title: Constraining the Milky Way Mass profile with data driven distribution function using DESI DR2 halo stars
background_knowledge: 银河系的质量分布，特别是暗物质晕的维里质量 $M_{\mathrm{200c}}$ 与浓度 $c_{\mathrm{200c}}$，是理解银河系形成、暗物质性质、星系演化及本星系群动力学的基石。观测上通常利用晕族恒星、球状星团和卫星星系等示踪体的位置与速度，在引力势中反演质量轮廓；传统方法常假设示踪体分布函数或速度各向异性的解析形式，并依赖稳态、球对称等近似。DESI 银河系巡天提供大样本晕族恒星光谱，使数据驱动的动力学建模成为可能；此类方法试图减少对示踪体分布函数先验形式的依赖，同时需要校准非稳态效应与观测误差。
contribution: 论文采用数据驱动的经验分布函数（emPDF）动力学建模方法，不预设示踪体分布函数的具体形式，并利用 AuriDESI 的逼真模拟观测检验和校准偏离稳态假设及观测误差的影响。将该方法应用于 DESI MWS 的两类晕族示踪体后，对 BHB 星得到 $\log M_{\mathrm{200c}}/M_{\odot}=12.05_{-0.12}^{+0.21}(_{-0.18}^{+0.26})$ 与 $\log c_{\mathrm{200c}}=1.20_{-0.16}^{+0.11}(_{-0.24}^{+0.20})$；对 RR Lyrae 星得到 $\log M_{\mathrm{200c}}/M_{\odot}=12.15_{-0.14}^{+0.22}(_{-0.19}^{+0.26})$ 与 $\log c_{\mathrm{200c}}=1.16_{-0.12}^{+0.09}(_{-0.18}^{+0.16})$。括号外与括号内分别为统计误差和包含 AuriDESI 校准系统误差的总误差。**两类示踪体给出的银河系晕质量轮廓总体一致**。进一步联合晕族恒星约束与卫星动力学独立约束，得到 $\log M_{\mathrm{200c}}/M_{\odot}=12.12_{-0.05}^{+0.05}(_{-0.04}^{+0.06})$ 与 $\log c_{\mathrm{200c}}=1.16_{-0.03}^{+0.05}(_{-0.07}^{+0.05})$，相关系数为 $\rho=-0.90(-0.54)$。**该工作以数据驱动方式提高了银河系质量轮廓测量的稳健性，并给出了系统误差经过校准的精确晕参数。**
summary: We employ a novel data-driven dynamical modeling method, the empirical distribution function (emPDF), to constrain the Milky Way mass profile using a large sample of halo stars from the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument Milky Way Survey (DESI MWS). The method does not assume any functional form of the tracer distribution. Deviations from the steady-state assumption and the effects of observational errors are further tested and calibrated using a number of realistic mock observations (AuriDESI). Applying the calibrated method to two classes of tracers in DESI, we derive a best-constrained virial mass and concentration of $\log M_\mathrm{200c}/M_{\odot}=12.05_{-0.12}^{+0.21}(_{-0.18}^{+0.26})$ and $\log c_\mathrm{200c}=1.20_{-0.16}^{+0.11}(_{-0.24}^{+0.20})$ for BHBs. For RR Lyrae stars we derive $\log M_\mathrm{200c}/M_{\odot}=12.15_{-0.14}^{+0.22}(_{-0.19}^{+0.26})$ and $\log c_\mathrm{200c}=1.16_{-0.12}^{+0.09}(_{-0.18}^{+0.16})$. The uncertainties quoted outside and within brackets are statistical and total errors including systematic errors calibrated from AuriDESI, respectively. The two tracer populations provide overall consistent measurements of the MW halo mass profile. Combining the halo star constraints with the independent constraint from satellite dynamics, we derive a robust and precise final measurement of the MW halo parameters of $\log M_\mathrm{200c}/M_{\odot}=12.12_{-0.05}^{+0.05}(_{-0.04}^{+0.06})$ and $\log c_\mathrm{200c}=1.16_{-0.03}^{+0.05}(_{-0.07}^{+0.05})$, with correlation coefficients of $ρ=-0.90(-0.54)$.

title: Gravitational waves flooding the Universe after wall domination
background_knowledge:
早期宇宙的热历史通常以辐射主导为主线：随着膨胀，能量密度由相对论粒子控制，尺度因子 $a(t)$ 随宇宙时 $t$ 增长，温度下降。若宇宙经历相变，可能形成拓扑缺陷，如宇宙弦、畴壁（domain walls）等；它们由场论真空结构稳定存在，其网络演化由共动相关长度与壁张力等参数描述。若某类缺陷能量密度一度超过辐射，宇宙会进入由该缺陷主导的阶段，改变膨胀律与引力波产生条件。
\n引力波是早期宇宙的干净信使：张量扰动在视界内产生，一旦物理波长超过视界尺度便近似冻结，待视界重新进入后以随机引力波背景形式传播。其频谱记录了主导组分的状态方程、缺陷网络尺度和持续时间。此外，早期宇宙额外能量密度会改变大爆炸核合成与宇宙微波背景所限制的膨胀速率，从而影响有效中微子种数 $N_{\mathrm{eff}}$ 等观测量。
contribution: 论文讨论一种早期宇宙情景：辐射主导期被畴壁主导时期中断，畴壁随后湮灭为粒子。在该阶段宇宙经历加速膨胀，而畴壁网络的共动相关长度保持不变。网络作为张量模的源；这些模在退出视界时被冻结，机制类似暴胀扰动。随后在辐射主导阶段重新进入视界，并自此贡献随机引力波背景。作者指出，该情景预言的引力波谱形与畴壁始终次主导、直到湮灭的情形 **显著不同**；这些引力波在很宽频率范围内 **强到足以被当前和未来装置观测**。尤其是其能量密度 **足以对有效中微子种数产生显著影响**，除非对畴壁主导的持续时间施加适当限制。
summary: We discuss a possible early Universe scenario, where radiation era is interrupted by the epoch of domination of domain walls eventually annihilating into particles. During this period the Universe undergoes accelerated expansion, while the comoving correlation length of the domain wall network remains constant. The network serves as a source of tensor modes, which get frozen upon exiting the horizon similarly to the case of inflationary fluctuations. The modes re-enter the horizon during the subsequent stage of radiation domination and since then contribute to the gravitational wave background. The spectral shape of gravitational waves predicted in this scenario is markedly different compared to the case of domain walls remaining sub-dominant all the way till annihilation. These gravitational waves are strong enough to be observed with present-day and future facilities in a broad range of frequencies. In particular, their energy density is sufficient to produce a significant impact on the effective number of neutrino species, unless the duration of wall domination is suitably constrained.

title: ReveaLLAGN 2: Exploring the Nuclear Gas and Stellar Kinematics of Nearby LLAGNs with JWST/NIRSpec IFU
background_knowledge: 活动星系核（AGN）由中心超大质量黑洞吸积供能，是研究黑洞增长、星系演化反馈与周围引力势的重要窗口。低光度活动星系核（LLAGN）通常指爱丁顿比很低、辐射效率较低、吸积流可能以径移主导流或 ADAF 形式存在的系统；它们在本地宇宙中数量最多，但核区在 pc 尺度上的结构、恒星与气体运动学以及电离机制仍不清楚。近红外积分视场光谱（IFU）可在强尘埃消光环境中同时获得空间分辨的恒星吸收线、氢复合线、分子氢线与高电离日冕线，用来测量视向速度、速度弥散及高阶 Gauss-Hermite 矩，并用发射线比值区分 AGN 光致电离、激波加热与恒星形成等机制。将恒星和气体的运动学与射电喷流、黑洞质量及爱丁顿比对照，是理解 LLAGN 吸积状态与核区物理的关键研究范式。
contribution: 论文利用 JWST/NIRSpec IFU 对 ReveaLLAGN 样本中 8 个近邻代表性 LLAGN（M87、M104、M94、M81、NGC 1052、NGC 4258、NGC 5128、NGC 4395）的核区开展空间分辨光谱研究，系统测量恒星、分子氢、氢复合线与高电离日冕线的运动学及空间分布，并考察这些谱线的可探测性和分布如何随爱丁顿比变化。**所有目标核区的恒星视向速度图均显示一个缓慢旋转的盘，且该速度场与 Gauss-Hermite 矩 $h_3$ 呈反相关；恒星速度弥散整体向中心黑洞方向升高。** 仅 M104 与 M94 的速度弥散呈现偏离简单盘结构的复杂图样，暗示存在多个运动学成分。**气体分布与运动学所显示的旋转常与恒星旋转解耦，表明当前吸积状态与恒星引力势并不简单耦合；气体运动学还经常在视向上与射电喷流方向一致，并沿喷流方向表现出更大的速度弥散。** 发射线比值图表明，**中心 AGN 的光致电离是主导激发机制，而激波机械加热仅在本样本较高爱丁顿比源中变得重要。** 使用核区孔径光谱时，所有 LLAGN 均探测到日冕线；但仅在 NGC 5128 和 NGC 4395 这两个爱丁顿比最高的源中获得了日冕线的空间分辨运动学。
summary: Low-luminosity active galactic nuclei (LLAGN) represent the most common mode of black hole accretion in the local Universe, yet their nuclear structure, stellar and gas kinematics remain poorly constrained at parsec scales. We investigate the nuclear regions of eight nearby representative LLAGN, the ReveaLLAGN sample: M87, M104, M94, M81, NGC1052, NGC4258, NGC5128 and NGC4395. Using JWST/NIRSpec data, we probe the stellar, molecular hydrogen, hydrogen recombination, and high ionisation coronal lines kinematics and their spatial distribution, exploring how detectability and spatial distributions of these lines vary across different Eddington ratios. The stellar LOSV maps reveal a slowly rotating disk in the nuclei of all our targets, characterised by an anti-correlation with the h3 Gauss-Hermite moment. Across the sample, the stellar velocity dispersion rises toward the central black hole. Only in M104 and M94 does the velocity dispersion display a more intricate pattern that departs from a simple disk configuration, indicating the presence of multiple kinematic components in these galaxies. Across the sample, the gas distribution and kinematics exhibit rotation that is frequently decoupled from the stellar rotation, suggesting that the stellar gravitational potential is decoupled from the current accretion state. The gas kinematics are often visually aligned with the radio jet, presenting broader velocity dispersions along the jet direction. Line-ratio maps indicate that the dominant excitation mechanism is photoionisation by the central AGN, with mechanical heating from shocks becoming important only at higher Eddington ratios. Across the sample, we detect coronal lines in all LLAGN when using nuclear-aperture spectra, and we can obtain spatially resolved kinematics only in NGC5128 and NGC4395, the highest Eddington ratio sources.

title: Euclid. Predicting scaling relations for emission-line galaxies using simulated data
background_knowledge: 星系形成与演化研究关注星系如何通过气体吸积、恒星形成、反馈和并合等过程增长，并形成可观测的统计规律。发射线星系是重要样本：H$\alpha$、Pa$\beta$ 和 [O II] 等谱线可示踪近期恒星形成率，H$\alpha$ 与 H$\beta$ 的 Balmer 递减可估计尘埃消光，多条光学静止系发射线可用于诊断气相金属丰度。恒星形成主序（MS）描述恒星形成星系在 SFR 与恒星质量 $M_*$ 平面上的紧密相关关系；尘埃—质量关系（DMR）联系尘埃消光或尘埃含量与星系质量；质量—金属丰度关系（MZR）反映星系化学富集历史与反馈。Euclid 近红外无缝光谱巡天（包括 EWS 与 EDS）将大幅增加发射线星系样本，但流量极限、谱线信噪比和波段覆盖会造成选择偏差，因此需要用包含星系族群分配与观测流程的模拟星表来评估巡天能否无偏地重建这些标度关系。
contribution: 本文使用 MAMBO（mocks with abundance matching in Bologna）光谱模拟星表，并经 Euclid 官方 pipeline 处理，评估在最终 DR3 深度下 EWS 与 EDS 能否由发射线测量重建恒星形成主序（MS）、尘埃质量关系（DMR）和质量—金属丰度关系（MZR）。作者在 $0 \leq z \leq 4$ 内用 Pa$\beta$、H$\alpha$ 和 [O II] 作为 SFR 示踪量追踪 MS：**EWS 的浅层流量极限会偏向选择最亮、恒星形成最强烈的星系，从而使 MS 的归一化偏高、斜率偏平**；**更深的 EDS 在 $\log_{10}(M_*/M_\odot) \geq 10.3$、$0 \leq z \leq 1.88$ 范围内用 Pa$\beta$ 和 H$\alpha$ 可近乎完整采样**，仅在红移两端有轻微偏差；基于 [O II] 的 MS 在高红移端会越来越偏向高 SFR。DMR 通过 Balmer 递减在 EWS 的 $1.45 \leq z \leq 1.88$ 和 EDS 的 $0.9 \leq z \leq 1.88$ 范围内追踪，导出的色余与输入值吻合较好，但探测微弱的 H$\beta$ 使样本在固定 $M_*$ 下偏向遮蔽较少的星系，这一问题在 EWS 中尤其明显，而 EDS 对 DMR 的采样更好。最后，在 $1.49 \leq z \leq 1.88$ 内被多条光学静止系发射线探测到的“金样本”可在 $\log_{10}(M_*/M_\odot) \geq 10$ 时以约 0.1 dex 的典型精度恢复气相金属丰度，低质量星系偏差可达 0.15 dex；**相对 H 波段限制样本，该样本更偏向追踪 MS 上部和 MZR 下部**。尽管模拟较简化、未包含谱线相互污染和探测器 persistence 等效应，这些预测仍为未来 Euclid 光谱分析提供了基准。
summary: The Euclid spectroscopic surveys will substantially increase the number of observed emission-line galaxies. We assess the ability of the Euclid Wide Survey (EWS) and Euclid Deep Survey (EDS), at the final DR3 depth, to recover the star-forming main sequence (MS), dust-mass relation (DMR), and mass-metallicity relation (MZR) from emission-line measurements. We use MAMBO (mocks with abundance matching in Bologna) spectroscopic simulations processed with the official Euclid pipelines. The MS is traced over $0\leq z\leq 4$ using Pa$β$, H$α$, and [OII] as SFR tracers. The shallow EWS flux limit biases the MS towards higher normalisation and a flatter slope by selecting the brightest, most strongly star-forming galaxies. The deeper EDS enables almost complete sampling with Pa$β$ and H$α$ at log$_{10}(M_*/M_\odot)\geq10.3$ over $0\leq z\leq 1.88$, with mild biases at both redshift limits. The [OII]-based MS is increasingly biased towards higher SFRs at the highest redshifts. The DMR is traced through the Balmer decrement over $1.45\leq z\leq 1.88$ and $0.9\leq z\leq 1.88$ in the EWS and EDS, respectively. The derived colour excess agree well with the input values, although detecting the faint H$β$ line restricts the sample to less obscured galaxies at fixed $M_*$, particularly in the EWS; the DMR is better sampled in the EDS. Finally, a golden sample detected in multiple optical rest-frame emission lines at $1.49\leq z\leq 1.88$ recovers gas-phase metallicities with typical accuracy of 0.1 dex at log$_{10}(M_*/M_\odot)\geq10$, while lower-mass galaxies show biases up to 0.15 dex. Relative to H-band limited sample, this sample preferentially traces the upper MS and lower MZR. Despite the simplified simulations lacking effects such as mutual spectral contamination and detector persistence, these forecasts provide a benchmark for future Euclid spectroscopic analyses.

title: CosmoVerse Data Challenge: How Tip of the Red Giant Branch Analysis Choices Shape the Inferred Hubble Constant
background_knowledge: 该工作属于近邻宇宙距离阶梯与哈勃常数测量方向。TRGB 指红巨星分支顶端，即低质量恒星发生核心氦闪的位置；其 I 波段光度对年龄和金属丰度相对不敏感，因而可作为标准烛光。通过高精度测光识别 TRGB 并测量其视星等，可获得星系距离；再利用同时宿主 Ia 型超新星（SN Ia）的星系标定 SN Ia，并将 SN Ia 应用于哈勃流，即可推断当前宇宙膨胀率 $H_0$。这条距离阶梯的关键环节包括测光目录选择、星系样本选择、TRGB 拟合与消光、拥挤和流量定标处理，以及锚星系（如 NGC 4258）的距离测定。当前本地距离阶梯测量与宇宙微波背景推断之间存在显著张力，因此理解不同分析选择如何传播到 $H_0$ 十分重要。
contribution: 论文介绍 CosmoVerse Data Challenge：参与者在共享距离阶梯框架下分析公开测光目录，使测量各步骤接受社区检验，并考察分析选择如何传播到 $H_0$。参与者独立选择测光目录、星系样本和 TRGB 测量设置，但使用共同的 SN Ia 汇编与拟合流程将距离转换为 $H_0$。挑战收到来自 22 位参与者的 26 份提交；所有提交使用同一分析笔记本，许多参与者为培训学校学员，且真实星系距离未知，因此结果刻画的是提交结果对分析与样本选择选择的敏感性，而非 $H_0$ 的联合测定或已发表 TRGB 测量系统误差的估计。推断的 $H_0$ 中位数为 $77.10\,\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$，标准差为 $7.38\,\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$（按中位数绝对偏差缩放为 $5.11\,\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$），约为单份提交典型不确定度的 3.4 倍（2.4 倍）。锚星系 NGC 4258 的 TRGB 测量差异会给距离尺度带来相干偏移。**该挑战表明，在同一框架内的不同选择可产生显著不同的 $H_0$ 值**，并为追踪这些差异、提高数据集与工具的透明性和可及性提供了开放基础。
summary: Tip of the red giant branch (TRGB)-based determinations of the Hubble constant ($H_0$), the current expansion rate of the Universe, depend on choices made in selecting and analyzing stellar photometry and in assembling the sample of calibrator galaxies hosting Type Ia supernovae (SNe Ia). The CosmoVerse Data Challenge invites participants to analyze public photometric catalogs within a shared distance-ladder framework, opening each step of the measurement to the community and testing how these choices propagate into $H_0$. Participants independently selected photometric catalogs, galaxies, and TRGB measurement settings, while using a common SN Ia compilation and fitting procedure to convert distances into $H_0$. Supported by public notebooks and a training school, the challenge received 26 submissions from 22 participants. All submissions used the same analysis notebook, many participants were trainees at the school, and the true galaxy distances are unknown; the results therefore characterize the sensitivity of the submissions to analysis and sample-selection choices and are not a combined determination of $H_0$ or an estimate of the systematic uncertainty in published TRGB measurements. The inferred $H_0$ values have a median of $77.10\,\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$ and a standard deviation of $7.38\,\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$ $(5.11\,\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$ for the scaled median absolute deviation), $\sim 3.4$ $(\sim 2.4)$ times the typical quoted uncertainty of a submission. Differences in the measured tip of the anchor galaxy NGC 4258 add a coherent shift in the distance scale. The challenge shows how different choices within a common framework can produce substantially different values of $H_0$, and provides an open basis for tracing these differences and for making datasets and tools more transparent and accessible.

title: From Earth's Harshest Landscapes to Lunar Horizons: Engineering NEA Telescopes for Extreme Environments
background_knowledge: 近地小行星（Near-Earth Asteroids, NEAs）的发现、编目、跟踪与物理表征是行星防御的核心任务。望远镜通过探测小行星反射的太阳光，在重复成像中识别移动目标，并利用多历元观测定轨、评估撞击概率。天体尺寸通常由绝对星等 $H$ 与反照率联合估算；撞击能量随直径和速度急剧增加，因此百米级天体也可能造成区域尺度灾害。地面巡天受大气消光、天气、月相、昼夜循环和太阳规避角限制，对靠近太阳方向的目标尤其不敏感，可能显著缩短预警时间。月球无大气、可连续观测并覆盖部分地面盲区，被视为下一代行星防御观测平台的重要候选，但其热循环、月尘、辐射与自主运行等工程约束极为严苛。
contribution: 论文指出现有巡天已成功发现大多数大型 NEAs，但约 $140$ m 以下天体仍存在显著观测空白，而这类天体仍可造成区域尺度破坏；地面巡天受大气条件、天气和太阳规避约束，尤其难以探测从太阳方向接近的目标，从而缩短可用预警时间。作者论证月球望远镜可观测地球难以覆盖的天区、提升灵敏度并改善早期预警能力，但必须克服热循环、月尘污染、辐射暴露和自主运行等严苛工程挑战。为此提出 **AMAS（Atacama-Mongolia-Antarctica-Sahara）国际计划**，将地球最极端环境作为未来月球天文设施的类比试验场，通过部署和测试专用 NEA 巡天望远镜，在接近真实运行条件下验证关键技术。文章系统给出科学论证、工程挑战、选址策略，以及面向 **全球地月行星防御观测网络** 的长期路线图。
summary: Near-Earth Asteroids (NEAs) represent both a scientific opportunity and a potential threat to human civilization. While current survey programs have successfully detected most large NEAs, a significant observational gap remains for objects smaller than approximately 140 m, which can still produce regional-scale devastation. Ground-based surveys are intrinsically limited by atmospheric conditions, weather, and solar avoidance constraints, which leave a significant fraction of near-Sun objects difficult to detect. In particular, Earth-based observatories remain largely blind to objects approaching from the Sun-ward direction, reducing available warning times. Future lunar observatories offer a promising solution to this limitation. A telescope operating on the Moon could enable observations of regions inaccessible from Earth, provide enhanced sensitivity, and significantly improve early detection capabilities. However, the lunar environment imposes severe engineering constraints, including thermal cycling, dust contamination, radiation exposure, and autonomous operation requirements. We propose the AMAS(Atacama-Mongolia-Antarctica-Sahara) project, an international initiative using Earth's most extreme environments as analogue sites for future lunar astronomical facilities. By deploying and testing specialized NEA survey telescopes in these environments, key technologies for future lunar observatories can be validated under realistic operational conditions. This paper presents the scientific rationale, engineering challenges, site selection strategy, and long-term roadmap toward a global Earth-Moon network for planetary defense.

title: Spectroscopy-informed Deep Learning Searches for Photometric Little Red Dots in JWST Surveys
background_knowledge: “小红点”（Little Red Dots，LRDs）是 JWST 在高红移宇宙中发现的一类形态紧凑、颜色偏红的特殊源。其静止系光谱能量分布（SED）常呈 V 形：紫外端相对偏蓝，光学端明显偏红，并在巴尔末跃变附近出现特征结构。部分 LRD 具有宽 $\mathrm{H}\alpha$ 发射线，说明存在高速运动的电离气体，可能来自活动星系核（AGN）宽线区；同时也存在致密星暴、尘埃遮蔽或特殊恒星族群等解释，因此其物理本质仍是活跃争论问题。当前 LRD 样本主要依赖 JWST/NIRCam 多波段测光颜色选择，不同研究采用的颜色标准并不统一，容易受到测光误差、红移、尘埃消光和 AGN 贡献简并的影响，进而造成样本差异与选择偏差。NIRSpec 光谱能够提供红移、发射线宽度和谱形等关键证认信息，但光谱观测成本高、覆盖面积和样本量有限。近年来，利用机器学习把光谱监督信息迁移到大规模测光数据，成为系统搜寻和检验 LRD 颜色选择完备性的重要研究范式。
contribution: 论文构建了一个跨模态机器学习框架，将匹配的 NIRCam 成像与 NIRSpec/PRISM 光谱联合使用，把光谱信息迁移到基于成像的表征中，从而仅凭 JWST/NIRCam 测光识别 LRD。将该分类器应用于此前被归类为非 LRD 的光谱观测高红移星系，模型给出 35 个新的 LRD 候选；其中大多数满足至少一个独立的 LRD 颜色选择标准。在 13 个具有中分辨率或高分辨率 NIRSpec 光栅光谱的候选中，10 个显示出宽 $\mathrm{H}\alpha$ 发射线，这是 LRD 的重要特征。作者进一步把分类器用于 Dawn JWST Archive 的公开 NIRCam 成像以及两个独立 JWST 巡天，分别得到 357 个和 23 个额外 LRD 候选。新方法恢复的候选在观测 SED 性质上比现有样本分布更广，表明**当前基于颜色选择的样本可能尚未完整覆盖 JWST 巡天中 LRD 类天体的多样性**；研究也强调，**光谱信息引导的测光分类是系统挖掘大面积 JWST 成像数据的有力策略**，并为后续研究这一新兴天体族群提供了实用框架。
summary: Little Red Dots (LRDs) are a population of compact, red sources discovered at high redshift with JWST that exhibit distinctive V-shaped spectral energy distributions (SEDs). Existing LRD samples are typically identified using a variety of color-based selection criteria, which can lead to differences in the populations recovered by different studies. We develop a cross-modal machine-learning framework that combines matched NIRCam imaging and NIRSpec/PRISM spectroscopy to transfer spectroscopic information into imaging-based representations, enabling LRD identification from JWST/NIRCam imaging alone. Applied to spectroscopically observed high-redshift galaxies previously classified as non-LRDs, our model identifies 35 new LRD candidates. The majority satisfy at least one independent LRD color selection criterion, and among the 13 candidates with medium- or high-resolution NIRSpec grating spectra, 10 exhibit broad H$α$ emission - a hallmark of LRDs. We further apply the classifier to public NIRCam imaging from the Dawn JWST Archive and two independent JWST surveys, yielding 357 and 23 additional LRD candidates, respectively. The candidates recovered by our method span a broader range of observed SED properties than those in existing samples, suggesting that current color-selected samples may not fully capture the diversity of LRD-like systems present in JWST surveys. Our findings highlight the value of spectroscopy-informed photometric classification as a powerful strategy for systematically mining large-area JWST imaging datasets and provide a practical framework for future studies of this emerging population.

title: Aperture-dependent [O III] profile variability: Clues to the nature of double-peaked narrow emission lines
background_knowledge: 活动星系核（AGN）由超大质量黑洞吸积驱动，其辐射会电离周围气体，并形成宽线区和窄线区（NLR）。NLR 的尺度通常从数十秒差距延伸到数千秒差距，其中包含云团、团块，以及可能的外流、旋转或非轴对称结构；[O III] 等禁线因临界密度低，能有效追踪这些气体的电离状态与运动学。双峰窄发射线（DPNELs）是指窄线轮廓中出现两个速度分量，可能源于双 AGN、AGN 驱动外流、旋转盘、喷流与气体相互作用，或投影与消光等效应。由于光谱孔径对应天空上的特定立体角，不同光纤或狭缝会采样 NLR 的不同区域，并以不同权重把不同速度、不同空间尺度的气体积分进单一谱线轮廓。因此，比较同一目标在不同孔径下的谱线轮廓，可把空间信息编码进轮廓变化，用来检验 DPNELs 的物理起源。当前研究常结合 SDSS、DESI、LAMOST 等多源光谱、积分视场光谱、高分辨率成像与多波段数据，并借助谱线比、速度分离和形态先验区分候选机制；核心难点在于不同运动学场景常产生简并的积分谱线特征。
contribution: 本文提出一种简单而实用的孔径依赖方法，利用不同光谱孔径采样 NLR 不同空间区域、因而对应不同气体运动学的特点，通过比较同一目标在不同孔径下的双峰窄发射线轮廓来约束其物理起源。作者将该方法应用于 SDSS J0941，对比 SDSS、DESI 和 LAMOST 的光谱，发现不同光谱中的双峰轮廓存在显著差异，表明**孔径效应能够强烈影响积分后的 DPNEL 轮廓**。双 AGN 模型（两个核位于垂直于视线的平面内）可以定性解释两个 NLR 的不对称采样，但**无法解释不同光谱中峰间距的变化**；两个分量表现出的不对称演化也不支持简单的 AGN 驱动外流和旋转盘状 NLR 图像。在所考虑的模型中，**只有更复杂的非轴对称旋转 NLR 能自洽解释观测到的孔径依赖变化**：蓝移发射区更致密，主要被较小孔径包住，因此线宽增加而流量变化不大；红移发射区空间上更延展，受较小孔径影响更强，导致流量和线宽同时明显下降。结果展示了联合多孔径光谱巡天研究 DPNEL 起源的诊断潜力，同时凸显了区分不同物理场景的困难。
summary: We propose a simple and practical aperture-dependent method for investigating the physical origin of double-peaked narrow emission lines (DPNELs). Spectroscopic observations obtained from different apertures probe different spatial regions and therefore different gas kinematics within the narrow line region (NLR). Consequently, changes in the profiles of DPNELs observed with different apertures can provide important constraints on their physical origins. We applied this method to SDSS J0941 by comparing spectra obtained from the SDSS, DESI, and LAMOST surveys. Significant differences are found in the double-peaked profiles of the different spectra, demonstrating that aperture effects can strongly influence the integrated DPNEL profiles. The AGN model, where the two nuclei lie in a plane perpendicular to the line of sight, can qualitatively explain the asymmetric sampling of the two NLRs, but it cannot explain the different peak separations of different spectra. The observed asymmetric evolution of the two components disfavors a simple AGN-driven outflow and a rotating disk-like NLR scenario. Of the models considered, only a more complex non-axisymmetric rotating NLR provides a self-consistent explanation for the observed aperture-dependent variations. In this scenario, the blueshifted emitting region is more compact and remains largely enclosed by the smaller aperture, resulting in an increased line width with little change in flux. In contrast, the redshifted emitting region is more spatially extended and is therefore more strongly affected by the reduced aperture, leading to pronounced decreases in both flux and line width. Our results illustrate the diagnostic potential of combining multi-aperture spectroscopic surveys to study DPNEL origins, while highlighting the difficulty of distinguishing between physical scenarios.

title: Gaia DR3 Reveals the Kinematics of Young Stellar Objects in the Carina Nebula: Peripheral Expansion and Central Rotation
background_knowledge:
星际介质与恒星形成研究关注冷分子云如何在自身引力、湍流、磁场和大质量恒星反馈的共同作用下坍缩并形成恒星，以及新生恒星和残余气体随后如何演化。巨分子云是恒星诞生的主要场所，其内部的高密度核会形成年轻恒星体（YSOs）；而大质量恒星一旦形成，就会通过电离辐射、星风、辐射压和超新星爆炸向周围注入能量与动量，加热、电离、吹散气体，并可能触发或抑制后续恒星形成。
\n船底座星云（Carina Nebula）是银河系内最活跃、最典型的大质量恒星形成区之一，包含丰富的分子云、电离氢区、年轻星团和大质量 OB 星。研究这类区域的核心范式之一，是把 YSOs 当作近期恒星形成活动的“运动学示踪体”：Gaia 等高精度天体测量给出恒星自行，光谱观测给出视向速度，分子谱线则描绘母云的气体分布与运动。将这些数据结合，可以重建星云内部的膨胀、旋转、外流和反馈驱动运动，并通过动量与能量收支判断大质量恒星反馈在云体动力学演化中的作用。
contribution: 论文利用与 Gaia DR3 交叉匹配的年轻恒星体（YSOs）样本，并结合 $^{12}\mathrm{CO}\,(1\mbox{--}0)$ 分子气体观测和 APOGEE 视向速度数据，研究船底座星云的恒星与气体运动学。结果显示，Carina 四个外围子区域中的 YSOs 自行呈现系统性向外膨胀，各子区域的二维膨胀速度约为 $0.57\mbox{--}4.56~\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}}$；中央区域的 YSOs 则绕位置角为 $86.9\pm1.5^\circ$ 的轴作有序旋转，旋转速度约为 $1.75\pm0.03~\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}}$。进一步的动量估计表明，外围区域的当前膨胀可能来自大质量 OB 星反馈与可能的过去超新星爆炸的共同作用。这些结果表明，**大质量恒星反馈在船底座星云巨分子云的动力学演化中起主导作用**。
summary: We investigate the kinematics of the Carina Nebula using a sample of young stellar objects (YSOs) cross-matched with Gaia DR3, together with $^{12}\mathrm{CO}\,(1\mbox{--}0)$ molecular gas observations and APOGEE radial-velocity data. The results show that the proper motions of the YSOs in the four peripheral subregions of Carina display a systematic outward expansion, and that the two-dimensional expansion velocities of the subregions are approximately $0.57\mbox{--}4.56~\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}}$. The YSOs in the Central Region exhibit ordered rotation around an axis at a position angle of $86.9\pm1.5^\circ$, with a rotation velocity of $1.75\pm0.03~\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}}$. Further momentum estimates suggest that the current expansion in the peripheral regions may result from the combined effects of feedback from massive OB stars and possible past supernova explosions. These results indicate that feedback from massive stars plays a dominant role in the dynamical evolution of the giant molecular cloud in the Carina Nebula.

title: Object-independent evaluation of small-data astronomical image classifiers: architecture, representation, and acquisition shortcuts
background_knowledge: 该工作属于天文图像处理与机器学习方法学的交叉领域。传统上，星系、球状星团、星云和疏散星团等天体可依据形态、颜色、尺度及所处环境进行分类；现代巡天产生海量图像，常用卷积神经网络（CNN）、Transformer 或预训练视觉模型进行自动分类。典型研究范式是：用带标签图像训练模型，在独立测试集上用平衡准确率等指标评估泛化能力。小样本天文数据存在特殊陷阱：同一物理天体可能在多个波段、不同视场裁剪或数据增强副本中重复出现；若随机划分训练集与测试集，模型可能记住对象而非学习形态。不同天体的视场大小、仪器与采集参数、星表元数据也可能与类别相关，形成捷径。严格评估需按物理天体分组划分，并设置统一视场、中心区域遮挡、仅用元数据等对照，以区分形态学习与上下文、采集或星表信息。预训练与架构效应常相互混淆：ImageNet 预训练提供强先验，从零训练模型则不同；要比较架构需控制预训练。平衡准确率可缓解类别不平衡，聚类自助法可处理对象级相关性。
contribution: 论文构建一个专门数据集，用于量化小样本天文图像分类中对象复用、视场差异、采集设置和星表属性等影响。数据集含 370 个有星表支持的物理天体，分属星系、球状星团、星云和疏散星团四类；每个对象有三个 Digitised Sky Survey FITS 波段图像；按物理对象分组划分为 222 个训练、75 个验证和 73 个测试对象。作者比较从零训练的自定义 CNN-Transformer 与 ImageNet 预训练 ResNet-50、ViT-B/16，在自适应全视场表示、统一角视场以及两种中心区域遮挡对照下，用三个固定随机种子评估。单次对象独立测试中，自适应视图的平均平衡准确率为自定义模型 $0.773\pm0.014$、ResNet-50 $0.874\pm0.054$、ViT-B/16 $0.866\pm0.023$。**经 Holm 校正后，没有任何主要架构对比拒绝零假设；ResNet-50 与 ViT-B/16 的平衡准确率仅差 $0.007$，95% 聚类自助法区间为 $[-0.048,0.062]$。** 基于采集与星表元数据的对照达到 $0.721$–$0.735$，中心区域遮挡的自适应视图达到 $0.731$–$0.800$。**这些结果说明模型能泛化到未见过的物理对象，但也表明图像上下文、采集设置和星表导出的对象属性携带大量类别信息；因此高准确率不能解释为分类器学会了目标形态，且该比较并未把架构效应与预训练效应分离。**
summary: Reported performance in small astronomical image datasets can reflect object reuse, field-of-view differences, acquisition settings, and catalogue-derived properties as well as astronomical morphology. We designed \dataset{} to measure these effects in a four-class task comprising galaxies, globular clusters, nebulae, and open clusters. The dataset contains 370 catalogue-supported physical objects, each represented by three Digitised Sky Survey FITS bands, and uses a group-constrained split of 222 training, 75 validation, and 73 test objects. We compared a custom CNN--Transformer trained from scratch with ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50 and ViT-B/16 under an adaptive full-field representation, a common angular field, and two central-region-masked controls, using three fixed seeds. In the one-pass object-independent test, mean balanced accuracy on the adaptive view was $0.773\pm0.014$, $0.874\pm0.054$, and $0.866\pm0.023$ for the custom model, ResNet-50, and ViT-B/16, respectively. No primary architecture contrast rejected its null after Holm correction; ResNet-50 and ViT-B/16 differed by 0.007 balanced-accuracy points (95\% cluster-bootstrap interval $[-0.048,0.062]$). Controls based on acquisition and catalogue metadata reached 0.721--0.735, and central-region-masked adaptive views reached 0.731--0.800. These results demonstrate generalisation to unseen physical objects, but also show that image context, acquisition settings, and catalogue-derived object properties carry substantial class information. In this regime, high accuracy cannot be interpreted as evidence that a classifier learned target morphology, and the comparison does not isolate architecture from pretraining.

title: The Environment of High-Energy Transient Host Galaxies at High Redshifts as Observed by SHARP
background_knowledge:
高能暂现源包括长伽马射线暴（long GRBs）、短伽马射线暴（short GRBs）、极超新星（extreme SNe）以及双中子星并合产生的千新星（kilonovae）。长 GRB 通常与大质量恒星坍缩有关，其宿主星系多呈现低质量、强恒星形成和亚太阳金属丰度等特征；短 GRB 与千新星则与致密双星并合有关，可出现在较年老或混合星族环境中。因此，暂现源可作为追踪早期宇宙恒星形成与金属丰度演化的独特探针。
\n传统研究多依赖宿主星系的整体光谱或宽带测光，获得的是星系平均物理性质。然而，前身星所在的局部环境可能受金属丰度梯度、星团尺度不均匀性和尘埃消光影响，与全局平均值显著不同；若直接以全局性质代替爆炸点条件，就可能误判长 GRB 等暂现源对低金属丰度的需求。
\n空间分辨积分场光谱（integral field unit, IFU）通过三维数据立方体同时获取每个空间像素的光谱，能够在爆炸点附近测量金属丰度、恒星年龄、电离参数和运动学。对高红移（$z \gtrsim 1$ 至 2）目标，静止系光学诊断线（如 [O II]、Hβ、[O III]、Hα）移到近红外，因而近红外 IFU 观测至关重要。SHARP/VESPER 等高空间分辨率近红外 IFU 可在自适应光学或自然视宁度条件下解析高红移宿主星系，为连接前身星性质与诞生环境提供直接观测基础。
contribution: 该文是一篇综述，系统论证了高红移高能暂现源宿主星系研究需要从“整体星系”走向“爆炸点局域环境”。作者指出，传统全局宿主星系研究受金属丰度梯度与空间不均匀性限制，难以准确刻画前身星所处条件；利用 SHARP/VESPER 等高空间分辨率近红外 IFU 数据，可在爆炸位置直接测定金属丰度、恒星年龄与运动学，从而把长 GRB 所需的低金属丰度等前身星性质与其诞生环境联系起来。文章进一步强调，这类观测对推动高红移暂现源科学具有关键作用，包括刻画无 GRB 伴随的超新星以及千新星宿主星系。**核心结论是：近红外空间分辨光谱是连接暂现源前身星性质与高红移恒星形成环境的关键手段，SHARP 类仪器将显著提升该领域的观测能力。**
summary: The study of transient events, such as Gamma-Ray Bursts (GRBs) and extreme Supernovae (SNe), provides a unique probe of star-forming environments in the early Universe. Traditional global host galaxy studies often fail to capture the local conditions around the progenitor, leading to potential mischaracterizations due to metallicity gradients and spatial inhomogeneities. Using high spatial resolution integral field unit (IFU) data, such as those obtained with SHARP/VESPER, allows us to spatially resolve the host galaxies and accurately determine the physical properties (metallicity, stellar age, kinematics) at the precise explosion site. Here, we review the need for near-infrared spatially-resolved observations to link progenitor properties, such as the required low metallicity for long GRBs, to their birth environments, and highlight the crucial role of instruments like SHARP in advancing high-redshift transient science, including the characterization of SNe without associated GRBs and Kilonovae hosts.

title: SHARP: A spectrograph proposal to fully exploit ELT capabilities
background_knowledge: 当代天文学正进入极大口径地基望远镜时代。望远镜的核心能力由集光面积和角分辨率决定：更大口径可探测更暗天体，并在衍射极限下分辨更小结构。ELT 口径约 39 m，其近红外集光能力和空间分辨率预计超过 JWST；但地基观测受大气湍流影响，需要自适应光学。MCAO 通过多个导星与变形镜对三维湍流进行宽场校正，使近红外衍射极限成像与光谱在大视场内成为可能。近红外光谱对天文学至关重要：它可探测高红移星系红移后的紫外/光学谱线，穿透尘埃，并研究恒星连续谱、发射线、气体运动学和化学丰度，从而连接近邻宇宙与遥远宇宙。观测模式上，MOS 可在较大视场内同时获取大量目标的光谱，适合极暗源的多路复用；IFU 则对每个空间像素获取光谱，适合研究延展源与内部运动学，multi-IFU 可同时观测多个目标。此类仪器概念研究通常从核心科学问题出发，分解为波长覆盖、光谱分辨率、视场、多路复用能力、灵敏度与巡天效率等需求，再通过光学设计、探测器与 AO 方案进行权衡，最终形成可建造的光谱仪概念。
contribution: SHARP 是面向 ESO ELT 的近红外光谱仪概念研究，覆盖 $0.95$--$2.45\ \mu\mathrm{m}$ 波段，目标是充分利用 ELT 的集光面积与角分辨率，并以足够的通用性应对从近邻到遥远宇宙的多样观测需求。其核心架构为两个单元：**NEXUS 是优化于探测最暗源的多目标光谱仪（MOS）**；**VESPER 是面向较亮源的多目标积分场单元（multi-IFU）**。报告概述科学设计驱动、为满足这些需求所发展的方案，以及达到所需性能的光学设计；摘要未给出具体观测结果或定量性能指标。
summary: The Extremely Large Telescopes (ELTs), with their large apertures and cutting-edge Multi-Conjugate Adaptive Optics (MCAO) systems, promise to deliver data sharper and deeper than even the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) across large fields. SHARP is a concept study for a near-IR (0.95--2.45 $μ$m) spectrograph specifically designed to fully exploit the collecting area and angular resolution capabilities of the upcoming ESO's ELT. The instrument concept is driven by the goal of tackling the most important questions in astrophysics and cosmology, bridging the gap between the local and distant Universe. This requires versatility to accommodate diverse observational needs. SHARP (http://sharp.brera.inaf.it) is composed of two main units: NEXUS, a Multi-Object Spectrograph (MOS) optimized for detecting the faintest sources, and VESPER, a multi-object Integral Field Unit (multi-IFU) designed for brighter ones. This presentation provides an overview of the scientific design drivers, the solutions developed to meet them, and the resulting optical design that achieves the required performance.

title: Quiescent galaxies at cosmic noon: from individual element abundances to star formation histories
background_knowledge:
大质量宁静星系是在宇宙早期形成了大部分恒星、随后快速淬灭并停止显著恒星形成的系统。它们的光谱与星族性质记录了星系组装、气体吸积、反馈和并合历史。化学丰度是理解这些过程的关键探针：不同质量的恒星与超新星在各自时标上产生不同元素，因此个体元素丰度及丰度比（如 $[\alpha/\mathrm{Fe}]$）可约束恒星形成时标、初始质量函数、气体流入流出和化学演化。低红移与中等红移的大样本研究已建立恒星质量—金属丰度—丰度比之间的强相关，但在宇宙正午（cosmic noon）的 $z \sim 2-3$，这类测量仍非常有限。
\n该红移处的大质量宁静星系暗弱且紧凑，其静止系光学吸收特征移到近红外，进行中等分辨率光谱和细致化学分析极具挑战。要可靠分解元素丰度模式，需要高信噪比、高空间分辨率以及大口径望远镜的自适应光学能力，这是理解最早大质量星系如何形成与淬灭的关键观测方向。
contribution:
本文提出一项科学论证：对宇宙正午具有代表性的大质量宁静星系样本，利用静止系光学吸收特征测量完整的个体元素丰度模式，并据此约束其星族性质与恒星形成历史。作者表明，**稳健的星族参数与丰度约束需要每个分辨元件达到 $S/N \sim 20$ 的信噪比，并具备与这些星系 $\sim 0.1$ 角秒尺寸相当的空间分辨率**；**只有配备强大自适应光学系统的 $40\,\mathrm{m}$ 级望远镜才能满足这些要求**。在这一条件下，**SHARP-NEXUS 与 MORFEO-MCAO 能力的组合是唯一能够实现该科学的 ELT 仪器方案**，可同时提供所需灵敏度与角分辨率。
\n尽管此类大质量宁静星系在高红移较稀少，但可通过瞄准星系过密区、并与恒星形成星系巡天协同，高效利用仪器的多目标复用能力；类似协同策略已在高红移星系团中以及如 4MOST 的多目标共享设施中得到验证。**该方案将使 SHARP-NEXUS 为最早大质量星系的化学增丰研究打开新窗口**。
summary: Understanding the formation and early evolution of massive quiescent galaxies is crucial for a complete picture of galaxy formation in a cosmological context. Such a comprehensive picture can be obtained through measurements of individual elemental abundances, which encode the timescales and physical conditions of their star-formation and assembly histories. While extensive work at low and intermediate redshift has revealed strong correlations between stellar mass, metallicity, and abundance ratios, studies at z ~ 2-3 remain extremely limited. Their faintness and compactness make medium-resolution near-infrared spectroscopy for detailed chemical analysis extremely challenging. We present a science case to measure full elemental abundance patterns in a representative sample of massive quiescent galaxies at cosmic noon, exploiting rest-frame optical absorption features. We show that deriving robust stellar population constraints for these systems requires spectra with S/N ~ 20 per resolution element, together with a spatial resolution comparable to their ~ 0.1 arcsec sizes. We show that such requirements can only be met with a 40m class telescope equipped with a powerful adaptive optics system. In this context, SHARP-NEXUS, in combination with MORFEO-MCAO capabilities, emerges as the only viable ELT instrument capable of enabling this science, providing both the sensitivity and angular resolution needed. Although massive quiescent galaxies are rare at these redshifts, their study can efficiently exploit the instrument's multiplexing by targeting galaxy overdensities and coordinating with surveys of star-forming galaxies. Such synergistic strategies, proven feasible in high-redshift clusters and by multiplex-sharing facilities like 4MOST, would allow SHARP-NEXUS to open a new window on the chemical enrichment of the earliest massive galaxies.

title: Primordial Black Holes and Induced Gravitational Waves from Inflation with History-Dependent Effective Dissipation
background_knowledge: 宇宙暴胀是极早期宇宙的加速膨胀阶段，可解释宇宙微波背景（CMB）近标度不变的曲率扰动、宇宙平直性与视界问题；其量子涨落是星系和大尺度结构的种子。标准单场慢滚图像中，扰动谱在 CMB 尺度近似为幂律，但在小尺度上若势能存在平台、拐点或非最小耦合等特征，功率可被显著增强。进入辐射主导期后，局部超额密度可坍缩形成原初黑洞（PBH），其质量与扰动进入视界的尺度相关；PBH 因而既是暗物质候选，也是探测暴胀小尺度物理的窗口。另一方面，标量扰动在二阶会源起标量诱导引力波（SIGW），其频率取决于扰动峰对应的尺度，可覆盖从纳赫兹到毫赫兹等频段，为未来引力波探测器提供检验早期宇宙的途径。该子领域的研究范式通常是：构建暴胀模型，求解背景与标量扰动方程，以 CMB 振幅归一化小尺度谱，计算 PBH 丰度与 SIGW 谱，并与观测或探测器灵敏度比较。本文进一步引入依赖累积膨胀历史的有效耗散与耦合：拉氏量前的指数因子由场依赖耦合调制，导致背景方程出现伴随响应及末时边界条件，从而改变慢滚参数和扰动增长。
contribution: 论文研究带有历史依赖有效耗散的暴胀模型：标量拉氏量乘以一个指数因子，该因子通过场依赖耦合依赖于累积膨胀历史；对有限区间上的完整作用量变分得到带末时边界条件的伴随响应。作者推导背景方程及耦合的标量扰动方程，并针对指数平台势能与光滑单窗口耦合构造五个基准情形。结果显示，**动能项、直接耦合项与伴随项近乎抵消，使第一 Hubble 慢滚参数 $ \epsilon_1 $ 出现瞬态正极小值，而场速度没有出现同等幅度的下降**。将标量谱按 CMB 枢轴振幅归一化后，小尺度上形成局域峰，峰幅为 0.033–0.098。在高斯统计与所采用的辐射期坍缩方案下，**PBH 丰度峰对应的质量范围为 $4.52\times10^{-13}$ 至 $34.05\,M_\odot$；最轻质量基准可达 $ f_{\rm PBH}\simeq0.99 $，在单色近似下几乎可解释全部暗物质**。伴随的标量诱导引力波谱峰频覆盖 $6.78\times10^{-10}$ 至 $5.92\times10^{-3}\,\mathrm{Hz}$，**其中部分基准落在未来探测器的预期灵敏度范围内**。
summary: We study inflation with an exponential factor multiplying the scalar Lagrangian and depending on the accumulated expansion history through a field-dependent coupling. Variation of the complete action on a finite interval yields an adjoint response with a final-time boundary condition. We derive the background and coupled scalar perturbation equations and examine five benchmarks for an exponential plateau potential and a smooth single-window coupling. The kinetic, direct-coupling and adjoint contributions nearly cancel, producing transient positive minima of the first Hubble slow-roll parameter, $ε_1$, without a comparable reduction in field velocity. The scalar spectra, normalized to the cosmic microwave background (CMB) pivot amplitude, develop localized peaks with amplitudes $0.033$--$0.098$. Under Gaussian statistics and the adopted radiation-era collapse prescription, the the primordial black hole (PBH) abundance peaks span masses from $4.52\times10^{-13}$ to $34.05\,M_\odot$. The lightest-mass benchmark reaches $f_{\rm PBH}\simeq0.99$, allowing nearly all dark matter within the monochromatic approximation. The accompanying scalar-induced gravitational-wave spectra span peak frequencies from $6.78\times10^{-10}$ to $5.92\times10^{-3}\,\mathrm{Hz}$, with selected benchmarks lying within the projected sensitivities of future detectors.

title: A brief overview of the baryon cycle in galaxies
background_knowledge: 星系形成与演化是现代天体物理的核心课题之一。在 ΛCDM 宇宙学框架下，暗物质晕通过引力塌缩与层级并合不断生长，重子物质（气体）则沿宇宙网（cosmic web）的纤维结构被吸积进入暗物质晕，形成环绕星系的星系周介质（circumgalactic medium, CGM）；气体进一步冷却、凝聚并进入星系内部，成为星际介质（interstellar medium, ISM）。ISM 中的分子云在引力不稳定性作用下塌缩形成恒星，而恒星在其生命末期通过星风、超新星爆发，以及中心大质量黑洞的辐射与喷流，把能量、动量和金属元素返还给 ISM 与 CGM，这一过程统称为反馈（feedback）。吸积、恒星形成与反馈共同构成"重子循环"（baryon cycle），决定了星系的气体含量、恒星形成率、恒星质量、金属丰度及其随宇宙时间的演化，同时也解释了星系恒星质量函数与重子比例等宏观统计规律。观测上，该领域依赖多波段手段：光学与近红外成像及光谱测量恒星形成与金属丰度，射电 21 cm 线与毫米波分子谱线探测冷气体，紫外吸收线（如 Lyα、C IV、O VI）与 X 射线观测探测 CGM 中的热气体；理论上则以宇宙学流体模拟（如 IllustrisTNG、EAGLE、FIRE）为桥梁，将小尺度恒星反馈物理与大幅天区统计观测相比较。当前的核心争议包括：气体以"冷流"还是"热吸积"模式进入星系、反馈能量如何在星系尺度上耦合与逃逸、以及 CGM 中重子与金属的分布和循环时标等。
contribution: 本文是一篇简要综述，围绕星系重子循环的完整物理链条展开梳理：从气体被吸积到星系上，到气体转化为恒星，再到调控星系生长的各类反馈过程。作者指出，**星系形成与演化由宇宙网、星系周介质（CGM）与星系内星际介质（ISM）之间持续的气体交换所主导**，并在此基础上**系统提炼出该领域若干关键的开放问题**，强调需要宇宙学模拟、多波段观测与理论三方面的协同进展方能加以解决。
summary: Galaxy formation and evolution is governed by the continuous exchange of gas between the cosmic web, the circumgalactic medium (CGM), and the interstellar medium (ISM) of galaxies. This brief review summarises our current understanding of this baryon cycle, from the accretion of gas onto galaxies to its conversion into stars, and the feedback processes that regulate the growth of galaxies. Several open questions will be highlighted, that will encourage progresses in cosmological simulations, multiwavelength observations, and theory to resolve.

title: Polarimetry with the Giant Magellan Telescope: A Scientific Justification & Technical Requirements Document
background_knowledge: 在天文学中，光子除携带流量、波长和到达时间等信息外，还携带偏振态信息。偏振通常用 Stokes 参数 $I$、$Q$、$U$、$V$ 描述：$I$ 为总强度，$Q$ 与 $U$ 描述线偏振，$V$ 描述圆偏振；线偏振度为 $P=\sqrt{Q^2+U^2}/I$，偏振角为 $\chi=\frac{1}{2}\arctan(U/Q)$。偏振的产生与传播过程密切相关，可由散射、同步辐射、磁场中的尘埃吸收或发射、原子 Zeeman 效应等机制引起，因此偏振测量可探测源的几何结构、辐射机制、尘埃性质与磁场构型。许多天体的磁场和空间结构在直接成像中无法分辨，而偏振信号可提供独特约束。光学与近红外偏振测量通常需要比较不同偏振调制状态下的光子计数，系统效应和统计噪声控制要求很高；关键模型判别往往需要达到 0.1% 的偏振度精度。光谱偏振测量进一步要求在每个光谱 bin 内积累足够多的光子，因此属于典型的光子稀缺型观测。大口径望远镜和高效偏振仪是提升信噪比、开展暗弱目标偏振测量的关键基础。
contribution: 该文档以巨型麦哲伦望远镜（GMT）的偏振测量为主题，给出科学论证与技术需求。作者指出，光学与近红外波段通常通过滤光片或色散器提取光子流量随颜色的变化，而偏振态这一常被忽视的信息能够揭示源的几何结构与磁场等细节，这些细节往往无法分辨，因而难以由其他手段获得。**偏振测量能够揭示通常无法分辨的源几何与磁场信息**。由于关键模型判别常要求偏振度精度达到 0.1%，偏振测量是光子稀缺型科学；在光谱偏振测量中，每个光谱 bin 需收集超过一百万光子，因此典型目标需要大口径望远镜。**未来巨型分段镜望远镜（GSMTs）建成后，其聚光能力将开启天文偏振测量的新时代**。
summary: The photons we collect from astronomical sources are encoded with information about the physics behind their origin. To fully probe that physics, we must maximize the information we extract from those photons. At optical and near-infrared wavelengths, this is typically done with the use of filters or a disperser to extract flux as a function of color. An often disregarded piece of information that is also carried by those photons is the polarization state. Astronomical polarimetry is capable of revealing details about the source geometry and magnetic fields that are often unresolvable and, therefore, inaccessible by any other means. Polarimetry is typically a photon-starved science because crucial model discriminators are often only revealed when precisions of 0.1% in the degree of polarization are achieved. For spectropolarimetry, this necessitates the collection of over one million photons at each spectral bin, which demands the use of large aperture telescopes for typical objects of interest. The future completion of Giant Segmented Mirror Telescopes (GSMTs) promises the long-awaited light grasp to initiate an unprecedented era of discovery with astronomical polarimetry.

title: Magnetic Properties of Galactic Molecular Clouds
background_knowledge: 分子云是星际介质中冷而致密、以分子氢为主的气体云，也是恒星形成的主要场所。巨分子云（GMCs）的质量、半径、速度弥散与湍流性质常呈现幂律标度关系，其中质量—半径关系 $M \sim R^{s}$ 被称为第三 Larson 关系，经典观测给出 $s \approx 2$，而更近的 CO 巡天在银河系内部和近邻星系中常发现 $2 < s < 3$。理解这些标度关系的物理起源，需要考察分子云是否处于维里平衡：引力、湍流运动、磁场压力以及外部星际介质压力共同决定云的动力学状态。磁场研究中的关键参数是质量磁通比 $\lambda$，即实际质量磁通比与临界值之比；$\lambda < 1$ 为磁亚临界，磁场足以支撑云体，$\lambda \gtrsim 1$ 为临界或超临界，重力更容易主导坍缩。观测上常用 CO 分子谱线巡天测量云的质量与半径，用尘埃偏振、Zeeman 效应和 DCF 方法估计磁场，并结合 MHD 模拟研究恒星形成效率（SFE）。该领域的核心问题之一是：大尺度分子云为何恒星形成效率很低，而致密云核又如何最终发生引力坍缩。
contribution: 论文将磁亚临界维里平衡方程拟合到约 1500 个 CO 分子云的 $M$-$R$ 趋势，拟合相关系数为 $0.8$–$1$。结果显示，在内银河系中位质量磁通比 $\lambda \approx 0.7$、总磁场强度 $B_{\mathrm{tot}} \approx 60\,\mathrm{\mu G}$、外部压力 $P_{\mathrm{e}}/k \approx 5\times10^{5}\,\mathrm{cm}^{-3}\,\mathrm{K}$，而 M33 与 M31 中的相应数值较低。对 18 个银河系“bones”在假定合理 $P_{\mathrm{e}}$ 下的维里平衡分析同样给出亚临界 $\lambda$，与偏振观测结果一致。**这些结果表明许多巨分子云（GMCs）符合压力束缚的磁亚临界维里平衡**。若如此，**其相对较强的磁场会使纤维状结构、团块和云核形成缓慢，而反馈与湍流又快速将其驱散，从而造成低恒星形成效率（SFE）**；同时，Zeeman 与 DCF 观测以及 MHD 模拟表明其团块和云核中的磁场可能弱到允许恒星形成坍缩，模拟预测 **SFE $\approx 0.5$–$2\%$**。
summary: The earliest studies of molecular clouds (MCs) showed scaling relations between mass and radius M$\sim$R^s with exponent s $\approx$ 2, known as the third Larson relation. More recent CO surveys indicate 2 < s < 3 in the inner Milky Way (MW) and nearby galaxies. These observations appear consistent with the virial equilibrium (VE) of magnetically subcritical clouds, bound by the pressure Pe of the midplane ISM. The VE equations for such clouds are consistent with 2 < s < 3 for magnetically subcritical clouds, but not for magnetically critical, supercritical, or nonmagnetic clouds. We fit the subcritical VE equations to M-R trends observed in CO surveys of $\sim$1500 clouds, with correlation coefficients 0.8 - 1. The fits indicate median mass-to-flux ratio lambda $\approx$ 0.7, magnetic field strength Btot $\approx$ 60$\mathrm{μG}$, and Pe/k $\approx$ 5 x 10^5 cm^-3 K in the inner MW, with lesser values in M33 and M31. For 18 MW "bones," VE analysis assuming likely values of Pe also indicates subcritical values of lambda, as found from polarization observations. These results indicate that many giant molecular clouds (GMCs) are consistent with pressure-bound magnetically subcritical virial equilibrium. If so, GMCs may have low star formation efficiency (SFE) because their relatively strong fields cause filaments, clumps and cores to form slowly, while feedback and turbulence disperse them rapidly. The fields in their clumps and cores are likely weak enough to allow star-forming collapse, according to Zeeman and DCF observations, and according to MHD simulations which predict SFE $\approx$ 0.5-2%.

title: The formation and evolution of Wolf-Rayet stars with temperature-dependent winds
background_knowledge: 大质量恒星（初始质量约 $M_\star \gtrsim 8\,M_\odot$）通过辐射压驱动的星风、核心坍缩超新星和电离辐射强烈影响周围环境，而其自身演化又高度依赖星风造成的质量损失。Wolf-Rayet（WR）星是演化晚期、星风强且光学厚的热星，其星风质量损失率是恒星演化模型中的关键不确定因素之一。经典 WR 星风通常被认为由铁族元素不透明度峰（铁不透明度 bump）驱动，但风启动区域的不透明度、温度与密度结构会改变质量损失率。近期基于流体动力学一致大气计算的工作表明，WR 星风质量损失率可能强烈依赖风启动区域的温度。金属丰度会改变不透明度与星风强度，因此 Milky Way、Large Magellanic Cloud（LMC）和 Small Magellanic Cloud（SMC）等不同金属丰度环境是检验星风处方与恒星演化模型的重要实验室。观测到的 WR 星温度分布、数量及二元系统中的演化，也可用于约束这些物理过程。
contribution: 本文将最新理论 WR 星风处方纳入单星与双星演化模型，覆盖 Milky Way、LMC 和 SMC 金属丰度，系统考察温度依赖的 WR 星风对恒星演化的影响。研究发现，WR 星风的温度依赖可显著改变接近 WR 形成阈值附近恒星的演化。特别是，当模型从富氢 WNL 星风处方过渡到由热铁不透明度峰驱动的经典 WR 星风时，部分 SMC 金属丰度模型会在 $T \approx 70\text{--}90\ \mathrm{kK}$ 的温度区间停留较长时间。这使模型在温度分布上集中于大多数观测到的 SMC WR 星所在区间，而这一特征此前难以用恒星演化模型解释。**结果表明，采用具有物理动机且依赖温度的 WR 星风处方，能够改善恒星演化模型与观测 WR 星族之间的符合程度。**
summary: Massive stars strongly influence their environments through their radiation, stellar winds and core-collapse supernovae, while their own evolution is strongly shaped by wind mass loss. Wolf-Rayet (WR) stars are characterised by strong, optically thick winds, and the implementation of these winds remains an important uncertainty in stellar evolution models. Recent hydrodynamically consistent atmosphere calculations predict WR mass-loss rates that depend strongly on the temperature at the wind-launching region. We investigate the effects of incorporating these latest theoretical WR wind prescriptions into single and binary stellar evolution models at Milky Way, Large Magellanic Cloud and Small Magellanic Cloud (SMC) metallicities. We find that the temperature dependence of the WR wind can significantly alter the evolution of stars near the threshold for WR formation. In particular, an implementation that transitions from a hydrogen rich WNL wind prescription to a classical WR wind driven by the hot iron opacity bump causes some SMC-metallicity models to spend an extended period at temperatures of approximately 70 to 90 kK. This produces a concentration of models in the temperature range occupied by most observed SMC WR stars, a feature that has previously been difficult to explain with stellar evolution models. Our results demonstrate that incorporating physically motivated, temperature dependent WR winds can improve the agreement between stellar evolution models and observed WR populations.

title: Gravitational-Wave Microlensing as a Probe of Compact Object Population
background_knowledge: 引力透镜是背景源发出的光或引力波经过前景质量分布时，因时空弯曲发生偏折、聚焦或延迟的效应。按像的分离程度和质量尺度，可分为强透镜、弱透镜和微引力透镜：强透镜产生多重像或爱因斯坦环，弱透镜造成微弱形状剪切，微透镜的像通常无法分辨，表现为源亮度随时间变化或携带透镜印记的波形。对电磁辐射，微透镜长期用于搜寻恒星质量致密天体；对引力波，当引力波波长与透镜的引力半径可比时，波光学效应（衍射、干涉和频率依赖的调制）会出现在波形中，使 LIGO/Virgo 等地面探测器对恒星级至中等质量致密天体，特别是原初黑洞和暗物质子晕等弱电磁辐射族群敏感。该领域的核心研究范式是把单次透镜事件的波形畸变、到达时间差、放大率等观测量与透镜质量、横向速度、位置等参数联系，再通过事件群体统计反演透镜质量函数、空间数密度和暗物质在致密天体中的占比；这需要层次贝叶斯推断、选择效应建模，并处理透镜参数与源参数、宇宙学参数之间的简并。
contribution: 论文构建了一个层次贝叶斯框架，从一组微引力透镜化的引力波事件中联合推断微透镜的总体性质，约束幂律透镜质量函数的斜率 $\alpha_{\rm ML}$ 、透镜数密度 $n_0$ 以及致密透镜占暗物质的比例 $f_{\rm DM}$ 。作者基于现实的双黑洞族群产生模拟微引力透镜引力波信号并检验该方法，发现**约 100 个可探测的微引力透镜事件即可同时约束 $\alpha_{\rm ML}$ 和 $n_0$ ，但二者之间仍存在简并**。对于低质量端主导、 $\alpha_{\rm ML}=2$ 且 $n_0=10^6\,\mathrm{Mpc}^{-3}$ 的透镜族群，O4 灵敏度下三年观测预计给出约 130 个可探测微引力透镜事件，并能恢复注入的暗物质比例，** $f_{\rm DM}\simeq 1.2 \times 10^{-4}$ ，其 90% 可信区间为 $7.3 \times 10^{-5} \lesssim f_{\rm DM} \lesssim 1.8 \times 10^{-4}$ **。该工作表明引力波微引力透镜可作为探测弱辐射致密天体族群、并服务于天体物理与宇宙学推断的互补探针。
summary: The abundance of compact objects ranging from stellar to intermediate masses ($\sim 1 - 10^{5}M_{\odot}$) remains poorly constrained, particularly for populations such as primordial black holes and dark matter subhalos that emit little or no electromagnetic radiation. Gravitational-wave (GW) microlensing provides a complementary way to probe these populations through wave-optics effects imprinted on the GW signals, with implications for astrophysical and cosmological inference. We develop a hierarchical Bayesian framework to infer the population properties of microlenses from an ensemble of microlensed GW events, constraining the slope of the power-law lens mass function ($α_{\rm ML}$), the lens number density ($n_0$), and the fraction of dark matter in compact lenses ($f_{\rm DM}$). Using simulated microlensed GW signals drawn from a realistic binary black hole population, we find that $\sim 100$ detected microlensed events are able to constrain both $α_{\rm ML}$ and $n_0$, although a degeneracy between the two remains. For a low-mass-dominated lens population ($α_{\rm ML}=2$) with $n_0=10^6~\mathrm{Mpc}^{-3}$, a three-year observation at the O4 sensitivity yields $\sim 130$ detectable microlensed events and recovers the injected dark-matter fraction, $f_{\rm DM}\simeq 1.2 \times 10^{-4}$, with a 90% credible interval of $7.3 \times 10^{-5} \lesssim f_{\rm DM} \lesssim 1.8 \times 10^{-4}$.

title: An obstruction to cosmic acceleration from shift-symmetric dark sector interactions
background_knowledge: 宇宙学观测表明，当前宇宙约 95% 的能量密度由暗物质和暗能量构成。暗能量驱动晚期宇宙加速膨胀，其最简模型是宇宙学常数；暗物质则通过引力塑造大尺度结构。标准 ΛCDM 模型假设二者仅通过引力相互作用，但理论上有理由考虑暗扇区内部存在非引力相互作用。研究此类模型通常借助有效场论：把暗物质、暗能量视为具有特定对称性和状态方程 $w = p/\rho$ 的宇宙学介质，写出低能自由度对应的作用量，计算背景演化与宇宙学扰动，并要求理论无 ghost、无梯度不稳定性、声速平方非负且满足其他稳定性条件。移位对称性（shift symmetry）使相互作用以导数形式出现，同时保留守恒流，是超流体和一类暗能量模型的自然语言；超流体可由具有移位对称性的标量凝聚描述，其低能激发为声子。判断一个暗扇区模型能否产生可行的宇宙加速，需要同时考察背景慢滚条件和扰动稳定性，这也是模型构造与观测检验之间的核心桥梁。
contribution: 论文基于宇宙学介质有效场论，研究暗扇区中完美流体与超流体之间的移位对称导数相互作用。作者证明，这类相互作用无法在保持无不稳定性的同时支持 slow-roll 宇宙加速。进一步将暗扇区介质分解为有效暗物质与暗能量分量后，作者发现稳定性条件排除从 phantom 区（$w < -1$）到非 phantom 区（$w > -1$）的穿越。**因此，稳定性要求会对暗扇区相互作用的宇宙学动力学施加根本限制，并为构造理论可行的暗扇区模型提供了明确路径。**
summary: Using the effective field theory of cosmological media, we show that derivative interactions in the dark sector between a perfect fluid and a superfluid cannot support slow-roll expansion while remaining free from instabilities. Furthermore, decomposing the dark sector medium into effective dark matter and dark energy components, we find that the stability conditions exclude a phantom-to-non-phantom crossing. Our approach gives a clear route for constructing theoretically viable dark sector models, and highlights the fundamental constraints that stability requirements impose on their cosmological dynamics.

title: Understanding galaxies and the origin of the golden mass through the study of scaling relations across cosmic history
background_knowledge: 星系形成与演化研究关注暗物质晕中的重子物质如何凝聚、冷却并形成恒星，以及恒星反馈、活动星系核反馈、并合和吸积等过程如何调节这一过程。观测上常利用恒星质量、恒星形成率、金属丰度、形态、运动学、恒星族群梯度、暗物质比例和总质量密度斜率等标度关系来检验宇宙学模拟。一个核心图像是：星系恒星形成效率并非随质量单调变化，而是在约 $10^{10}$ 到 $10^{11} M_{\odot}$ 的区间达到峰值；低质量端受强反馈抑制，高质量端则受暗物质晕引力加热、气体耗竭和 AGN 反馈等影响。该特征质量被称为 golden mass，是连接暗物质势阱、重子循环与反馈物理的关键尺度。高红移观测可提供宇宙时间基线，约束质量组装与气体转化为恒星效率的演化。
contribution: 论文聚焦于星系总质量分布如何通过气体供给、反馈和暗物质势阱影响恒星形成，并系统讨论特征恒星质量“golden mass”在宇宙历史中的起源。摘要指出，恒星形成效率在 $5 \times 10^{10} M_{\odot}$ 处达到峰值；恒星族群梯度、暗物质比例和总质量密度斜率与恒星质量的关系也在该质量附近出现显著极小值。作者提出利用 ELT 上的 SHARP 的高分辨率、多目标复用和宽视场优势，特别是 mIFU 模式，对 $z > 1.5$ 星系开展空间分辨的恒星族群与动力学制图，精确测量上述标度关系，从而追踪 **golden mass 在不同宇宙时期如何出现和演化**，并通过与宇宙学模拟比较，解码 **并合、超新星反馈和 AGN 反馈等过程对星系质量组装和恒星形成效率的影响**。SHARP 预期将提供比 JWST 更锐利、更深的数据，填补早期宇宙星系质量组装形成阶段的关键观测空白。
summary: The total mass distribution in galaxies strongly influences star formation (SF), both directly via gas availability and feedback, and indirectly via the dark matter (DM) potential well. Star formation efficiency peaks at a characteristic stellar mass of $5 \times 10^{10} M_{\odot}$, often termed the "golden mass", where feedback mechanisms minimally affect SF. This scale also appears in other scaling relations: correlations between stellar population gradients, DM fraction, and total mass density slope versus stellar mass all show pronounced minima at the golden mass. How, why, and when does this golden mass emerge during galaxy evolution? Early cosmic epochs ($z > 1.5$) remain largely unexplored, yet they probe the formative stages of galaxy mass assembly. They provide the full redshift baseline needed to constrain the buildup of stellar mass and the efficiency of gas-to-star conversion. By combining high resolution, multiplexing, and a wide field of view, SHARP on the ELT will address these questions, delivering sharper and deeper data than JWST. In this SHARP White Paper contribution, we present a scientific case exploiting these unique characteristics. SHARP will enable precise measurements of stellar population gradients, DM fractions, and total mass density slopes. Using the mIFU mode, SHARP will obtain spatially-resolved stellar population and dynamical maps for galaxies at $z > 1.5$. Reconstructing these observables for early- and late-type systems will allow us to trace the emergence of the golden mass across cosmic time, and to decode the impact of galaxy processes (mergers, SN, and AGN feedback) by comparing observations with cosmological simulations. (abridged)

title: Euclid: Survey mask effects on clustering of galaxy clusters
background_knowledge: 星系团是宇宙中最大的引力束缚结构之一，其数密度和空间分布对宇宙膨胀历史、结构增长以及暗物质、暗能量的性质高度敏感。在 Stage-IV 巡天时代，宽天区星系团样本使星系团成团性（cluster clustering）成为重要的宇宙学探针：通常通过两点相关函数 $\xi(\theta)$ 或其傅里叶对应量测量星系团的空间聚集程度，并用协方差描述统计误差与样本之间的相关性。实际观测天区并不规则，也不均匀：巡天 mask 会造成不规则的观测足迹，选择函数随天区变化会造成非均匀覆盖；这些效应会影响随机样本的生成、相关函数估计和协方差。因此，在利用 Euclid 等巡天开展星系团宇宙学之前，需要校准 mask 与选择函数带来的系统误差，并评估它们对成团性测量及协方差建模的影响。
contribution: 本文面向 Euclid 首次数据发布（DR1），使用类 DR1 的 lightcone mock 评估巡天 mask 与非均匀天区覆盖对星系团两点相关函数及其协方差的影响。作者确认：当随机星表采用与数据相同的 mask 时，不规则观测足迹不会对两点相关函数产生明显改变；把选择函数随天区的变化实现为空间非均匀性后，在变化幅度远高于 DR1 预期的情况下，成团性振幅也**没有显著偏差**。当非均匀程度增大到效应显著的区域时，其影响幅度主要与选择函数在不同天区之间的**最大变化量**有关，而与这类天区的数目关系较弱。作者进一步发现，不规则 mask 几何与非均匀天区覆盖都会**增大成团性协方差**，并产生小的、近似不随尺度变化的偏移；这些偏移可以由协方差模型中的 nuisance 参数吸收。上述结果为 DR1 中 mask 系统误差的处理提供了依据，也为未来 Euclid 星系团宇宙学所需的方法改进提供了参考。
summary: Wide-area cluster catalogues from Stage-IV surveys will substantially improve the precision of cluster clustering measurements, making the control of observational systematic effects essential for cosmological inference. In preparation for the first Euclid data release (DR1), we assess the impact of the survey mask and non-homogeneous sky coverage on the two-point correlation function of galaxy clusters and its covariance. Using DR1-like lightcone mocks, we confirm that the irregular footprint does not introduce appreciable changes in the two-point correlation function when the same mask is applied to the random catalogue. We also find that spatial inhomogeneities, implemented as variations of the cluster selection function in different patches of the sky, do not significantly bias the clustering amplitude, up to levels of variation well above those expected for DR1. When the degree of inhomogeneity is increased to the regime where the effect becomes significant, we show that its amplitude is related to the maximum variation of the selection function among different regions, rather than to the number of such regions. We further find that irregular mask geometry and non-uniform sky coverage both increase the clustering covariance, introducing small, nearly scale-independent offsets that can be captured by nuisance parameters in the covariance model. Our results consolidate the treatment of mask systematic errors for DR1 and inform the methodological refinements required for future \Euclid cluster cosmology.

title: The impact of Population III stars on the elemental enrichment of ultra-faint galaxies in the FIRE-3 zoom-in simulations
background_knowledge: 超暗弱矮星系（ultra-faint dwarf galaxies, UFDs）是 Local Group 中恒星质量最低、金属丰度最低的一类星系，被视为研究早期宇宙化学增丰、第一代恒星和低质量星系反馈的“化石”。观测上的恒星质量—金属丰度关系（stellar mass-metallicity relation, MZR）在超暗弱端对理论模型构成约束：低质量星系如何保留金属、恒星形成历史是否延展、以及不同超新星通道的贡献，都会影响其 $z=0$ 的化学丰度。基础物理图像是：Population III 恒星作为最早星族，可能具有偏大质量的初始质量函数（IMF），通过 core-collapse 超新星迅速注入 α 元素和部分铁；随后正常星族与延迟的 Type Ia 超新星继续增丰铁。恒星反馈（超新星能量、辐射、星风等）会驱动气体外流、改变恒星形成历史并影响金属在星系内的分布。宇宙学 zoom-in 流体模拟在暗物质晕中重采样目标星系，并用 sub-grid 模型处理 IMF、超新星、星风与金属扩散；FIRE-3 是其中一套广泛使用的星系形成反馈模型。超暗弱星系对 Pop III 模型的转变金属丰度、IMF、反馈强度及 Type Ia 延迟极为敏感。
contribution: 作者构建了一组 FIRE-3 宇宙学重子 zoom-in 模拟，覆盖孤立超暗弱星系（积分到 $z=0$，最高重子分辨率约 $30\,M_\odot$、$0.1\,\mathrm{pc}$）与 LMC 质量环境（最高重子分辨率约 $110\,M_\odot$、$0.5\,\mathrm{pc}$），并对 Population III 恒星采用不同的 sub-grid 模型。其 Pop. III 模型规定：在低于临界金属丰度 $Z_{\mathrm{crit}}$ 时形成的星粒子采用仅含 $8$–$100\,M_\odot$ 大质量恒星的 IMF。论文考察不同恒星反馈过程如何影响超暗弱星系的恒星形成历史（SFHs）与元素丰度。主要结果是：**Pop. III 模型变体在 $z=0$ 的超暗弱星系中引入有效金属丰度地板**，约为 $Z_{\mathrm{floor}} \sim 10^{-5}\,Z_\odot$ 至 $10^{-3}\,Z_\odot$，对应 $[\mathrm{Fe}/\mathrm{H}]_{\mathrm{floor}} \sim -7$ 至 $-5$，具体取决于模型；**但仅引入 Pop. III 模型并不能系统性保证所有（甚至多数）超暗弱星系增丰到 $[\mathrm{Fe}/\mathrm{H}] \sim -2.5$ 以完全解决与观测 MZR 的张力**，尽管模拟中有部分星系达到该水平。关键在于，那些能增丰到该观测水平的超暗弱星系具有 Pop. III 增丰之后延展的恒星形成历史，并经历来自白矮星（Type Ia）超新星的显著铁增丰，**说明单靠 Pop. III 恒星不足以完成所需的铁增丰**。作者还分析了早期 Pop. III 反馈对金属丰度分布与 $[\mathrm{Mg}/\mathrm{Fe}]$ 丰度比的影响，并给出了模拟对恒星质量与 $[\mathrm{Mg}/\mathrm{H}]$ 之间关系的预测。
summary: The observed stellar mass-metallicity relation for ultra-faint galaxies in the Local Group (LG) is in tension with many theoretical predictions, suggesting the need for modified or additional channels of elemental enrichment at low metallicities. We present a suite of FIRE-3 cosmological baryonic zoom-in simulations of isolated ultra-faint galaxies run to z=0 (maximum baryonic resolution ~ 30 Msun, 0.1 pc) and LMC-mass environments (maximum baryonic resolution ~ 110 Msun, 0.5 pc), with different sub-grid models for Population III stars. Under our Pop. III model(s), star particles forming below a critical metallicity Z_crit represent an initial mass function (IMF) consisting of only massive stars (8-100 Msun). We examine how various stellar feedback processes impact the star formation histories (SFHs) and elemental abundances of ultra-faint galaxies. We find that our Pop. III model variants introduce an effective metallicity floor in ultra-faints at z=0, at Z_floor ~ 1e-5 Zsun to 1e-3 Zsun or [Fe/H]_floor ~ -7 to -5 depending on the model. However, simply including the Pop. III model does not systematically guarantee that all (or even most) ultra-faints enrich up to [Fe/H] ~ -2.5 to fully resolve the tension with the observed mass-metallicity relation, even though we obtain some galaxies at that level. Crucially, the ultra-faints that do enrich in [Fe/H] to this level observed in the LG have extended SFHs after Pop. III enrichment and significant iron enrichment from white dwarf (Type Ia) supernovae, indicating that iron enrichment from Pop. III alone is not sufficient. We also examine the ways in which early-time Pop. III feedback impacts the metallicity distributions and [Mg/Fe] abundance ratios in ultra-faint galaxies, and make a prediction for the stellar mass - [Mg/H] metallicity relation from our simulations.

title: Identifying Compact Object Candidates using Gaia DR3 Astrometric Accelerations and Jerks
background_knowledge: Gaia 是欧空局的全天天体测量卫星，核心科学产品之一是对银河系内十多亿颗恒星反复测量天球位置、视差与自行。对单颗恒星，标准五参数解描述其在天空中的匀速直线运动；若恒星存在未分辨的伴星，其质心会因引力作用产生天球投影上的加速度甚至加加速度，于是 Gaia 的非单星解可能采用七参数常加速度模型（额外拟合 $\dot{\boldsymbol{\mu}}$）或九参数变加速度模型（额外拟合 $\ddot{\boldsymbol{\mu}}$）。在双星系统中，若可见恒星绕一个不发光的大质量致密伴星运动，可见星的加速度与加加速度就编码了伴星质量、轨道周期和轨道几何的信息；这与分光双星中的视向速度方法、天体测量质量函数以及微引力透镜、X 射线双星和引力波探测相互补充。恒星质量黑洞尤其难以发现：大多数在沉默状态下不辐射显著 X 射线，只能通过可见伴星的运动或光谱间接推断。当前研究范式是把 Gaia 的大样本天体测量解与恒星参数、视向速度、测光和种群合成结合，先筛选“非单星”候选，再用轨道模型、质量函数或贝叶斯推断估计伴星性质，并通过模拟观测评估选择函数和假阳性。九参数解往往只能覆盖完整轨道的一小段，因此加速度与 jerk 的联合特征、拟合简并和观测偏差是该方法的关键。
contribution: 此前对致密伴星的 Gaia 搜索多依赖有完整轨道解的天体测量质量函数，而对七参数常加速度解与九参数变加速度解的挖掘相对不足。本文系统发展了从 Gaia DR3 九参数非单星天体测量解中筛选“可能拥有大质量致密伴星”的源的方法。作者假设观测源是双星中绕暗天体运行的发光恒星，并分别针对倾斜偏心轨道、面朝偏心轨道和面朝圆轨道三类双星种群，推导了天球投影加速度与加加速度的解析表达式；随后利用 POSYDON 构建了更现实的、由发光恒星和黑洞组成的双星种群。对每个种群，作者用 gaiamock 模拟 Gaia 观测并只保留可被九参数解拟合的系统，从而显式处理观测偏差。核心结果是：**具有大质量致密伴星的候选体可由发光星表现出的特征性加速度—加加速度联合分布来识别，即使九参数拟合远不足以完全约束完整轨道**。最后，作者分析了历史关注对象 HD 12871，并考察了类似 Gaia BH3 的双星的九参数拟合，以展示该筛选方法的用途。
summary: Gaia Data Release 3 (DR3) provides astrometric measurements for more than a billion sources, hundreds of thousands of which have non-single-star astrometric solutions that indicate deviations from linear proper motion. Although sources with orbital solutions have been extensively inspected for compact objects via the astrometric mass function, two other solution types--the 7-parameter constant-acceleration solutions characterized by $\dot{\mathbfμ}$, and the 9-parameter variable-acceleration solutions characterized by $\dot{\mathbfμ}$ and $\ddot{\mathbfμ}$--have not been as carefully explored. In this work, we develop a methodology for selecting sources within the Gaia DR3 9-parameter non-single-star astrometric solutions that are most likely to host massive compact companions. We assume that a source is the luminous star in a binary orbit around a dark object and derive analytic expressions for the sky-projected accelerations and jerks for three binary populations with different orbit approximations: inclined eccentric, face-on eccentric, and face-on circular. Using POSYDON, we develop a fourth, more realistic population of binaries, each consisting of a luminous star and a black hole. For each population, we address observational biases using gaiamock and select only the systems it fits with a 9-parameter solution. We find that binaries likely to host massive compact companions can be identified from the characteristic joint astrometric accelerations and jerks exhibited by the luminous stars, despite 9-parameter fits under-constraining full orbits. Finally, to illustrate the utility of our approach, we analyze a historical object of interest, HD 12871, and examine 9-parameter fits of Gaia BH3-like binaries.

title: The M87 Black Hole Mass from JWST and Keck Stellar Kinematics Spanning 10 pc to 10 kpc
background_knowledge: M87 是邻近巨椭圆星系，其中心超大质量黑洞是 EHT 首次成像黑洞阴影的目标。测量黑洞质量的核心思路是把恒星或气体作为引力势中的示踪物：通过积分视场光谱获得视向速度分布，进而拟合速度弥散、高阶 Gauss-Hermite 矩（如 $h_4$）以及二维运动学场。若观测能深入黑洞影响球半径以内，恒星运动才会对中心点质量敏感；三轴 Schwarzschild 轨道建模可在给定引力势中构建大量轨道并拟合 LOSVD，但结果受距离、PSF、模板失配、倾角与暗物质/恒星质量比等系统误差影响。EHT 阴影给出的引力半径尺度为 $\theta_g = GM_{\mathrm{BH}}/(c^2 D)$，与恒星动力学质量限制可相互校验并作为独立先验。
contribution: 论文联合 JWST NIRSpec 与 Keck KCWI，构建 M87 从约 10 pc 到约 10 kpc、跨三个数量级投影半径的连续二维恒星运动学图，并据此测量中心超大质量黑洞质量。最内层运动学探测到黑洞影响球半径约 3% 的投影半径，约 30,000 个 Schwarzschild 半径。针对 $R < 0.45''$ 的 NIRSpec 光谱中准周期「wiggle」伪影，作者开发 `hyphen`，利用探测器光谱轨迹预测 wiggle 频率随波长的变化，并在合并数据前逐曝光、逐光谱拟合并扣除该模式。清洗后的光谱显示中心恒星速度弥散与 $h_4$ 显著上升。使用 TriOS 进行三轴 Schwarzschild 恒星轨道建模，拟合 JWST 与 Keck 在 618 个空间 bin 中约 5,000 个运动学约束，得到 **$M_{\mathrm{BH}} = (5.38 \pm 0.13 \pm 0.22) \times 10^9\,M_\odot$**。该结果与此前仅用 KCWI 的测定一致，但统计不确定度缩小 2–3 倍，目前已小于 M87 距离 $D$ 的系统误差。由此得到的质距比 **$\theta_g = GM_{\mathrm{BH}}/(c^2 D) = 3.16 \pm 0.08\,\mu$as** 的 90% 可信区间与多历元 EHT 分析重叠，为未来 EHT 研究提供了稳健且独立的先验。
summary: We combine JWST NIRSpec and Keck KCWI observations to construct a contiguous 2D map of M87's stellar kinematics spanning three decades in projected radius, from ${\sim}10$ pc to ${\sim}10$ kpc, and measure the mass of its central supermassive black hole. The innermost stellar kinematic measurements probe projected radii as small as ${\sim}3$% of the black hole's sphere of influence radius, or approximately 30,000 Schwarzschild radii. The NIRSpec spectra within $R < 0.45''$ are contaminated by quasiperiodic "wiggle" artifacts. We develop hyphen, which uses detector spectral traces to predict how the wiggle frequency varies with wavelength, then fits and subtracts the wiggle pattern from each spectrum in each exposure before combining the data. The cleaned spectra reveal a pronounced central rise in stellar velocity dispersion and $h_4$. Triaxial Schwarzschild stellar orbit modeling with the TriOS code, fitting ${\sim}$5,000 kinematic constraints across 618 spatial bins from JWST and Keck, yields a black hole mass of $M_{\mathrm{BH}}=(5.38 \pm 0.13\pm 0.22)\times10^9\,M_\odot$. This result is consistent with our prior KCWI-only determination but with the statistical uncertainty reduced by a factor of 2-3, now subdominant to the systematic uncertainty in the distance ($D$) to M87. Our inferred mass-to-distance ratio is $θ_g=GM_{\mathrm{BH}}/(c^2 D) = 3.16 \pm 0.08\, μ$as, whose 90% credible interval overlaps with that obtained from the multi-epoch Event Horizon Telescope (EHT) analysis, providing a robust and independent prior for future EHT studies.

title: Searching for Signatures of i-process Nucleosynthesis in Metal-Rich, Lead-rich Barium Stars
background_knowledge:
中子俘获过程是解释铁峰以上元素来源的核心框架：$s$-process（慢中子俘获过程）的中子密度较低，主要发生在渐近巨星支（AGB）星的热脉冲与第三挖掘阶段，并通过星风或双星质量转移在伴星表面留下 Ba、La、Pb 等元素丰度异常；$r$-process（快中子俘获过程）需要高中子密度，通常关联中子星并合或核心坍缩超新星等极端环境，是 Eu 等元素的重要来源。$i$-process（中间中子俘获过程）位于二者之间，可能出现在质子摄入 AGB 或特殊热核燃烧环境中，可同时产生类似 $s$ 与 $r$ 过程的元素组合。
\n经典钡星通常是双星系统，其重元素丰度异常来自曾经历 AGB 阶段的伴星物质转移；铅星则以 Pb 的显著超丰为特征。碳增强金属贫星（CEMP）中有一类同时富集 $s$ 与 $r$ 过程元素，曾被用来提出 $i$-process。观测检验依赖高分辨率光谱得到从轻到重元素的 $[X/\mathrm{Fe}]$ 丰度、碳同位素比与镁同位素比，并与 AGB 核合成模型网格比较；难点在于 $s$-process 与 $i$-process 的产物有时相似，且原子扩散、双星相互作用和金属丰度效应会混淆判读。
\n银河系盘星的化学丰度是反演核合成来源的重要探针。传统上，Ba、Pb 等被视为 $s$ 过程示踪，Eu 被视为 $r$ 过程示踪；若金属丰度较高（近太阳）的恒星出现无法由标准 $s$ 过程解释的 Ba、Pb、Eu 组合，就可能提示额外核合成通道。该方向结合 GALAH 等大规模光谱巡天筛选、高分辨率随访光谱、恒星参数与化学丰度分析，以及 AGB 模型，研究不同质量与金属丰度恒星对银河系化学演化的贡献。
contribution:
论文分析 GALAH 巡天中筛选出的 6 颗极端富 Ba 且富 Eu（或 Sm）的恒星，其 Ba 与 Eu（或 Sm）丰度较太阳高约 10 倍以上，金属丰度范围为 $-0.7<[\mathrm{Fe}/\mathrm{H}]<-0.1$；使用 Gemini/GHOST 与 McDonald/Tull 高分辨率光谱，并重新分析文献中两颗 $i$-process 候选星的存档光谱。作者测定最多 42 种元素（从 Li 到 Pb）的丰度、$^{12}\mathrm{C}/^{13}\mathrm{C}$ 与 Mg 同位素比，系统比较文献钡星、CEMP 星以及多组 AGB 模型网格。
\n结果发现 3 颗星具有极端 Pb 超丰，$[\mathrm{Pb}/\mathrm{Fe}]=+1.79\pm0.19$ 至 $+2.50\pm0.32\,\mathrm{dex}$；2 颗星具有极端 Eu 超丰，$[\mathrm{Eu}/\mathrm{Fe}]=+1.10\pm0.11$ 至 $+1.30\pm0.11\,\mathrm{dex}$，明显区别于典型富金属钡星。**其中 3 颗 Pb 超丰星里的 2 颗，其丰度模式无法由 $s$-process 模型解释，而与现有 $i$-process 预言最吻合**。其余样本可由 $s$-process 富集解释，或提示原子扩散影响。文献中的两颗候选星均能被 $i$-process 模型较好拟合，但仍不能排除常规 $s$-process 富集。
\n作者强调，**金属丰度较高的 AGB 星可能对传统上归于 $r$-process 的元素产生有不可忽视的贡献**，并给出近太阳金属丰度下很有希望的 $i$-process 富集候选体；这些结果也**推动更多 $i$-process 模型**，以厘清该核合成过程对银河系盘化学演化的贡献。
summary: The intermediate neutron-capture process ($i$-process) has been invoked to explain the peculiar compositions of carbon-enhanced metal-poor (CEMP) stars enriched in both slow- ($s$) and rapid- ($r$) neutron-capture elements. Recent literature has questioned its operation at higher metallicities, but observational evidence remains limited. We analyse Gemini/GHOST and McDonald/Tull spectra of six $\rm -0.7 < [Fe/H] < -0.1$ stars identified in GALAH by their extreme Ba and Eu (or Sm) compositions ($\gtrsim$10$\times$ solar). We also reanalyse archival spectra of two literature $i$-process candidates. We determine abundances in up to 42 elements (Li through Pb), $^{12}$C/$^{13}$C, and Mg isotopic ratios, and compare to literature barium and CEMP stars and multiple asymptotic giant branch (AGB) model grids. Three stars exhibit extreme [Pb/Fe] (+1.79$\pm$0.19 to +2.50$\pm$0.32 dex), and two extreme [Eu/Fe] (+1.10$\pm$0.11 to +1.30$\pm$0.11 dex), distinguishing them from typical metal-rich barium stars. Two of these three exhibit abundance patterns that are inconsistent with $s$-process models and best explained by existing $i$-process predictions. The remaining sample is either consistent with $s$-process enrichment or suggestive of atomic diffusion. Both literature candidates are well-fit by the $i$-process model, but conventional $s$-process enrichment cannot be excluded. Our findings reinforce that metal-rich AGB stars contribute to the production of elements classically attributed to the $r$-process. These results identify promising candidates for $i$-process enrichment near solar metallicity and motivate additional $i$-process models to understand the contribution of this nucleosynthetic process to the chemical evolution of the Milky Way disk.

title: Investigating the initial conditions of globular clusters via $N$-body simulations: I. half-mass radius and stellar density
background_knowledge: 球状星团（globular clusters, GCs）是银河系晕中年龄古老、恒星密度高的束缚系统，被认为是极端恒星形成模式的产物。其形成可能发生在早期宇宙的高密度、湍动气体云中，初始性质（质量、半径、密度、金属丰度）决定了后续演化。传统研究通过测光、光谱和视向速度获得现今结构、质量函数、化学丰度及多星族（multiple populations, MPs）信息；但星团在数十亿年中经历两体弛豫、恒星演化质量损失、潮汐剥离和轨道加热，现今的延展状态往往不能直接代表诞生状态。研究范式之一是用高精度直接 $N$-body 模拟重现长期动力学演化，并将模拟的恒星数密度分布、半质量半径等与观测匹配，从而反推初始条件，同时结合 Gaia 等高精度天测数据搜寻潮汐外候选成员。
contribution: 作者使用高精度直接 $N$-body 模拟代码 PeTar 对两个低质量外晕球状星团 Eridanus 和 Whiting 1 进行长期动力学演化，并将模拟数密度剖面与观测比较。最佳拟合得到初始半质量半径分别为 $2.0 \pm 1.0\ \mathrm{pc}$（Eridanus）和 $2.5 \pm 0.5\ \mathrm{pc}$（Whiting 1），对应初始表面密度为 $2592.03\ M_\odot\ \mathrm{pc}^{-2}$ 和 $226.35\ M_\odot\ \mathrm{pc}^{-2}$，**比现今值高 2–3 个量级**。Whiting 1 与年轻大质量星团（young massive clusters, YMCs）缺乏多星族，而 Eridanus 存在多星族，这一对比支持**多星族形成需要更高的初始表面密度和/或更低的金属丰度**。作者还以模拟为模板，从 Gaia DR3 和 APOGEE DR17 中识别出 Whiting 1 的 5 个高概率潮汐外候选成员，它们具有一致的运动学和化学丰度。结果表明**低质量球状星团的弥散状态是长期动力学膨胀与潮汐剥离的产物，其原初结构显著更致密**。
summary: Born out of the turbulent, dense gas of the early Universe, globular clusters (GCs) represent a significantly different star-formation mode compared to the local Universe. To quantify the initial cluster conditions, we perform the long-term dynamical evolution of GCs using the high-precision direct N-body simulation code PeTar. As the first step in a series of studies, we investigate the two low-mass outer-halo GCs, Eridanus and Whiting 1. By comparing simulated number density profiles with observations, we derive best-fit initial half-mass radii of $2.0 \pm 1.0$ pc for Eridanus and $2.5 \pm 0.5$ pc for Whiting 1, corresponding to initial surface densities of $2592.03 M_\odot pc^{-2}$ and $226.35 M_\odot pc^{-2}$, respectively -- 2-3 orders of magnitude higher than their present-day values. The absence of multiple populations (MPs) in Whiting 1 and young massive clusters (YMCs), in contrast to the MP-hosting Eridanus, supports the scenario that MP formation requires higher initial surface density and/or lower metallicity. Using the simulations as a template, we identify five high-probability extra-tidal candidates of Whiting 1 from Gaia DR3 and APOGEE DR17, which exhibit coherent kinematics and chemical abundances. Our results demonstrate that the diffuse states of low-mass GCs are the product of long-term dynamical expansion and tidal stripping, and that their primordial configurations were significantly denser.

title: Living near filaments: How environment shapes age profiles in low-mass galaxies
background_knowledge: 在 ΛCDM 宇宙学框架下，星系被认为在暗物质晕中通过气体冷却、坍缩与恒星形成逐步组装。宇宙网由节点（星系团、群）、纤维（filament）、片层与空洞构成，纤维是暗物质与重子物质进入大质量节点的通道，气体沿纤维被吸积到星系晕中，为恒星形成持续供料。低质量星系（恒星质量约 $10^9$–$10^{10}\,M_\odot$）通常具有延展、渐进式的恒星形成历史，其径向恒星年龄剖面多呈“正”梯度：中心偏老、外围偏年轻，反映出由内向外逐步增长的质量组装。环境会显著改变这一图像：卫星星系在晕内会经历冲压剥离、潮汐剥离、热气移除（strangulation）与 harassme-nt 等过程而提早猝灭；中心星系则主要通过晕质量、纤维吸积供给以及是否靠近星系群或纤维来调节自身演化。近年来，积分场光谱（IFS）与深场测光观测在部分低质量星系中发现例外的“U 型”径向年龄剖面：年龄由内向外递减至一个局部极小值后又回升。这种形态暗示星系外围存在相对年老的星族，可能与早期在纤维或群环境中的预处理、气体剥离后再度吸积以及并合事件有关，是理解环境如何塑造低质量星系恒星形成历史的关键线索。宇宙学磁流体动力学模拟（如 IllustrisTNG 系列）包含气体冷却、恒星形成、超新星与 AGN 反馈等子网格物理，并自洽再现宇宙网大尺度结构，因此成为在统计意义上把星系内部结构特征与其所处宇宙网环境联系起来的有效工具。
contribution: 论文基于 IllustrisTNG-50 宇宙磁流体动力学模拟，选取恒星质量为 $10^9\,M_\odot$ 至 $10^{10}\,M_\odot$ 的星系样本，按径向年龄剖面将其分为具有与不具有 U 型特征的两类，并系统刻画其所在环境。作者把 U 型剖面定义为：恒星年龄向局部极小值递减、随后又上升，且极小值两侧相对其取值至少要有 0.4 Gyr 的年龄反差。结果共找到 145 个呈 U 型年龄剖面的星系，约占样本的 $\sim 11\%$；这些星系多为**中心系统（约 72%）**，且**约 82% 位于低质量暗物质晕中（$M_{200} < 10^{12}\,M_\odot$）**。在环境位置上，具有该特征的星系**远离星系群、却靠近宇宙纤维**，到纤维的中位距离约为 $\sim 265$ kpc；不具有 U 型剖面的星系到这类结构的中位距离则更远，约为 $\sim 351$ kpc。这一结果指出，**低质量晕中靠近纤维的中心星系是 U 型年龄剖面的高发群体**，说明宇宙网环境（尤其是纤维的气体供给与星系群之间的过渡区域）在塑造低质量星系径向恒星年龄分布中起重要作用。
summary: U-shaped radial age profiles have recently been reported in low-mass galaxies. This type of profile differs from the usually observed positive radial age gradients of the low-mass regime. We aim to characterise the environment in which low-mass galaxies with U-shaped age profiles are more commonly found. We use the IllustrisTNG-50 hydrodynamical simulations to select a sample of galaxies with stellar masses ranging from $10^9 \, M_\odot$ to $10^{10} \, M_\odot$. Based on their radial age profiles, we classify the sample into galaxies with and without a U-shaped feature. We define a U-shaped profile as one where stellar ages decrease towards a local minimum and subsequently increase, requiring an age contrast of at least 0.4 Gyr on either side of the minimum relative to its value. We find 145 galaxies with U-shaped age profiles ($\sim 11\%$ of the sample). They are mostly central systems ($\sim 72\%$) and $\sim 82\%$ of them reside within low-mass halos ($M_{200} < 10^{12} \, M_\odot$). We also find that galaxies exhibiting this feature are located at large distances from galaxy groups but close to cosmic filaments, with a median distance of $\sim 265$ kpc, whereas those without U-shaped age profiles tend to be located farther away from these structures ($\sim 351$ kpc).

title: Adaptive Optics for the Extremely Large Telescope: overcoming Point Spread Function challenges with MORFEO
background_knowledge: 自适应光学（AO）是地面大型望远镜克服大气湍流、实现衍射极限观测的核心技术。大气湍流使入射波前产生随时间变化的畸变，AO 系统用波前传感器实时测量波前误差，并驱动可变形镜（DM）补偿。传统单共轭 AO 只在窄视场内校正良好；多共轭自适应光学（MCAO）则利用多颗导星同时探测不同方向上的湍流，并通过层析重建，把校正量分配到多个共轭于不同高度的变形镜上，从而在较大视场内获得较均匀的点扩散函数（PSF）。激光导星（LGS）可提供明亮且可部署的人工信标，但通常不能测量整体倾斜，需要自然导星（NGS）辅助；因此天区覆盖率取决于可用 NGS 的数量与亮度。对 ELT 而言，宽场高角分辨率成像、积分视场光谱和多目标光谱都要求稳定、可预测且可重建的 PSF；基于遥测的 PSF 重建对于没有亮参考星时的光度测量、天体测量和光谱提取尤为关键。
contribution: 本文围绕 ELT 的 MORFEO 多共轭自适应光学中继系统，总结其可交付的 MCAO 能力。MORFEO 将望远镜的 M4–M5 自适应镜与两块焦后变形镜结合，**在接近 1′ 的视场内提供稳定、衍射极限的 PSF**；它利用 6 颗钠激光导星和最多 3 颗自然导星在约 160″ 技术视场内进行大气层析探测，**在南银极方向达到约 50% 的天区覆盖率**。MORFEO 通过两个重力不变端口，为 MICADO 首光成像仪与光谱仪提供 51″ 的校正视场，并服务高角分辨率积分视场光谱仪 HARMONI。面向 ELT 的多目标近红外光谱仪概念 SHARP 也以 MORFEO 作为参考 MCAO 架构，用以评估可达图像质量与科学性能。论文进一步总结 MORFEO 的光学质量、层析性能、校正焦面的稳定性以及基于遥测的 PSF 重建精度，并讨论这些能力对 SHARP 及其他 ELT 宽场光谱概念的意义。
summary: MORFEO is the multi-conjugate adaptive optics (MCAO) relay for the Extremely Large Telescope (ELT) of the European Southern Observatory. It combines the adaptive mirrors of the telescope (M4-M5) with two post-focal deformable mirrors to deliver a stable, diffraction-limited point spread function over a field approaching 1'. MORFEO senses the atmosphere using six sodium laser guide stars and up to three natural guide stars distributed across a $\sim$160'' technical field, enabling sky coverage levels of order 50% at the South Galactic Pole. Through its two gravity-invariant ports, MORFEO feeds the MICADO first-light imager and spectrograph with a corrected field of 51''and HARMONI, the high-angular resolution integral field spectrograph. SHARP, a concept for a multi-object near-infrared spectrograph at the ELT, adopts MORFEO as its reference MCAO architecture for evaluating achievable image quality and scientific performance. In this paper, we summarise the MCAO capabilities delivered by MORFEO, its optical quality, tomographic performance, stability of the corrected focal plane, and the accuracy of telemetry-based PSF reconstruction, and discuss their relevance for the development of SHARP and other wide-field spectroscopic concepts at the ELT.

title: Revisiting the Stellar-Dynamical Mass of the Central Black Hole in NGC 3227
background_knowledge: 超大质量黑洞（SMBH）的质量测量是理解黑洞与宿主星系共同演化、以及检验 $M_{\mathrm{BH}}$—星系标度关系（如 $M_{\mathrm{BH}}$—$\sigma$ 关系）的基础。附近星系中的 SMBH 可通过多条独立途径测质：恒星动力学、气体动力学、脉泽盘、混响映射等。恒星动力学方法的核心，是观测星系核区沿视线的恒星速度分布（LOSVD）；它不只给出速度弥散，还包含高阶矩（如 $h_3$、$h_4$），从而反映轨道结构与黑洞引力势。随后，研究者构建动力学模型，拟合二维或三维光谱数据。常用手段包括轴对或三轴动力学模型、轨道叠加（Schwarzschild 方法）以及参数化分布函数模型。建模时需同时处理表面亮度分布、点扩散函数、质量—光度比、暗物质与恒星贡献的简并，以及距离尺度等系统效应。不同测质方法各有假设与偏差来源，因此用同一星系开展多技术交叉比较，对建立统一的黑洞质量标尺十分关键。NGC 3227 是邻近的 Seyfert 星系，其核区相对明亮且空间可分辨，是检验恒星动力学、气体动力学与混响映射等方法的常用目标。
contribution: 作者利用 Gemini 天文台 NIFS 的存档空间分辨 $K$ 波段光谱，测定了 NGC 3227 核区恒星沿视线的速度分布（LOSVD）；并结合 Hubble 空间望远镜 WFC3 F547M 图像，将星系表面亮度分布分解为四个成分。随后，作者使用开源程序 $\texttt{FORSTAND}$ 中的 Schwarzschild 轨道叠加方法构建动力学模型，得到最佳拟合黑洞质量为 **$M_{\mathrm{BH}} = (1.2 \pm 0.5) \times 10^{7}\,M_{\odot}$**。该结果与 R. I. Davies 等人基于轨道建模的恒星动力学质量一致，但由于新分析采用了更高信噪比的数据，能够约束恒星 LOSVD 的高阶矩，因此给出了更精确的 $M_{\mathrm{BH}}$。该结果也与 M. C. Bentz 等人报道的速度分辨混响映射约束一致；与 E. K. S. Hicks 和 M. A. Malkan 的气体动力学质量相比（在统一距离标度后），本文最佳拟合值略小，但两者在 $2\sigma$ 范围内一致。作者强调，不同技术给出的黑洞质量之间的直接比较虽然少见，却对确保所有黑洞质量位于同一标尺、识别并最小化各方法的不确定性与潜在偏差至关重要。
summary: We present a new stellar-dynamical mass for the supermassive black hole in the nearby Seyfert galaxy NGC 3227. We determined the line-of-sight velocity distributions of stars in the nuclear region of NGC 3227 using archival spatially-resolved $K$-band spectra obtained with NIFS at Gemini Observatory. The surface brightness profile of the galaxy is described by four components, measured from a WFC3 F547M image from the Hubble Space Telescope. We constructed dynamical models using the Schwarzschild orbit-superposition method implemented in the open-source code $\texttt{FORSTAND}$. We find a best-fit black hole mass of $M_{\mathrm{BH}}$=$(1.2\pm0.5) \times 10^7$ $M_{\odot}$. This mass is consistent with a previous mass from R. I. Davies et al. based on stellar dynamics using orbit-based modeling, but our results make use of higher signal-to-noise data from which the higher-order moments of the stellar LOSVDs are constrained, thus providing a more precise $M_{\mathrm{BH}}$. Our result is also consistent with the $M_{\mathrm{BH}}$ constraint from velocity-resolved reverberation mapping reported by M. C. Bentz et al.. And while our best-fit mass is slightly smaller than the mass constraint from gas-dynamical modeling reported by E. K. S. Hicks & M. A. Malkan (after scaling to the same adopted distance), they are within 2$σ$ of each other. Direct comparisons of black hole masses from different techniques are rare but crucial to ensure all black hole masses are on the same scale, and to identify and minimize the uncertainties and possible sources of bias associated with each technique.

title: DESI DR2 Results III: The Mass of the Milky Way
background_knowledge: 银河系质量是连接暗物质晕、星系形成与宇宙学的基础物理量。主流研究利用晕族示踪天体（如 RR Lyrae、蓝水平支星等）的三维位置和三维速度（即 6D 相空间），在给定引力势中通过动力学建模反演质量分布；常用手段包括 Jeans 方程、分布函数或轨道建模、逃逸速度与视向速度色散分析等。由于远处晕星稀少、观测选择函数复杂、测量误差显著，且星系可能存在非平衡态（如吸积、潮汐作用、子结构），质量估计易受系统偏差影响，因此需要借助宇宙学模拟生成的 mock 巡天评估方法偏差。Gaia 提供高精度天体测量，DESI 提供光谱与视向速度，两者结合可在约 10–95 kpc 的银晕范围获得大样本 6D 信息。$M_{200c}$ 指相对临界密度 200 倍球内的维里质量，常用于表征星系总质量。
contribution: 论文基于 DESI DR2 选取 10,036 颗 RR Lyrae 与蓝水平支星，覆盖距银心约 10–95 kpc 的晕区，构建目前同类最大样本，并应用四种动力学建模方法测量银河系质量。作者利用包含单颗示踪星、DESI 与 Gaia DR3 式误差以及选择函数的宇宙学 mock 巡天，量化方法假设与星系非平衡态造成的系统偏差；据此修正各方法估计，并在考虑逐方法偏差及方法间残余相关后给出联合约束。得到 **$M(r < 80\,\mathrm{kpc}) = 6.36^{+0.53}_{-0.48}\times 10^{11}\,M_\odot$** 和 **$M_{200c} = 1.19^{+0.14}_{-0.12}\times 10^{12}\,M_\odot$**；仅用 RR Lyrae 或仅用 BHB 的结果类似。该工作为 DESI 及其他光谱巡天可靠约束银河系质量提供了路线图。
summary: We present measurements of the mass of the Milky Way using distant halo stars selected from the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) Data Release 2 (DR2). We apply four dynamical modeling methods to 10,036 RR Lyrae (RRL) and blue horizontal branch (BHB) stars with 6D phase space coordinates that span from $\sim$10 to 95 kpc from the Galactic center, the largest samples of their kind. All methods are applied to mock surveys based on cosmological simulations that include generating individual tracer stars, convolving their phase-space coordinates with DESI and Gaia DR3-like uncertainties, and tailored models of the survey selection functions. By comparing the performance on these mocks, we quantify how systematic biases from both methodology assumptions and galaxy disequilibrium impact each estimate. The mock-based systematics, which differ by method and tracer, are used to correct the individual estimates and to derive joint estimates using a rigorous formalism that accounts for per-method biases and residual correlations between methods. We obtain a joint estimate of the mass within 80 kpc to be $M(r < 80 \mathrm{\,kpc}) = 6.36^{+0.53}_{-0.48} \times 10^{11}$ M$_\odot$ and a virial mass estimate of $M_\mathrm{200c} = 1.19^{+0.14}_{-0.12} \times 10^{12}$ M$_\odot$, with similar results when combining only RRL-based or BHB-based measurements. These results provide a roadmap for future DESI efforts, as well as those in other spectroscopic surveys, to reliably constrain the mass of our Galaxy.

title: How sky subtraction scales affect Intracluster light measurements
background_knowledge:
星系团是宇宙中最大的引力束缚系统，由暗物质晕、成员星系和高温团内气体组成。团内光（intracluster light，ICL）是弥散在星系之间、并不归属于单个星系的恒星辐射，主要来自星系并合与潮汐剥离过程，因而记录星系团的总恒星质量和等级成团历史。ICL 的表面亮度极低，通常远暗于夜空背景，典型量级可低至约 26 至 29 mag arcsec$^{-2}$，其测量属于低表面亮度成像与弥散结构探测的范畴。
\n测量 ICL 的关键步骤是准确扣除天空背景：夜空亮度远高于 ICL 信号，且存在大尺度梯度与时间变化。天空扣除通常通过在大尺度上估计背景来实现；若估计尺度与天体源角尺度相当，就会把一部分源流量误当作天空而扣除，造成流量偏低或系统性偏差。这种尺度耦合对延展性最强的弥散成分尤其危险，并会随星系团质量、红移和巡天深度而变化。
\n星系团的质量常用 $M_{500}$ 表征，即平均密度达到宇宙临界密度 500 倍球体内的质量；红移 $z$ 则决定角直径距离和观测到的角尺度。不同巡天的天空扣除尺度不同，因此需要在 $M_{500}$–$z$ 平面上比较其系统效应。LSST Data Preview 2、Hyper Suprime-Cam Public Data Release 3（HSC-PDR3）及其前代 HSC-PDR2 等深成像数据，为检验这类系统误差提供了实测样本。
contribution: 论文系统评估了 LSST Data Preview 2 与 HSC-PDR3 中所用天空扣除尺度对 ICL 测量的影响，并以 HSC-PDR2 作为对照。作者在 $M_{500}$–$z$ 平面上表明：**LSST Data Preview 2 和 HSC-PDR3 的天空扣除尺度会影响 $M_{500}\gtrsim10^{13.4}\,\mathrm{M}_{\odot}$ 的星系团，且这种影响跨越所有红移；HSC-PDR2 则只对 $z<0.1$ 处质量最大的系统产生过度扣除。** 此外，**完整 LSST 巡天预计采用更大的天空扣除尺度，从而缓解这一偏差。**
summary: Deep imaging surveys are opening a new window on the low surface brightness universe. However, the recovery of diffuse emission depends on the survey depth and how the sky background is treated. Estimating the sky on scales comparable to astrophysical sources risks biasing flux measurements. This effect is particularly significant for intracluster light, the most extended diffuse baryonic component of galaxy clusters. We show in a $M_{500}$--$z$ plane that the sky subtraction scales employed in the Legacy Survey of Space and Time Data Preview 2 and Hyper Suprime-Cam Public Data Release 3 (HSC-PDR3) impact clusters with $M_{500}\gtrsim10^{13.4}\,\mathrm{M_\odot}$ at all redshifts, whereas HSC-PDR2 only oversubtracts the most massive systems at $z < 0.1$. The larger sky subtraction scale anticipated for the full LSST survey will mitigate this bias.

title: From Early Concepts to Lunar Hypertelescopes Roadmap for Next-Generation Optical Astronomy on the Moon
background_knowledge:
