月球天文观测位于空间天文、光学干涉测量与未来月球基础设施建设的交叉方向。其核心物理动机是：月球没有大气，因而没有大气吸收、湍流造成的视宁度限制与闪烁；月面机械环境相对稳定，且背面存在可屏蔽地球无线电干扰的静默区；真空、低重力与可扩展建造条件也有利于架设超大口径或超长基线设施。
\n在光学与红外天文中，角分辨率的基本标度满足 $\theta \sim \lambda/B$ ，其中 $\lambda$ 为观测波长， $B$ 为干涉基线或孔径尺度。单一口径望远镜受制造、发射与成本限制，而稀释孔径阵列将多台分离望远镜的光进行相干合成，可在等效口径远大于单镜的条件下获得高分辨率。hypertelescope（超望远镜）是一类稀释孔径干涉成像方案，试图在 pupil plane 中通过 densified pupil 设计实现直接、宽视场的快照成像，而不仅是被动的傅里叶分量测量。若在月面部署跨度达数百米至数公里的光学阵列，可望把角分辨率推进到毫角秒乃至微角秒量级，为恒星表面成像、系外行星直接成像与表征、活动星系核与致密天体周边结构等研究提供新窗口。
\n该方向的研究范式兼具概念研究、系统工程与观测科学：需要论证月面选址、热与机械稳定性、光学相干与相位计量、光束传输与延迟线、波前 sensing、阵列编队飞行、原位制造与组装、数据反演和科学目标定义。历史上自 Space Age 与 Apollo 时代起已有大量月球天文台构想，但多因技术成熟度不足、科学优先级变化与持续月面运行成本高昂而未实现。当前机器人、自主系统、增材制造、精密光学与编队飞行等技术进展，使大规模月面天文基础设施重新进入可行性讨论。
contribution: 本文是一篇面向下一代月面光学天文的综述与路线图论文。文章系统回顾了自 Space Age 以来六十年间月球天文观测概念的历史演变，重点梳理 Apollo 时代相关研究及其后各类月面天文台设想；分析以往项目未能落地的原因，包括技术限制、科学优先级的转移以及持续月面作业的高成本；并考察当前机器人、自主系统、增材制造、精密光学与编队飞行等技术的发展如何重新开启月面大型天文基础设施的可能性。文章特别聚焦 lunar hypertelescope 概念，指出其可通过跨度达数百米至数公里的稀释光学阵列实现前所未有的角分辨率。**论文的核心结论是： renewed lunar exploration 与新兴技术使未来月面 hypertelescope 设施重新具备现实前景，并有望在 21 世纪变革观测天文学**；在此基础上，文章提出了通往未来月球 hypertelescope 设施的发展路线图。
summary: Since the dawn of the Space Age, the Moon has been considered one of the most promising locations for astronomical observations. The absence of atmosphere, exceptional mechanical stability, access to the permanently shielded radio-quiet far side, and the possibility of constructing extremely large apertures have motivated numerous concepts for lunar observatories over the past six decades. Despite extensive studies conducted during the Apollo era, most proposed lunar astronomy projects remained unrealized due to technological limitations, shifting scientific priorities, and the high cost of sustained lunar operations. Today, renewed international interest in lunar exploration, combined with advances in robotics, autonomous systems, additive manufacturing, precision optics, and formation flying, is reopening the prospect of large-scale astronomical infrastructures on the Moon. In particular, lunar hypertelescope concepts offer the possibility of achieving unprecedented angular resolutions through diluted optical arrays spanning hundreds of meters to several kilometres. This paper reviews the historical evolution of lunar astronomy concepts, analyses the reasons behind previous failures, examines current technological developments, and proposes a roadmap toward future lunar hypertelescope facilities capable of transforming observational astronomy during the twenty-first century.

title: A distribution-function estimate of the Milky Way mass profile from outer halo stars in DESI DR2
background_knowledge: 银河系质量剖面是理解星系形成、暗物质晕性质及本星系群动力学的基石。观测上通常利用晕星、球状星团、卫星星系、星流等示踪体的三维位置与速度，反演引力势与质量分布；研究范式包括 Jeans 方程、分布函数建模、贝叶斯分层推断以及将观测约束外推至 NFW 等暗物质晕模型。外晕示踪体稀疏且距离、速度误差较大，不同示踪星族（如蓝水平分支星 BHB 与天琴座 RR 型变星 RRL）在年龄、金属丰度和空间分布上的差异会带来系统误差，因此需要通过模拟星表校验方法并评估示踪体选择效应。DESI 等大规模光谱巡天为外晕提供了日益增多的恒星运动学样本，使精确测量银河系质量剖面并控制系统误差成为可能。
contribution: 论文利用 DESI DR2 前三年观测中约 $50$--$80\,\mathrm{kpc}$ 的 279 颗 BHB 星与 213 颗 RRL 星测量银河系质量，样本规模约为此前 DESI DR1 质量测量所用星表的两倍。作者采用分层贝叶斯框架 GME，假设引力势与示踪体密度为幂律形式，并计入距离和速度误差；在 24 个 AuriDESI 模拟星表（6 个 Auriga 暗晕 × 4 个视角）上校验后发现，该方法在 $80\,\mathrm{kpc}$ 处高估包围质量约 15%，据此进行修正。得到 **BHB 与 RRL 分别给出 $M(<80\,\mathrm{kpc}) = 0.64^{+0.06}_{-0.06}\times10^{12}\,M_\odot$ 和 $0.53^{+0.05}_{-0.05}\times10^{12}\,M_\odot$**；若计入人马座星流恒星，质量约降低 10%。外推至 $100\,\mathrm{kpc}$ 得 **$M(<100\,\mathrm{kpc}) = 0.74^{+0.07}_{-0.07}\times10^{12}\,M_\odot$ 与 $0.62^{+0.06}_{-0.07}\times10^{12}\,M_\odot$**；将 NFW 晕锚定于 $65\,\mathrm{kpc}$ 处的 GME 约束，得到 **$M_{200} = 1.12^{+0.14}_{-0.12}\times10^{12}\,M_\odot$ 与 $0.89^{+0.11}_{-0.10}\times10^{12}\,M_\odot$**。**BHB 在整个径向范围内给出的质量系统性高于 RRL**，表明即使方法相同，示踪体选择也会影响结果。该工作是 DESI DR2 Key Project 中利用不同样本与方法测量银河系质量并约束系统误差的组成部分。
summary: We present measurements of the Milky Way mass using blue horizontal-branch (BHB) and RR Lyrae (RRL) stars from the second data release of DESI (DR2), covering its first three years of operations. We employ 279 BHBs and 213 RRLs at $\sim\!50$--$80$\,kpc from the Galactic center, selected from catalogs roughly twice as large as those of DESI DR1, used in our previous mass measurement. We apply the Galactic Mass Estimator (GME), a hierarchical Bayesian framework that assumes power-law forms for the potential and the tracer density, and accounts for distance and velocity uncertainties. Validating the method on 24 AuriDESI mock catalogs (six Auriga halos at four viewing angles), we find that it overestimates the enclosed mass by $\sim\!15\%$ at 80\,kpc, and correct our results accordingly. We obtain $M(<80\,{\rm kpc}) = 0.64^{+0.06}_{-0.06}$ and $0.53^{+0.05}_{-0.05} \times 10^{12}\,M_\odot$ for BHBs and RRLs, respectively, while including Sagittarius stream stars lowers these masses by $\sim\!10$\%. Extrapolating to 100\,kpc, we obtain $M(<100\,{\rm kpc}) = 0.74^{+0.07}_{-0.07}$ and $0.62^{+0.06}_{-0.07} \times 10^{12}\,M_\odot$, and anchoring an NFW halo to our GME constraints at 65\,kpc yields virial masses of $M_{200} = 1.12^{+0.14}_{-0.12}$ and $0.89^{+0.11}_{-0.10} \times 10^{12}\,M_\odot$. BHBs yield systematically higher masses than RRLs across the full radial range, reflecting the impact of tracer choice even within a single method. This work is part of a wider DESI DR2 Key Project effort to measure the Milky Way mass and constrain systematics arising from different samples and methodologies.

title: Euclid: Forecasting the number counts of bright line emitters in the Euclid Wide Survey and Euclid Deep fields
background_knowledge: 在宇宙学与星系演化研究中，发射线星系是示踪大尺度结构、星系形成历史与宇宙膨胀的重要样本。强发射线（如 $[\mathrm{OII}]$ 3727 Å、$\mathrm{H}\beta$、$[\mathrm{OIII}]$ 5007 Å、$\mathrm{H}\alpha$、$\mathrm{Pa}\beta$）主要来自 HII 区电离气体的复合与禁戒跃迁，其流量和等值宽与恒星形成率、金属丰度及电离源性质相关。通过光谱测量这些线的红移和流量，可以构建按红移与流量选择的星系样本，用于星系成团性、重子声学振荡（BAO）、星系形成以及尘埃和金属丰度演化研究。Euclid 的宽场与深场光谱巡天将提供大量低分辨率光谱；预测不同红移和流量下的数目计数，需要结合星系形成模型、经验标度关系、巡天选择函数、光谱提取与红移测量误差。模型间差异和流量损失会显著影响样本完备性，因此是规划宇宙学分析的重要前置工作。
contribution: 论文系统比较半解析模型与经验标度关系给出的发射线星系数目计数，并利用 FastSpec 在 MAMBO 光锥中快速生成 Euclid 观测风格的模拟光谱，再通过 Euclid 官方光谱 pipeline 恢复红移与线流量，从而预测 EWS 和 EDS 中 $[\mathrm{OII}]$、$\mathrm{H}\beta$、$[\mathrm{OIII}]$、$\mathrm{H}\alpha$ 与 $\mathrm{Pa}\beta$ 发射线星系的计数。结果显示，$\mathrm{H}\alpha+[\mathrm{NII}]$ 的预测在不同 mock 之间以及与现有观测大体一致；在 EWS 中，集成计数的 mock 间相对 RMS 散布约为 $\mathrm{H}\alpha+[\mathrm{NII}]$ 的 19%、$[\mathrm{OII}]$ 的 44% 和 $[\mathrm{OIII}]$ 的 41%，表明氧线预测更依赖模型。计入流量损失和红移误识别后，校正后的流量测量可恢复大部分本征线计数，尤其在 EDS 中。基于 MAMBO/FastSpec 模拟，**Euclid 预计在 EWS 中探测到约 4200 万个 $\mathrm{H}\alpha$ 发射体，在 EDS 中探测到约 170 万个**；同一模拟还预测 EDS 中约 50 万个 $[\mathrm{OII}]$ 和 80 万个 $[\mathrm{OIII}]$ 发射体，EWS 中约 130 万个 $[\mathrm{OII}]$ 和 750 万个 $[\mathrm{OIII}]$ 发射体。**非 $\mathrm{H}\alpha$ 预测仍存在显著的模型依赖不确定性**。这些样本将把大尺度结构和 BAO 研究推进到 $z\sim2$ 以上，并扩展 Euclid 在宇宙学与星系演化方面的研究能力。
summary: The Euclid mission will revolutionize our understanding of the visible Universe by collecting images and spectra of millions of galaxies across cosmic time and environments. Here, we forecast the number counts of galaxies emitting [OII], H\b{eta}, [OIII], Hα and Pa\b{eta} lines in the Euclid Wide Survey (EWS) and Deep Survey (EDS). We compare predictions from different models, including semi-analytic models and empirical scaling relations. We then simulate spectra for galaxies in the MAMBO lightcone using FastSpec, designed to rapidly generate one-dimensional spectra as observed by Euclid. We process these simulated spectra with the official Euclid spectroscopic pipeline to recover redshifts and line fluxes and derive expected counts. Predictions for Hα+[NII] emitters are broadly consistent across mocks and with existing observations. In the EWS, relative RMS scatter among mock predictions for integrated counts is approximately 19% for Hα+[NII], 44% for [OII] and 41% for [OIII], reflecting greater model dependence for oxygen-line forecasts. After accounting for flux losses and redshift misidentification, corrected flux measurements recover most intrinsic line counts, especially in the EDS. From the MAMBO-based FastSpec simulations, we predict that Euclid will detect about 42 million Hα emitters in the EWS and 1.7 million in the EDS. The same simulations predict approximately 0.5 and 0.8 million [OII] and [OIII] emitters, respectively, in the EDS, and about 1.3 and 7.5 million in the EWS. These non-Hα forecasts remain subject to substantial model-dependent uncertainties, as shown by scatter among the different mocks. These samples will be instrumental in pushing large-scale structure and baryon acoustic oscillation studies beyond redshift z~2, extending Euclid cosmological and galaxy evolution studies beyond what is achievable with Hα alone.

title: CHEX-MATE: Density profile reconstruction in galaxy clusters
background_knowledge: 星系团是宇宙中已维里化的最大引力束缚结构，其质量主要由暗物质主导，重子部分则以温度可达千万开尔文的团内介质（ICM）热等离子体为主。ICM 在 X 射线波段通过热轫致辐射发光，观测得到的是沿视线的投影 X 射线表面亮度；要获得三维径向气体密度分布，需要在球对称等假设下进行反投影。实际星系团常具有非球形形态、子结构、冷团块和动力学扰动，这些因素会使基于方位角平均的反投影产生偏差。因此，发展稳健的反投影方法、理解平均与中位数统计在真实星系团样本中的系统误差，是大样本 X 射线星系团研究（如 CHEX-MATE）和后续宇宙学、团内物理研究的基础。
contribution: 在 CHEX-MATE 框架内，本文利用 109 个模拟星系团并沿 40 条独立视线生成投影观测，系统比较方位角平均与方位角中位数反投影方法，评估星系团形态、动力学状态及方法选择对 ICM 径向密度剖面重建的影响。结果显示：**基于方位角中位数的密度剖面可在 $[0.15-1.3] R_{500}$ 范围内以可忽略偏差恢复真实气体密度**；基于平均值的剖面则受子结构影响，若对团块或子结构进行准确掩膜，偏差可降至 5% 以下，但在扰动系统或子结构未被分辨时偏差显著增大。平均与中位数密度之比在统计上可追踪投影气体不均匀性，但本征弥散和投影效应限制其用于单个星系团。因此，**联合使用平均与中位数剖面是大样本 X 射线星系团分析中最完整的方法**。
summary: We investigated the reconstruction of the intra-cluster medium radial density profiles in galaxy clusters, focusing on the impact of cluster morphology, dynamical state, and methodological choices, within the framework of the CHEX-MATE project. Using a sample of 109 simulated galaxy clusters analysed along 40 independent lines of sight, we compared azimuthal mean and median techniques for deprojection. We find that azimuthal median-based density profiles recover the true gas density with negligible bias over the radial range $[0.15-1.3] R_{500}$. Mean based profiles are affected by the presence of substructures. While an accurate masking of clumps or substructures can reduce the bias to $< 5\%$, the discrepancy increases substantially in disturbed systems or when substructures remain unresolved. The mean-to-median density ratio statistically traces projected gas inhomogeneities, although intrinsic scatter and projection effects limit its use for individual clusters. The complementary use of mean and median profiles therefore provides the most complete approach for large X-ray cluster samples.

title: Dynamics of self-gravitating halos with decaying dark matter
background_knowledge: 现代宇宙学通常假定暗物质由一种或多种超出标准模型的粒子组成，并在标准宇宙学模型中近似稳定。暗物质在引力不稳定性下形成从矮星系到星系团的等级结构；暗物质晕是星系形成的引力势阱，其密度剖面、速度分布和各向异性记录了结构形成与暗物质微观性质的信息。若暗物质粒子并非完全稳定，而会衰变为更轻的暗粒子与无质量粒子，则衰变产物携带的反冲能量会改变暗物质晕的相空间分布，使晕加热、膨胀甚至部分解体。宇宙学观测（如宇宙微波背景辐射、大尺度结构、莱曼阿尔法森林等）已经对暗物质寿命和衰变参数给出限制，但这些限制主要依赖背景或线性尺度；暗物质晕内部的非线性演化可提供互补的、尺度较小的检验。研究此类问题通常需要自引力 N 体模拟、暗物质晕平衡态与弛豫理论，并考虑初始速度各向异性等更真实的初始条件。
contribution: 论文研究由会衰变的暗物质粒子组成的自引力球对称暗物质晕的演化：暗物质粒子衰变为一个稍轻的暗物质粒子和一个无质量粒子，子粒子获得的小反冲速度会对晕加热。作者指出，**当反冲速度远小于暗物质晕的特征速度时，晕仍保持引力束缚，但会发生膨胀（puff out）**。论文**首次考虑具有各向异性初始条件的衰变暗物质晕，并发现其对最终密度剖面有不可忽略的影响**。作者使用新近发展的 NSphere 代码，在宽广的衰变时标与反冲速度参数范围内模拟晕的演化，并训练 emulator 建立衰变参数到弛豫后密度剖面的映射。论文进一步讨论这些暗物质晕尺度的信号如何补充现有对衰变暗物质的宇宙学限制，并指出它们可由未来巡天检验。
summary: We study the evolution of self-gravitating spherical dark matter halos composed of dark matter particles that decay to a slightly less massive particle and a massless particle. The small kick velocity imparted to the daughter particle upon decay heats the halo. If the kick velocity is small compared with the characteristic velocity, the halo remains bound but puffs out. We also consider, for the first time, decaying halos with anisotropic initial conditions and find non-negligible effects on the resulting density profile. To simulate the halo evolution, we utilize the recently developed \texttt{NSphere} code across a broad range of decay times and kick velocities. We train an emulator to provide a mapping between the decay parameters and the relaxed density profile. We discuss how the resulting halo-scale signatures complement existing cosmological constraints on decaying dark matter and can be tested by upcoming surveys.

title: Developing the Field Selector System for the SHARP Multi-IFU: Optomechanical Design and First Prototype Validation
background_knowledge:
积分场光谱（Integral Field Spectroscopy）能够对二维视场中的每个空间位置同时获取光谱，从而把目标的空间形态与运动学、化学丰度等信息联系起来。传统单狭缝光谱一次通常只观测一个狭缝或少量目标；积分场单元（IFU）则通过透镜阵列、光纤或图像切片器把二维视场重排成光谱仪狭缝，再由探测器记录多条光谱。多积分场单元（multi-IFU）系统进一步把多个 IFU 集成到同一台光谱仪中，以便同时观测多个目标或子视场，这对近红外高分辨率光谱、星系物理、恒星形成以及高红移宇宙研究等具有重要意义。
\n在 multi-IFU 光谱仪中，前端选场系统负责从望远镜焦面上选取目标，并把光高效、稳定地引导至各 IFU。该环节面临机械干涉、渐晕、光程变化、焦面共轭、定位重复性与光学像质等多种挑战。探针或光学拾取器需要在有限空间内独立移动，同时不能遮挡其他光路；其位置误差会转化为光束倾斜、焦面偏移或耦合效率变化，因此必须把机械公差与光学性能联系起来评估。SHARP 是一台近红外光谱仪，VESPER 是其多 IFU 组件；为其设计可靠的选场系统，本质上是在光机结构、运动控制与光学系统之间进行精密协同设计。
contribution:
论文提出并验证了用于 SHARP 的 VESPER 多 IFU 的场选择系统（Field Selector System，FSS）。该系统采用可移动集光探针（Field Selectors）阵列，各探针沿平行且垂直错开的平面运动，以避免机械干涉和渐晕。其核心创新是光机同步：当每个探针平移 $\Delta y$ 以选择目标时，一组折叠镜同步移动 $\Delta y/2$，从而保持光程恒定，使多个独立运动的探针能够共享同一焦面，并在该焦面上形成连续像，便于切片器进行切片。
\n作者搭建了专用光学测试装置，用于表征探针运动的定位稳定性和重复性；随后把测得的机械误差转换为等效光学倾斜，并纳入 SHARP 光学模型，以评估其对仪器性能的影响。实验识别了主要的定位误差来源，揭示了机械公差与光学性能之间的关系，并提出若干可显著减小探针倾斜、提升系统稳定性的设计改进。**结果证明了所提出概念的可行性**，并表明在实施上述改进后，该系统可作为 SHARP 及其他多积分场单元（mIFU）光谱仪的优良选场方案。
summary: This paper presents the innovative Field Selector System (FSS) developed for VESPER, the multi-Integral Field Unit of the SHARP near-infrared spectrograph. The proposed system employs an array of movable light-collection probes (Field Selectors) that travel along parallel, vertically offset planes to avoid mechanical interference and vignetting. The true novelty lies in its opto-mechanical synchronization: as each probe translates by Δy to select a target, a set of folding mirrors shifts by Δy/2. This maintains a constant optical path length, allowing multiple independently moving probes to share a single focal plane and form a continuous image on it, easy to slice by the slicer. A dedicated optical test setup was developed to characterize the positioning stability and repeatability of the probe motion. The measured mechanical errors were converted into equivalent optical tilts and incorporated into the SHARP optical model to assess their impact on instrument performance. The experimental results identified the dominant sources of positioning error and provided valuable insight into the relationship between mechanical tolerances and optical performance. The study also highlights several design improvements capable of significantly reducing probe tilting and enhancing system stability. The results demonstrate the viability of the proposed concept and indicate that, with the identified improvements, the system represents an excellent field-selection solution for SHARP and other multi-integral-field-unit (mIFU) spectrographs.

title: Horndeski Gravity as an Effective Dark Energy Fluid in Cosmological N-body Simulations
background_knowledge: 现代宇宙学中，宇宙的加速膨胀通常归因于暗能量，标准图像是 $\Lambda$CDM 模型：爱因斯坦方程中的宇宙学常数 $\Lambda$ 提供负压，使膨胀加速；更一般地可用状态方程参数 $w=p_{\rm DE}/\rho_{\rm DE}$ 描述暗能量，$\Lambda$ 对应 $w=-1$。为解释宇宙学常数问题及观测上的细微张力，修改引力模型被广泛研究，其中 Horndeski 理论给出一般标量—张量引力作用量，可在宇宙学尺度上产生额外的有效暗能量扰动，并通过筛选机制在太阳系等强引力环境中恢复广义相对论。结构增长对引力理论十分敏感：不同模型会改变物质扰动的演化、引力滑移和有效牛顿常数。然而，非线性阶段的方程高度复杂，解析预言困难，因此需要 N-body 模拟。常见范式是用线性 Boltzmann 求解器（如 CLASS）计算暗能量或修改引力扰动的线性演化，再将其作为有效流体耦合到 N-body 代码中，以推进粒子并生成非线性大尺度结构；大质量中微子还会通过自由流效应影响增长和聚类。
contribution: 论文把 Horndeski 引力作为有效暗能量流体引入宇宙学 N-body 模拟。作者将线性暗能量扰动（$\delta\rho_{\rm DE}$、$\delta P_{\rm DE}$、$\theta_{\rm DE}$ 与 $\sigma_{\rm DE}$）用同步规范中的度规扰动表示，并在 CONCEPT 中通过 Boltzmann 方程演化该有效流体；同时用包含 Horndeski 家族模型的 mochi_CLASS 替换原 CLASS。模拟覆盖 $w_0w_a$CDM、Hu--Sawicki $f(R)$ 与 cubic Galileon 等情形，并均加入大质量中微子。结果显示，各模型相对广义相对论的偏离与线性区预言接近：$\Lambda$CDM 的相对差异 **低于 0.2%**，Hu--Sawicki $f(R)$ 可达 **约 40%**，cubic Galileon 为 **低于 25%**。该工作是首个把 Horndeski 引力植入 N-body 代码的实现，其验证具有非平凡的计算挑战，并为在当前和未来宇宙学巡天中探索大量修改引力模型打开了道路。
summary:
Unraveling the nature of the cosmic expansion, driven by Dark Energy (DE), remains one of the key challenges in modern cosmology. Modified Gravity (MG) models provide an alternative to the standard cosmological constant paradigm. These models predict distinct signatures in the growth of structure, yet analytical predictions are challenging due to the highly non--linear equations involved.
  To overcome this problem, we study MG as an effective DE fluid. To this end, we have incorporated linear DE perturbations into the N--body code $\texttt{CO}N\texttt{CEPT}$, which relies on the Einstein--Boltzmann solver $\texttt{CLASS}$. We replaced the $\texttt{CLASS}$ version used by $\texttt{CO}N\texttt{CEPT}$ with $\texttt{mochi\_CLASS}$, a patched version that includes Horndeski family models. By writing linear DE perturbations ($δρ_{\rm DE}$, $δP_{\rm DE}$, $θ_{\rm DE}$, and $σ_{\rm DE}$) in terms of metric perturbations in the synchronous gauge, the N--body code is able to evolve the effective fluid using the Boltzmann equation. Our current simulations encompass a range of cosmological scenarios ---$w_0w_a$CDM, Hu--Sawicki $f(R)$ and cubic Galileon--- each extended to include massive neutrinos.
  For each of the models, we have found deviations from General Relativity close to what is predicted in the linear regime: a sub-$0.2\%$ relative difference for $Λ$CDM, up to $40\%$ for $f(R)$ and a sub-$25\%$ for cubic Galileon. Since our code is the first to implement Horndeski gravity into an N--body code, its validation is a non--trivial computational task. Our novel code opens the door to explore a vast number of modified gravity models in the context of current and future cosmological surveys.

title: ReveaLLAGN 3: Revealing the Infrared Spectral Energy Distributions of Low Luminosity AGN
background_knowledge: 活动星系核（AGN）由中心超大质量黑洞吸积物质驱动，是多波段辐射系统。通常，光学/紫外连续谱主要来自吸积盘，X 射线来自盘上方的热冕，红外辐射主要由尘埃环（torus）吸收并再辐射短波辐射产生，射电辐射则可来自喷流。红外波段还包含硅酸盐尘埃在静止系约 $9.7$ 和 $18$ 微米的特征，以及连续谱形状和颜色，可用于约束尘埃分布、覆盖因子与核区几何。低光度活动星系核（LLAGN）吸积率较低，辐射效率可能下降，吸积流可能处于径移主导吸积流等状态，喷流/射电过程相对更重要；同时宿主星系星光和尘埃污染很强，使核区红外光谱能量分布（SED）的测量与解释困难。该领域常通过高空间分辨率红外成像/光谱分离未分辨核，联合 X 射线与射电观测，检验 AGN 统一模型、吸积—喷流联系以及 SED 随光度的演化。
contribution: 本文利用詹姆斯·韦布空间望远镜（JWST）研究 7 个近邻低光度活动星系核在 $1.7$–$24$ 微米波段的近红外与中红外 SED。作者对全波段二维图像进行空间拟合，干净地分离出未分辨的 AGN 光谱，并与基于孔径提取的光谱比较，表明该方法能有效去除星系污染。将红外测量与 X 射线发射比较后，发现**低光度 AGN 的近红外辐射相对于更高光度 AGN 增强，且该趋势与射电噪度相关**；它们的中红外与 X 射线光度比则与更高光度 AGN 相当。多数目标呈现强且致密的硅酸盐发射，暗示这些系统在秒差距尺度上存在暖尘埃。作者还量化了近红外与中红外幂律斜率及颜色：在近红外，不同光度 AGN 的光谱斜率与颜色相似；在中红外，低光度 AGN 通常具有更陡的斜率与更红的颜色。**强硅酸盐发射和陡峭的中红外斜率均与现有低光度 AGN SED 模型不符**。
summary: The spectral energy distributions of active galactic nuclei (AGN) provide valuable information on the emission mechanisms taking place in their inner regions. Here we use the James Webb Space Telescope to study the near and mid-infrared spectral energy distributions of seven nearby low-luminosity active galaxy nuclei from 1.7 to 24 $μm$. We cleanly separate the AGN spectrum by performing spatial fits of the two-dimensional images across all wavelengths. We then compare these clean unresolved spectra to aperture-based spectra and show that they effectively remove galaxy contamination. Comparing our infrared measurements to X-ray emission, we find that low-luminosity AGN have enhanced near-infrared emission relative to more luminous AGN, a trend that correlates with radio-loudness, while their mid-infrared-to-X-ray ratios are comparable. A majority of our targets show strong compact silicate emission suggesting the presence of warm dust on parsec scales in these systems. We also quantify the near- and mid-infrared power-law slopes and colors of low-luminosity AGN. In the near-infrared we find AGN of all luminosities have similar spectral slopes and colors, however in the mid-infrared, we find low-luminosity AGN typically have steeper slopes and redder colors than more luminous AGN. Both the strong silicate emission and steep mid-infrared slopes disagree with existing models for low-luminosity AGN spectral energy distributions.

title: Tracking turbulence for wind-driven halo removal using MagAO-X pyramid wavefront sensor images
background_knowledge:
地基高对比度成像旨在在明亮恒星附近探测暗弱的系外行星、碎屑盘等结构，其核心挑战是把恒星衍射光与波前误差产生的散斑压制到极低水平。自适应光学（adaptive optics，AO）通过波前传感器测量大气湍流造成的相位畸变，并用变形镜实时校正；但闭环控制存在时间延迟，即 servo-lag 误差，使得快速变化的湍流不能被完全校正。大气湍流常被近似为若干冻结湍流层，各层以不同风速和风向输运相位屏；残余波前误差 $\phi(\mathbf{x},t)$ 因而带有方向性和时间相关性。
\n在日冕仪图像中，这种残余误差表现为风驱动晕（wind-driven halo，WDH）：一种持续存在的低空间频率噪声，其强度和位置角会随观测变化。WDH 会淹没延展天体（如星周盘）的低频信号，而仅靠空间滤波难以在去除 WDH 的同时保留天体信号。常用的数据驱动高对比度后处理算法（如 KLIP）依赖参考 PSF 减除恒星散斑；面对动态 WDH，它们往往需要过度减除，从而损失真实天体信号。
\n波前传感器（wavefront sensor，WFS）持续记录闭环残余波前，包含湍流层风速、风向等时间信息，因此其遥测是开展 WDH 后处理建模的理想数据源。MagAO-X 是安装在 6.5 米 Magellan-Clay 望远镜上的极端 AO 系统，配备金字塔波前传感器，可在观测期间以高帧率保存波前遥测，为可见光波段高对比度成像中的 WDH 去除提供了条件。
contribution: 论文针对日冕高对比度成像中的 WDH 噪声，提出并验证了一套利用 WFS 遥测在单幅日冕科学图像中重建和去除 WDH 的新流程。作者使用 MagAO-X 的归档 WFS 遥测数据；该仪器是 6.5 米 Magellan-Clay 望远镜上的极端 AO 系统，其金字塔 WFS 能在数据采集期间以高帧率记录闭环波前。其 windsoCC 数据处理流程对记录的闭环波前做互相关，测量 Las Campanas 天文台上空若干湍流层的风矢量。随后，作者利用这些风参数和参数化模型重建 WDH 的足迹，并将其从科学图像中去除。**在可见光波段的 MagAO-X 实测图像上，针对 HR 4796A 周围碎屑盘，该流程显著改善了对天体信号的恢复**，展示了 WFS 遥测用于动态 WDH 后处理去除的可行性。
summary: The wind-driven halo (WDH) is a persistent, low spatial frequency noise artifact that arises due to the servo-lag error inherent to all adaptive optics (AO) instruments. Spatial filtering may be employed to overcome this artifact, however, filtering out the WDH while simultaneously preserving signal from an extended astrophysical object of interest is exceptionally challenging. Additionally, since the WDH changes in intensity and position angle through an observation, data-driven algorithms (e.g., KLIP) that are commonly used to subtract the starlight need to be overly-aggressive to remove both the static and dynamic noise components. Since wavefront sensors (WFSs) continuously track the closed-loop residual wavefront error, WFS telemetry presents the ideal resource for combating this type of noise artifact through postprocessing. Using archival WFS telemetry from MagAO-X, which is the "extreme" AO instrument for the 6.5-meter Magellan-Clay telescope, we demonstrate a novel workflow for WDH reconstruction and removal in individual coronagraphic science images. MagAO-X is equipped with a pyramid WFS capable of recording wavefront telemetry at a high-cadence which is saved during data acquisition. Given this, we detail how our WFS data processing pipeline, windsoCC, cross-correlates the recorded closed-loop wavefront to measure the wind vectors of several turbulent layers of the atmosphere above Las Campanas Observatory. We then make use of the wind parameters learned through windsoCC to reconstruct the WDH footprint by leveraging a parametric model. Notably, we demonstrate a dramatic improvement in object recovery using on-sky MagAO-X images of the disk around HR 4796A at visible wavelengths.

title: Near-Quantum-Limited Readout for the Princeton Axion Search using a sub-GHz Kinetic Inductance Traveling Wave Parametric Amplifier
background_knowledge: 轴子（axion）最初因强 CP 问题被提出，同时也是备受关注的暗物质候选者之一。类轴子粒子若构成暗物质，其质量与光子频率满足 $h\nu = m_a c^2$，因此不同质量对应不同射电/微波频段；亚 GHz 频段对应约 $10^{-6}$–$10^{-5}$ eV 量级的极轻轴子。实验上通常利用强磁场中的轴子—光子转换来搜寻暗物质晕中的轴子，但转换信号极弱，需要低噪声、宽带宽、可长期稳定运行的量子器件读出。微波/射电探测的噪声常用输入参考噪声光子数衡量；相位不敏感线性放大器的量子极限约为 $1/2$ 个量子，实际系统噪声还会受到器件损耗、后续链路和温度等影响。1 GHz 以上已有多种近量子极限参量放大器，而亚 GHz 频段因元件尺寸、泵浦功率、损耗与磁场兼容性等问题，低噪声放大器的发展相对有限。动力学电感行波参量放大器（KI-TWPA）利用超导传输线的非线性动力学电感，通过四波混频实现行波参量放大，具有宽带宽和低耗散潜力，适合低温精密读出与暗物质搜寻。
contribution: 论文报道了一款工作于 300–700 MHz 的动力学电感行波参量放大器（KI-TWPA），**增益超过 30 dB**，泵浦功率仅数百 nW。利用变温噪声源测得系统噪声为 **2.5–3.5 个量子**。作者进一步表征了与轴子搜寻相关的关键性能，包括增益漂移、压缩点、不同工作温度下的放大器噪声、带输入环形器的读出，以及磁场不敏感性。**该器件为亚 GHz 精密测量提供了近量子极限的通用读出工具**，可应用于半导体自旋量子比特读出、超导探测器阵列读出以及超越标准模型的新物理搜寻，包括 Princeton Axion Search。
summary: Parametric amplifiers are a workhorse for near-quantum-limited measurements above 1 GHz. However, amplifier development has been more limited below 1 GHz. We present a kinetic inductance traveling-wave parametric amplifier (KI-TWPA) operating over 300-700 MHz, with gain exceeding 30 dB and pump powers of a few hundred nanowatts. The system noise performance, as measured by a variable-temperature noise source, is 2.5-3.5 quanta. This device is a versatile new tool for precision measurements of sub-GHz signals, with applications including readout of semiconductor spin qubits, superconducting detector arrays, and searches for new physics beyond the Standard Model. We characterize aspects of the amplifier performance relevant to axion searches, including gain drift, compression point, amplifier noise at various operating temperatures, readout with an input circulator, and magnetic field insensitivity.

title: Probing Solar-Wind Structure During Crab Pulsar Conjunctions with Dispersion and Faraday Rotation
background_knowledge: 太阳风是从日冕向外持续流出的磁化等离子体，其电子密度起伏、速度结构和日球层磁场在太阳附近最强、最复杂。脉冲星的射电脉冲穿过这条视线时，会受到等离子体折射、散射和色散影响：自由电子使不同频率信号产生群延迟，沿视线积分得到色散量 $\mathrm{DM}=\int n_e\,\mathrm{d}l$；若等离子体中有平行于视线的磁场，则线偏振位置角随波长平方旋转，法拉第旋转量近似满足 $\mathrm{RM}\propto\int n_e B_\parallel\,\mathrm{d}l$。因此，DM 主要示踪电子柱密度，RM 同时依赖电子密度与磁场方向，二者联合可估计电子密度加权的视向磁场。太阳合期间，脉冲星视线扫过内日球层和太阳风结构，是研究磁扇边界、日冕物质抛射和太阳风湍流的独特探针；但脉冲散射、电离层法拉第旋转和观测窗口外的日常噪声都会污染测量，需要校正与稳健统计。CHIME 凭借宽频带和单脉冲记录能力，可同时测量 DM 与 RM 的短时变化。
contribution: 论文利用 CHIME 在 2022-2026 年蟹状脉冲星（PSR B0531+21）各次太阳合期间的观测，分析散射校正后的 DM 与经电离层校正的 RM 时间序列，以探测内太阳风等离子体结构。**2025 年 DM 序列在主合日峰值后约一周的 6 月 21 日出现次级增强**，其幅度 $\Delta \mathrm{DM}=(3.95\pm0.20)\times10^{-3}\ \mathrm{pc\,cm^{-3}}$，约为合日窗口外逐日 DM 散布的 20 倍；RM 由每次观测的单脉冲合并得到，**在合日期间出现最高约 $60\ \mathrm{rad\,m^{-2}}$ 的偏移和符号变化，与穿越日球层磁扇边界相符**，但未发现与 2025 年次级 DM 特征或 2026 年合日后 DM 尾巴相对应的 RM 信号。由 RM 超出量与 DM 超出量的斜率，作者估算了电子密度加权的视线方向磁场；在斜率显著的扇区，合日附近 $|\langle B_\parallel\rangle|$ 至少为约 $0.2$ 至 $10\ \mathrm{mG}$，其中 2025 年最大。
summary: Observations of the Crab pulsar (PSR B0531+21) during solar conjunction probe plasma structure in the inner solar wind through radio-propagation effects. We analyze dispersion measure (DM) and rotation measure (RM) measurements from the annual conjunctions of 2022-2026, obtained with the Canadian Hydrogen Intensity Mapping Experiment (CHIME). The 2025 DM time series is distinguished from those of the other years by a secondary enhancement on 21 June, about one week after the main conjunction peak. In our scattering-corrected DM measurements, this feature, $Δ$DM $= (3.95 \pm 0.20) \times 10^{-3}$ pc cm$^{-3}$, is about 20 times the day-to-day DM scatter outside the conjunction window. The RM time series, measured by combining the single pulses of each observation and corrected for the ionospheric contribution, show conjunction excursions of up to $\sim 60$ rad m$^{-2}$ and changes of sign consistent with crossings of heliospheric magnetic-sector boundaries, but no counterpart to the secondary 2025 DM feature or to a similar post-conjunction DM tail in 2026. From the slope of the RM excess against the DM excess we estimate the electron-density-weighted line-of-sight magnetic field; for the sectors with significant slopes, $|\langle B_\parallel \rangle|$ is at least $\sim 0.2$ to $\sim 10$ mG near conjunction, largest in 2025.

title: The dwarf galaxy NGC 185: the flagship of Andromeda's dwarf galaxies for the study of evolved multiple stellar populations
background_knowledge:
矮椭圆星系和矮椭球星系是低质量、以老年恒星为主的系统，也是理解星系形成、化学增丰与质量组装的重要“化石”。在本星系群（Local Group）内，望远镜可以把星系解析为单颗恒星，研究者因而能用颜色-星等图（CMD）开展“恒星考古”：不同年龄和金属丰度的星族会在主序、红巨星分支（RGB）、水平分支（HB）、红团簇（RC）和渐近巨星分支（AGB）等演化阶段占据不同位置；星族合成模型把这些演化阶段与观测到的颜色分布和光度函数相比较，反推恒星形成历史（SFH）、金属丰度分布、距离和消光。该范式的核心前提是恒星演化模型足够可靠，尤其是低质量恒星在 RGB 上的质量损失，因为它直接影响 HB 形态和后续演化。
\n传统 SFH 诊断常依赖主序拐点（MSTO），因为 MSTO 亮度对年龄敏感。但在 10–15 Mpc 乃至更远距离，老年低质量恒星的 MSTO 极其暗弱，HST 与 JWST 也难以获得足够深、足够完整的测光。较亮的演化恒星因此成为替代诊断：HB 形态对年龄、金属丰度、氦丰度和 RGB 质量损失敏感，可用于测距、消光和老年星族研究；RC 光度函数约束中等年龄及较近期的恒星形成；RGB 的颜色与斜率携带金属丰度信息；AGB 星补充较晚演化阶段。若这些诊断得到校准，便可把基于分辨恒星的 SFH 研究推广到 MSTO 方法无法触及的星系。
\nNGC 185 是仙女座星系（M31）的矮椭圆星系卫星，位于本星系群内，具有多年龄、多金属丰度的演化星族，是检验上述方法的理想实验室。研究“演化多星族”意味着星系并非由单一年龄和单一金属丰度的简单星族构成，而是由多个星族成分叠加；分辨恒星的颜色-星等图能够揭示这些成分的相对贡献。该工作也属于把近邻星系精细测量转化为更遥远星系统计诊断的研究路径。
contribution: 论文将 NGC 185 作为仙女座矮星系中研究演化多星族的样板，检验能否利用较亮的演化恒星，而不是极暗的主序拐点（MSTO），为 10–15 Mpc 距离上的矮椭圆星系重建恒星形成历史（SFH）。作者把低质量和中等质量恒星的演化模型输入星族合成模拟，复现 $(m_{F606W}-m_{F814W}, m_{F814W})$ 颜色-星等图中的颜色分布与光度函数，并联合使用水平分支（HB）、红团簇（RC）、红巨星分支（RGB）和渐近巨星分支（AGB）星诊断星族参数。HB 被用于约束 7 Gyr 以前的早期 SFH；由 HB 星分布得到 **$E(B-V)=0.20$ mag** 和 **距离模数 $DM=24.10$ mag**，低质量恒星在 RGB 阶段平均损失 **$0.22 \pm 0.01\,M_{\odot}$**。SFH 结果显示恒星形成集中于早期，**一半恒星在 11 Gyr 以前形成**；HB 形态表明 8 Gyr 以上的星族基本没有金属丰度弥散，而 RGB 斜率暗示 5–6 Gyr 以下的部分恒星有轻微金属增丰；RC 光度函数给出了 **8 Gyr 以内近期 SFH** 的约束。作者据此指出，在 RGB 质量损失得到充分约束后，演化恒星可为远超 MSTO 方法适用距离的矮椭圆星系提供可靠 SFH，并讨论了向更遥远系统推广的前景及恒星模型中的剩余不确定性。
summary:
Reaching galaxies at 10-15 Mpc with HST and JWST requires star
  formation history (SFH) diagnostics that do not rely on the faint
  main sequence turn-off. We investigate whether horizontal branch (HB),
  red clump (RC), and red and asymptotic giant branch (RGB, AGB) stars can
  fill this role for dwarf elliptical galaxies, using NGC 185 as a test case.
  We use stellar evolution models of low- and intermediate-mass stars as inputs
  to population synthesis simulations that reproduce the colour distribution and
  luminosity function of stars in the (mF606W-mF814W, mF814W)
  diagram. The study of the stars populating the HB is used to derive
  the distance modulus and reddening, the average mass loss suffered by the stars during
  the ascending on the RGB and the SFH occurred during the ancient epochs, before 7 Gyr ago.
  The luminosity function of the RC gives us constraints on the recent SFH (<8 Gyr).
  The distribution of HB stars yields a reddening E(B-V)=0.20 mag and a distance
  modulus DM=24.10 mag for NGC 185. The average mass lost by low-mass stars during
  the RGB phase is 0.22 +- 0.01 Msun. Star formation
  was concentrated at early epochs, with half of the stars formed more than 11 Gyr ago.
  The morphology of the HB indicates essentially no metallicity spread among stars older
  than 8 Gyr, whereas the slope of the RGB suggests that part of the stars younger than
  5-6 Gyr are slightly enriched in metals. Once RGB mass loss is adequately constrained, evolved stars can provide a
  reliable SFH for dwarf elliptical galaxies well beyond the reach of MSTO-based methods.
  We discuss the implications for more distant systems and the remaining uncertainties in
  the underlying stellar models.

title: Primary and Secondary Star Formation in the Spiral Waves of NGC 628
background_knowledge: 旋涡星系的旋臂通常被理解为密度波：盘内气体与恒星在引力作用下形成缓慢旋转的波型，气体经过旋臂时被压缩，从而触发恒星形成。若旋臂是波型臂，其图案速度与物质轨道角速度不同，在共转半径处二者相等；在共转半径内外，气体相对旋臂的角向流动会改变年轻星团在旋臂中的分布和年龄序列。与此并行，恒星反馈——大质量星的电离辐射、星风与超新星——会把周围气体扫成气泡，并在壳层聚集气体，触发下一代恒星形成。因此，可将旋臂直接压缩星际气体形成的星团称为第一代（初级）恒星形成，将气泡壳层中形成的星团称为第二代（次级）恒星形成。观测上，中红外 $7.7\,\mu\mathrm{m}$ 的 PAH 发射常用于描绘受辐照的分子云、纤维状结构与气泡；再结合光学和近红外星团目录，可以比较已露出与仍埋藏的年轻星团相对旋臂、spur、feather 和气泡的位置、质量函数及年龄。NGC 628 是近邻、正面朝向的旋涡星系，适合用来分辨这些星系尺度的恒星形成结构。
contribution: 论文以 NGC 628 为样本，将光学识别星团与正在显现的埋藏星团（emerging young star clusters，eYSCs）的位置，同 $7.7\,\mu\mathrm{m}$ 图像中的四类形态——旋臂纤维、旋臂支刺（spurs）、臂间羽状结构（feathers）与气泡——逐一对应，以区分密度波直接压缩和恒星反馈触发的恒星形成。作者发现，最年轻星团在小半径处向旋臂内延伸得比大半径处更远，这与波型旋臂中角向流动速率随离开共转点距离增大而增加的预期一致。旋臂相关的 eYSCs 被解释为由密度波直接压缩星际气体形成的**第一代恒星**，而气泡边缘的星团则是反馈压缩产生的**第二代恒星**。两类星团的质量函数不同：**旋臂纤维中的 eYSCs 可延伸到显著更高的质量，而气泡中的 eYSCs 质量上限较低**。次级恒星形成在初级恒星形成下游持续发生，**抹平了沿旋臂本应出现的年龄梯度**。气泡 eYSCs 约占全部正在显现星团质量的三分之一。**外层旋臂中旋臂相关与气泡相关 eYSCs 的混合程度高于内层旋臂**，这为区分波型臂与物质臂、并定位波型臂的共转半径提供了潜在诊断。在 17 个满足 $\log\,(M/M_\odot)>4$ 的质量最大星团中，有 8 个位于 4 对紧密星团对中；至少一例中，星团对的动力学时标与星团年龄相当。
summary: To determine the role of spiral arms and stellar feedback on the formation of stars, we examine the positions of optically identified and emerging star clusters in NGC 628. We find that the youngest clusters extend further into the spiral arms at small radii than at large radii, as expected when the angular flow rate through a wave-like arm increases with greater distance from corotation. The embedded or emerging star clusters (eYSCs) are identified relative to four distinct morphological features in the 7.7 micron image: spiral arm filaments, spiral arm spurs, spiral interarm feathers, and bubbles. Spiral arm-related eYSCs are presumably first-generation stars made from interstellar gas that was directly compressed by the density wave, while clusters along the rims of bubbles are secondary generations produced by feedback compression. The mass functions of the first and second generations differ: eYSCs in spiral arm filaments extend to significantly higher masses than eYSCs in bubbles. Secondary star formation continues downstream from primary star formation, removing the expected age gradient through the arms. Bubble eYSCs account for approximately one-third of all the emerging cluster mass. The outer arms have a more mixed distribution of spiral- and bubble-related eYSCs than the inner arms, potentially providing a way to distinguish wave and material arms and to find corotation in wave-like arms. Among the 17 most massive clusters with log M(Msun)>4, eight of them are in four tight pairs; in at least one case, the dynamical time for the pair is comparable to the cluster ages.

title: Pushing the frontiers of low-frequency radio astronomy: An ultra-deep sub-arcsecond LOFAR image of ELAIS-N1
background_knowledge: 低频射电天文学通过干涉测量探测宇宙中的同步辐射、自由–自由辐射等信号，是研究活动星系核、恒星形成星系、星系团射电晕和星际介质磁场的核心手段。LOFAR 等工作在百 MHz 频段的望远镜具有大视场优势，但低频率对应长波长：要实现亚角秒分辨率，需要极长基线和精确的电离层、方向相关增益校准；同时成像深度受噪声、混淆和仪器系统误差限制。宽场深巡天的另一个关键是天体测量精度与极化校准：总强度 Stokes I 到线偏振的泄漏会限制弱偏振信号的探测。ELAIS-N1 是经典多波段深场，适合检验极深射电成像、源计数及多波段交叉匹配。
contribution: 作者利用 200 小时 LOFAR 在 115 至 168 MHz 的观测，覆盖 $2.5\times2.5\ \mathrm{deg}^2$，并结合长基线校准与成像的新进展，生成了超深亚角秒射电连续谱图像。中心点源灵敏度达到 $5.3\ \mu\mathrm{Jy/beam}$，角分辨率为 $0.33^{\prime\prime}\times0.39^{\prime\prime}$；面积加权灵敏度为 $7.4\ \mu\mathrm{Jy/beam}$，分辨率为 $0.36^{\prime\prime}\times0.45^{\prime\prime}$，**这些是迄今低于 1.28 GHz 的最深射电图像，也属于任意射电频率下最深之列**。将新数据与先前发布的 6 角秒 LOFAR 图像结合，作者在 $2.5\times2.5\ \mathrm{deg}^2$ 内汇编了 **62,916 个唯一射电源** 的目录；利用 95 个 Gaia 类星体进行天体测量对齐后，这些源的位置偏差为 $\Delta\mathrm{RA}=-3\pm27\ \mathrm{mas}$、$\Delta\mathrm{DEC}=2\pm17\ \mathrm{mas}$。作者还展示了亚角秒分辨率下深偏振研究的潜力：Stokes I 到线偏振的仪器泄漏低至 0.12%，**约为 6 角秒分辨率 LOFAR Two-metre Sky Survey 典型泄漏水平的一半**。结果证明在宽场上对大量观测进行亚角秒分辨率成像是计算可行的，**在深度、分辨率和巡天面积组合上树立了低频射电成像的新基准，并为 LOFAR2.0 与 SKA 时代更深、更广的巡天奠定基础**。
summary: We present ultra-deep sub-arcsecond radio images of the ELAIS-N1 field covering 2.5x2.5 deg^2, produced from 200 hours of LOw Frequency ARray (LOFAR) observations in the 115-168 MHz band. The radio continuum images are obtained using recent advances in LOFAR long-baseline calibration and imaging. We achieve a central point-source sensitivity of 5.3 $μ$Jy/beam at an angular resolution of 0.33"x0.39" and an area-weighted sensitivity of 7.4 $μ$Jy/beam at 0.36"x0.45", making these the deepest radio images below 1.28 GHz to date and among the deepest at any radio frequency. By combining our data with previously released deep 6" LOFAR images, we compile a catalogue with a total of 62,916 unique radio sources across 2.5x2.5 deg^2. Our calibration strategy, combined with astrometric alignment using 95 Gaia quasars, results in positional offsets of $Δ$RA = -3 $\pm$ 27 mas and $Δ$DEC = 2 $\pm$ 17 mas for these same sources. We further demonstrate the potential for deep polarisation studies at sub-arcsecond resolution with instrumental leakages from Stokes I into linear polarisation down to 0.12%, which is about a factor of two better than the typical leakage in the LOFAR Two-metre Sky Survey at 6" resolution. Our results demonstrate that imaging a large number of observations over a wide field area at sub-arcsecond resolution is now computationally feasible. This establishes a new benchmark for low-frequency radio imaging in terms of combining depth, resolution, and survey area, which lays the foundation for deeper and wider surveys in the LOFAR2.0 and SKA era.

title: Planting neutrino SE-EdS: A < 3% accurate clustering approximation for neutrinos and other hot dark matter
background_knowledge: 宇宙大尺度结构研究关注早期宇宙的微小密度扰动如何在引力不稳定性作用下增长，并最终形成星系、星系团与宇宙网。其标准框架是包含暗物质、重子、辐射和暗能量的宇宙学扰动理论：在远大于自由流尺度的区域，物质近似无压，密度对比 $\delta$ 随尺度因子增长；在小尺度上，粒子的热运动则会抹平扰动。中微子具有非零但很小的质量，在早期是相对论性粒子，晚期转为非相对论性粒子，属于热暗物质；其自由流会抑制小于自由流尺度的物质聚类，并使聚类呈现尺度依赖性。由于中微子质量 $M_{\nu}$ 与其他宇宙学参数存在简并，精确、廉价且易实现的线性或非线性聚类近似，对宇宙学参数推断、N-body 模拟和巡天数据分析都十分重要。常见研究范式包括线性响应、微扰论、拟合公式，以及在模拟中通过傅里叶空间方法把中微子分布“补绘”到暗物质模拟中。
contribution:
论文提出新的线性近似 SE-EdS，适用于非相对论中微子及其他热暗物质，并在线性 Einstein-de Sitter 情形下精确。作者系统量化其精度并推广到广泛的平直与非平直宇宙学：在 $0.2 \leq \Omega_{m,0} \leq 1$、$0 \leq \Omega_{\nu,0} \leq 0.018$、$-0.1 \leq \Omega_{K,0} \leq 0.1$ 与 $w_0 \leq -0.6$ 的范围内，于所有尺度上**误差低于 3%**。该覆盖范围使 SE-EdS 适合红移 $z \lesssim 100$ 的 N-body 模拟，也适合处理从早期 $
\Omega_{m,0}=1$ 到晚期约 $0.3$ 的时间依赖情形。SE-EdS 可在傅里叶空间把中微子“补绘”进模拟；当这部分中微子占总物质的比例不超过 3% 时，**总物质密度对比的误差可控制在 0.1% 以下**，从而以可忽略的计算成本纳入中微子对聚类的效应。论文还讨论了该近似与现有线性响应方案高阶修正之间的联系，并公开了简单实现。
summary: The age of the cosmic neutrino is upon us. Aside from their fundamental importance to particle physics and the recent tensions in their mass scale $M_ν= \sum m_ν$, neutrinos' degeneracies with other cosmological parameters in analyses of scale-dependent cosmic clustering will significantly affect the estimates of these parameters, making accurate, inexpensive, easily-implemented approximations essential tools for theoretical cosmology. We present a new linear approximation, SE-EdS, applicable to non-relativistic neutrinos and other hot dark matter, which is exact in the linear Einstein-de Sitter case, and < 3% accurate for a broad range of flat and non-flat cosmologies characterized by parameters $0.2 \leq Ω_{m,0} \leq 1$, $0 \leq Ω_{ν,0} \leq 0.018$, $-0.1 \leq Ω_{K,0} \leq 0.1$, and $w_0 \leq -0.6$, at all length scales. This broad coverage in $Ω_{m,0}$ makes SE-EdS ideal for N-body simulations, whose redshift range $z \lesssim 100$ demands accuracy for time-dependent $Ω_m$ between unity and the preferred late-time values $\sim 0.3$. SE-EdS may be used to paint neutrinos into simulations in Fourier space, where its < 3% error and neutrinos' $\leq$ 3% matter fraction guarantees < 0.1% errors in the total matter density contrast, thereby including neutrino effects upon clustering at negligible computational cost. We quantify the approximation's accuracy; extend it to a broad range of cosmologies; and explore its correspondence with higher-order corrections to existing linear response schemes. A simple implementation is available online at https://codeberg.org/upadhye/SE-EdS .

title: The Cosmology of Hawking Axions
background_knowledge: 标准热大爆炸框架中，早期宇宙由辐射主导，膨胀速率由总能量密度决定；大爆炸核合成（BBN）以及复合与光子退耦过程对膨胀历史和额外相对论自由度非常敏感。原初黑洞（PBH）若在早期形成，由于其始终非相对论，能量密度按 $a^{-3}$ 稀释，而辐射按 $a^{-4}$ 稀释，因此 PBH 的相对能量占比会随尺度因子增长；即使初始丰度很小，也可能在蒸发前进入 PBH 主导的早期物质主导阶段。霍金蒸发以近似热谱发射粒子，黑洞温度与质量成反比；蒸发结束时的粒子注入会重新加热宇宙并恢复热大爆炸。轴子样粒子（ALP）是弱耦合的赝标量粒子，可由霍金辐射产生；其后续衰变到光子或保持相对论状态，会改变 BBN、宇宙微波背景（CMB）、大尺度结构（LSS）与 X 射线背景。CMB 中额外辐射常用 $\Delta N_{\rm eff}$ 表示，BBN 约束膨胀速率与衰变注入，LSS 和 X 射线则探测衰变光子的能量注入与背景辐射。该领域通过连接粒子物理、黑洞热力学与多探针宇宙学观测，限制早期宇宙新物理。
contribution: 论文指出，原初黑洞（PBH）的非相对论性使其能量占比相对辐射不断增长，因此**即使初始 PBH 丰度极小，宇宙也通常会进入一段早期物质主导时期；该时期在 PBH 蒸发、重新加热并恢复热大爆炸时结束**。作者研究这一阶段通过霍金蒸发产生的高能轴子样粒子（ALP），即“霍金轴子”的宇宙学后果：这些粒子随后变为非相对论并衰变为光子，从而影响多种宇宙学与天体物理观测量。基于此，论文利用大爆炸核合成（BBN）、宇宙微波背景（CMB）、大尺度结构（LSS）和 X 射线观测分别给出新的参数限制；并指出**若霍金轴子在复合时期仍保持相对论，则依其母体 PBH 质量可贡献 $\Delta N_{\rm eff}\simeq 0.05$–$0.11$，未来 CMB 探测有望观测到这一信号**。
summary: Since primordial black holes (PBH) are always non-relativistic, their cosmological energy fraction grows relative to that of radiation. Thus, for even a tiny initial PBH abundance, the universe generically enters an epoch of early matter domination, which ends when the PBH evaporate to restore the hot big bang. We consider the possibility that a PBH dominated era yields a population of boosted axion-like particles (ALPs) produced from Hawking evaporation. Eventually these ``Hawking axions" become non-relativistic and decay to photons, which can affect various cosmological and astrophysical observables. Here we place new constraints on these particles through their impact on big bang nucleosynthesis, cosmic microwave background, large-scale structure, and X-ray observables. Furthermore, if Hawking axions remain relativistic through recombination, then depending on the progenitor PBH mass, they contribute $ΔN_{\rm eff}\simeq0.05$-$0.11$, which may be observable with future CMB probes.

title: On the Detectability of Compact Multi-Planet Systems via Gravitational Microlensing
background_knowledge: 微引力透镜是引力透镜在恒星—行星质量尺度上的表现：前景透镜天体（恒星、褐矮星或行星）的引力弯曲并放大背景源星光，形成随相对运动变化的增光光变曲线。点透镜的特征角尺度为 $\theta_E$，对应物理尺度 $R_E=\sqrt{4 G M D_L D_{LS}/(c^2 D_S)}$，其中 $M$ 为透镜质量、$D_L$ 和 $D_S$ 分别为观测者到透镜和源的距离、$D_{LS}$ 为透镜到源的距离。当行星的投影间距接近透镜区（约一个爱因斯坦半径）时，会在这条光变曲线上产生可辨识的短时异常。因此微引力透镜对较宽轨道上的行星敏感，而对紧贴低质量主星的紧凑行星系统通常不敏感。超冷矮星周围的类 TRAPPIST-1 系统是凌星法发现的重要陆地行星族群，但其在微引力透镜巡天中的可探测性、以及凌星与微引力透镜两类银河系行星普查之间的灵敏度边界，需要用单透镜残差、多极展开和统计量 $\Delta\chi^2$ 等方法定量评估。
contribution: 论文把 TRAPPIST-1 的七颗行星分别及整体当作位于银河系核球方向背景源前的微引力透镜，定量计算其集体微引力透镜信号。取 $0.09\,M_\odot$ 的透镜位于 4 kpc 时，$R_E\approx 1.21$ AU，行星的投影间距为 $s=0.010$--$0.051\,\theta_E$，比透镜区小 12--63 倍；作者以单透镜模型拟合后的残差度量信号，并计入质心偶极项。由于四极项在两个像之间一阶相消，残差由八极项 $q s^3$ 主导，单颗行星仅达 $|\delta A/A|\sim 10^{-6}$。七颗行星合计即使采用 1 mmag 测光精度也仅给出 $\Delta\chi^2\sim 10^{-3}$，比标准探测阈值低五个数量级。**因此，类 TRAPPIST-1 系统无法通过微引力透镜被 Nancy Grace Roman 太空望远镜探测；要探测需把全部行星质量增大约 300 倍，而共振链在约 7 倍时已失去 Hill 稳定性的保证。** 只有透镜距源或太阳约 15 pc 以内，外行星才可能进入透镜区；同一视场中 Roman 的凌星通道却能大量探测此类行星，**这划出了银河系行星普查中微引力透镜与凌星灵敏度之间的一条清晰边界。**
summary: Compact multi-planet systems orbiting ultracool dwarfs, such as TRAPPIST-1, may be a major population of terrestrial worlds with poorly constrained demographics. Individual close-in planets are expected to escape microlensing detection, but whether a compact system can produce a detectable collective signal remains to be quantified. We calculate the microlensing signal from each TRAPPIST-1 planet, and of all seven combined, if the system were a lens toward the bulge. For a 0.09 $M_\odot$ lens at 4 kpc, $R_E \approx 1.21$ AU, placing the planets at $s = 0.010$--$0.051~θ_E$, 12--63 times interior to the lensing zone. We measure each signal as the residual after fitting a single-lens model, which accounts for the barycentric dipole. Because the quadrupole term cancels between the two images to first order, the residual scales as the octupole ($q s^3$), reaching $|δA / A| \sim 10^{-6}$. The seven planets combined yield $Δχ^2 \sim 10^{-3}$ even at 1~mmag precision, five orders of magnitude below the standard detection threshold. Detection requires increasing all planet masses by a factor of $\sim$300, whereas the resonant chain loses its guarantee of Hill stability at a factor of $\sim$7. Only a lens within $\sim$15 pc of the source or the Sun places the outer planets in the lensing zone. The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope is therefore not expected to detect a TRAPPIST-1-like system through microlensing, whereas its transit channel in the same fields can detect such planets in large numbers, marking a sharp boundary in the Galactic census between microlensing and transit sensitivity.

title: She Sees Shells by the Stellar Shore: A Kinematic View of NGC 253's Stellar Halo
background_knowledge: 在等级结构形成框架下，星系通过持续并合与吸积周围较小星系而增长；恒星晕是这一过程的化石记录，其中可能保留 streams、shells 和 debris fields 等动力学年轻子结构。研究范式通常利用分辨恒星的光谱测量视线速度 $v_{\rm los}$、金属丰度与年龄，并结合相空间和化学特征区分吸积恒星与原位恒星；前者来自被吞并的卫星星系，后者形成于主星系盘或原位晕。此类观测在银河系（MW）和 Andromeda 已有较多开展，但在 Local Group 之外成本高、难度大；Local Volume 中具有丰富晕子结构的 MW 质量星系因此成为关键实验室，NGC 253 即为代表。未来 30 m 级望远镜与宽场多目标光谱仪将显著扩展此类研究。
contribution: 论文利用 Magellan 的 M2FS 光纤多目标光谱仪，对以 NGC 253 西南壳层为中心的 225 颗恒星取得中等分辨率光谱，并据此**首次测量了 NGC 253 晕中 89 颗分辨恒星的恒星运动学**。作者通过多种方式探测子结构，识别出可能为吸积来源与原位来源的区域：其中低速度区与先前报道的西南壳层重合，**该壳层很可能由近期吸积形成**；另一个原位成分则**沿外盘分布**。扣除 NGC 253 的系统速度后，吸积群体与原位群体的视线速度中位数分别为 $-34_{-12}^{+16}\ \mathrm{km\,s^{-1}}$ 和 $167_{-14}^{+16}\ \mathrm{km\,s^{-1}}$。该工作**展示了运动学在区分吸积恒星与原位恒星方面的效用**，并为未来 30 m 望远镜和宽场多目标光谱仪观测提供探路示范。
summary: The stellar halos of nearby galaxies are fossil records of ancient mergers, providing insight into the formation and growth of these systems. These halos often contain substructure in the form of streams, shells, and debris fields that make up dynamically young remnants of past accretions. These remnants can be probed with resolved-star spectroscopic observations, giving insight into the kinematics of bygone satellite companions. Such observations have been made for the Milky Way (MW) and Andromeda, but are much more challenging and expensive to do outside the Local Group. The Local Volume has an abundance of MW-mass galaxies with richly structured halos, such as NGC 253. Leveraging the power of Magellan's M2FS fiber-fed multiobject spectrograph, we have obtained medium-resolution spectra of 225 stars centered on NGC 253's southwestern shell. These spectra enabled us to make the first-ever measurement of the resolved-star stellar kinematics for 89 stars in NGC 253's halo. We also detect substructure in several ways and identify regions likely to be accreted and in-situ, finding among them a low-velocity region coincident with the previously reported SW shell we believe was accreted recently, and an in-situ component that traces the outer disk. After subtracting NGC 253's systemic velocity, we measure median line-of-sight velocities of $-34_{-12}^{+16}$ km/s and $167_{-14}^{+16}$ km/s for the accreted and in-situ populations, respectively. This work highlights the utility of kinematics to differentiate between accreted and in-situ stars, and acts as a pathfinder for future observations with next-generation 30 m telescopes and wide-field multiobject spectrographs.

title: Estimating LuSEE-Night's Sensitivity to Cα Radio Recombination Lines
background_knowledge: 射电复合线（radio recombination line, RRL）是自由电子被离子俘获到高主量子数 $n$ 的激发态后，在相邻高激发能级之间级联跃迁产生的谱线。频率越低，对应的 $n$ 越大：1–50 MHz 频段大致对应碳复合线的 $n \sim 500$–$900$，即 C$n\alpha$ 线（$\Delta n = 1$）。在低频段，碳是主要的复合线来源，因为碳的电离势较低（11.3 eV），C$^{+}$ 在星际介质中广泛存在。这类谱线主要产生于星际介质的冷中性介质（cold neutral medium, CNM），其温度约为几十 K、密度约为数十 cm$^{-3}$，是中性氢的重要储库之一。因此，复合线强度对 CNM 的温度、密度以及低能辐射场（包括宇宙微波背景与银河系辐射场）十分敏感，是非热平衡（non-LTE）谱线形成的经典探针。低频观测面临几类独特挑战：地球电离层吸收与折射、短波与调频广播的强人为射电干扰，以及银河系同步辐射与自由—自由辐射构成的明亮前景。月球背面是太阳系中少数几乎完全屏蔽地球射电干扰的区域，被视为观测 1–50 MHz 窗口的理想场所。LuSEE-Night 是计划部署在月球背面的低频射电实验，其科学目标之一是测量天空平均（global）频谱，以寻找宇宙黑暗时代的中性氢 21 cm 吸收信号；而任何未被建模的谱结构（例如复合线）都可能污染这一微弱信号。观测上，单条复合线经波束稀释后，在天空平均谱中贡献的亮温度极其微弱；因此需要通过长时间积分，或将大量邻近谱线叠加（stacking）来提高信噪比。此外，实际观测谱还需与多相滤波器组（polyphase filter bank, PFB）频谱仪的通道响应卷积，才能与真实数据比较；这一步骤对窄线的形状与深度有不可忽略的影响。
contribution: 论文针对 LuSEE-Night 将在月球背面观测的 1–50 MHz 频段，系统建模了起源于冷中性介质的碳复合线，并将其视为该频段天空平均谱中的潜在前景。作者在模型中同时计入多普勒展宽、碰撞展宽与辐射展宽，并采用两种相互独立的方法估计线强：一种固定谱线的峰值光学深度，另一种固定频率积分光学深度；这两种方法又分别在“全天均匀”与“依据已有低频观测给定的分区取值”两类假设下实施，共构成六个天空模型。在此基础上，作者模拟了 LuSEE-Night 对这些 C$\alpha$ 线的响应：先对谱线做波束稀释，再与 LuSEE-Night 的多相滤波器组频谱仪通道响应卷积（zoom 模式的频率分辨率约为 390 Hz），从而得到预期的观测亮温度谱。利用这些模拟谱，作者针对六个天空模型估算了以 SNR $=5$ 探测单条 C$\alpha$ 线所需的积分时间，结果跨度极大：在最乐观的模型（全天光学深度约为 $10^{-3}$）中仅需 **约 30 小时**，而在最保守的模型（光学深度约为 $10^{-4}$）中长达 **27.6 年**。若把 10–50 MHz 之间的 361 条模拟 C$\alpha$ 线叠加，则 SNR $=5$ 所需的积分时间分别缩短至 **约 11 分钟**与**约 151 小时**；这表明 **即使在最保守的光学深度假设下，LuSEE-Night 也有现实机会在其任务寿命内实现 C$\alpha$ 复合线的叠加探测**。
summary: Carbon radio recombination lines (CRRLs) arising from the cold neutral medium (CNM) of the interstellar medium are potential foregrounds in the 1-50 MHz band that LuSEE-Night will observe from the lunar far side. CRRLs are sensitive probes of the temperature, density, and radiation field of the CNM, and LuSEE-Night will provide sky-averaged measurements in a poorly explored frequency range. We model CRRLs across this band, accounting for doppler, collisional, and radiation broadening, and we estimate line strengths using two independent methods - fixing either the peak or the frequency-integrated optical depth - applied both uniformly across the sky and with region-dependent values informed by prior low-frequency observations. We simulate LuSEE-Night's expected response to these CRRLs and further convolve the beam-diluted spectra with LuSEE-Night's polyphase-filter-bank spectrometer response, including its zoomed-mode frequency resolution of $\sim$390 Hz, to obtain the expected observed brightness temperature. Using these simulated spectra, we estimate the integration time required to detect individual CRRLs at SNR=5 across the six sky models considered. Required integration times range from as short as 30 hours (in the most optimistic model where the optical depth across the sky is $\sim$10$^{-3}$) to 27.6 years (in the most conservative models where the optical depth across the sky is $\sim$10$^{-4}$). Stacking the 361 simulated C$α$ lines between 10 and 50 MHz reduces the integration time needed for an SNR=5 detection to $\sim$11 minutes and $\sim$151 hours respectively, indicating that LuSEE-Night has realistic chances of making a stacked detection of C$α$ RRLs within a realistic mission lifetime, even under the most conservative optical-depth assumptions.

title: Net Cooling Tables for Cosmological Simulations under Multiple UV/X-ray Background Models
background_knowledge: 宇宙学流体模拟中的气体冷却函数描述单位体积气体在给定密度、温度、金属丰度和辐射场下的能量收支。在光学薄、光致电离平衡近似下，外部紫外与 X 射线背景会通过光致电离和光致加热改变氢、氦及金属离子的丰度，进而影响复合、碰撞激发与辐射冷却；净冷却率是冷却与加热之差，接近热平衡时二者近乎抵消，因此对辐射背景和元素丰度尤其敏感。实际模拟常把冷却率按元素分解成表，以便处理非太阳丰度。高红移低密度气体（如 IGM）光学薄且远离局域恒星辐射，是检验宇宙紫外与 X 射线背景模型对热演化影响的重要场所。
contribution: 作者使用 CLOUDY 23.01，在光学薄、光致电离平衡条件下，针对三种 UV/X-ray 背景模型计算了三套净冷却表。采用逐元素方法，并以与现有表格兼容的格式，分别给出氢、氦以及 13 种重元素的冷却、加热和净速率，同时包含氢组分丰度、电子丰度和平均粒子质量，且覆盖扩展的氦质量分数范围。对太阳组成气体，低红移时背景模型选择对净冷却率影响很小，但随红移升高差异增大，尤其在接近热平衡的弥散气体中。与广泛使用的旧表相比，在 $z \gtrsim 4.6$ 时该区域冷却时间可相差达一个量级；在 $z \approx 8$ 的弥散密度—温度平面上，约 10% 的区域甚至对气体净冷却还是净加热的判定不一致，对应 IGM。**因此，高红移低密度气体的热状态对 UV/X-ray 背景模型高度敏感，纯氢氦气体中该趋势仍然存在。**这些表为评估辐射背景对宇宙学模拟中气体冷却的影响提供了一致框架。
summary: We present three sets of net cooling tables for cosmological hydrodynamical simulations, computed with CLOUDY 23.01 for optically thin gas in photoionization equilibrium with three different UV/X-ray background models. Following the element-by-element approach, and in a format compatible with existing tables, we tabulate cooling, heating, and net rates separately for hydrogen and helium over an extended range of helium mass fractions and for 13 heavy elements, together with hydrogen species fractions, electron abundances, and mean particle masses. For gas of Solar composition, the choice of UV/X-ray background has little impact on the net cooling rates at low redshift, but the results increasingly diverge towards high redshift, particularly in diffuse gas near thermal equilibrium. Compared with widely used previous tables, cooling times in this regime differ by up to an order of magnitude at $z \gtrsim 4.6$, and the calculations disagree on whether the gas undergoes net cooling or heating over nearly 10% of the diffuse density-temperature plane at $z \approx 8$, corresponding to the intergalactic medium. These trends persist for gas composed exclusively of hydrogen and helium. The tables provide a consistent framework for assessing the impact of the radiation background on gas cooling in cosmological simulations.

title: Supermassive black holes and nuclear star clusters in galaxies: constraining formation and co-evolution with SHARP and MICADO
background_knowledge: 星系核区是星系引力势阱的中心，也是气体冷却、角动量输运、恒星形成与动力学演化在极小尺度上耦合的关键区域。核星团（nuclear star clusters, NSCs）与超大质量黑洞（supermassive black holes, SMBHs）是星系核区最主要的致密成分，二者可在同一星系中并存；它们的相对显著程度记录了秒差距（pc）尺度上的气体流入、恒星形成和动力学演化历史。当前核心开放问题包括：核星团究竟主要通过原位恒星形成、星团迁移与并合，还是多种通道组合而成；在哪些黑洞质量区间内，SMBH 的引力势开始主导核区动力学；以及在何种条件下，致密恒星核会被抑制、摧毁，或转变为尖峰状（cusp-like）结构。观测上，回答这些问题需要同时获得高角分辨率、近红外波段（以穿透尘埃）的核区成像与积分场光谱，并用恒星动力学、星族性质与核区结构进行联合约束。研究范式通常包括：利用恒星或气体运动学测量黑洞质量，利用积分场数据分解核星团内部运动学，利用星族年龄与金属丰度追溯恒星形成历史，并在统计样本中比较不同核区构型。下一代极端大型望远镜（Extremely Large Telescope, ELT）上的高分辨率近红外仪器将把这类研究从少数近邻星系扩展至更大样本和更高质量范围。
contribution: 文章系统阐述如何利用 ELT 上 SHARP 的近红外积分场光谱，并结合 MICADO 的高分辨率成像，在统一框架下对核星团形成与演化、以及核星团与超大质量黑洞的共同演化进行定量检验。**通过联合分析恒星动力学、星族性质和核区结构，可在同一星系内一致地测量黑洞质量、核星团内部运动学以及气体流入特征，并界定能够获得稳健约束的质量与距离范围。** 文章还指出，近期在高红移发现致密活动星系核表明，**即使在恒星成分较弱或高度致密的系统中，黑洞仍可实现高效生长**。尽管近邻星系并非早期系统的演化类比，SHARP 与 MICADO 可访问的核区构型多样性将提供一个本地实验室，用于分离并检验调控中心黑洞与核区恒星结构耦合演化的物理机制。
summary: Nuclear star clusters and supermassive black holes are the dominant compact components in galaxy nuclei. They can coexist within the same system, and their relative prominence traces the history of gas inflow, star formation, and dynamical evolution on parsec scales. Key questions remain open concerning the physical channels that assemble nuclear star clusters, the mass regimes in which supermassive black holes become dynamically dominant, and the conditions under which compact stellar nuclei are suppressed, destroyed, or replaced by cusp-like structures. We describe how near-infrared integral-field spectroscopy with SHARP on the Extremely Large Telescope, combined with high-resolution imaging from MICADO, enables quantitative tests of nuclear formation and evolution scenarios within a unified framework. The joint analysis of stellar dynamics, stellar populations, and nuclear structure allows black-hole masses, internal kinematics of nuclear star clusters, and signatures of gas inflow to be measured consistently within the same systems, and defines the mass and distance ranges where robust constraints can be obtained. Recent discoveries of compact active nuclei at high redshift indicate that efficient black-hole growth can occur in systems with weak or compact stellar components. Although nearby galaxies are not evolutionary analogues of early systems, the diversity of nuclear configurations accessible with SHARP and MICADO provides a local laboratory for isolating the physical mechanisms that regulate the coupled evolution of central black holes and nuclear stellar structures.

title: Magnetohydrodynamics During Reheating
background_knowledge: 早期宇宙与基础物理研究宇宙在极高温、极高能条件下的起源和演化，其核心框架是暴胀与热大爆炸模型。暴胀阶段由暴胀场（inflaton）主导，使宇宙近似指数膨胀，并产生近标度不变的曲率扰动；暴胀结束后，暴胀场围绕势能极小值振荡，并通过与辐射等离子体的相互作用把能量转移给标准模型粒子，这一阶段称为重加热。重加热并不一定瞬时完成，其持续时间、能量转移方式以及等离子体中的非线性动力学，都会影响随后热大爆炸宇宙的初始条件。原初磁场是早期宇宙中可能存在的另一类重要场；在辐射等离子体中，磁场与速度场、涡度以及密度扰动通过磁流体力学（MHD）耦合演化，并可在非线性阶段产生引力波。由于暴胀场与辐射等离子体在重加热期间可能尚未完全热化，需要采用多流体描述，把暴胀场和辐射分别作为相互耦合的流体来处理。研究这些非线性 MHD 过程，有助于理解原初磁场的演化、等离子体速度扰动的形成以及相应引力波谱的起源。
contribution: 本文建立了一个多流体框架，用于研究由暴胀子微扰衰变驱动、非瞬时重加热阶段中的三维非线性磁流体力学（MHD）演化。作者考虑暴胀子均匀向辐射区注入能量的最简单情景，追踪耦合的暴胀子—辐射系统中各组分动能、速度扰动、涡度、磁场和引力波的演化。结果显示，暴胀子向辐射区的均匀能量转移会提高辐射能量密度和动能密度，但**并未显著放大初始磁场扰动**；因此，磁场谱相对于瞬时重加热情景基本保持不变，而速度扰动会发生尺度再分配，并进一步**改变所产生的引力波谱**。该工作表明非线性多流体 MHD 动力学对于理解重加热期间原初场的演化十分重要，并为研究非均匀衰变过程和更细致的热化效应提供了框架。
summary: Reheating is a crucial phase that connects inflation with the hot Big Bang Universe. During this phase, the nonlinear interactions among the inflaton, the radiation plasma, and the primordial magnetic fields can influence the subsequent evolution of cosmic structures we observe today. In this paper, we develop a multifluid framework to investigate the evolution of three dimensional nonlinear magnetohydrodynamics (MHD) during the non instantaneous reheating phase driven by the perturbative decay of the inflaton into the radiation plasma. For the present paper, we consider the simplest scenario where the inflaton field homogeneously injects energy into the radiation sector. We study the MHD evolution of the coupled inflaton radiation system during the reheating phase, including the evolution of their individual kinetic energies, the velocity perturbations, vorticity, magnetic fields, and gravitational waves. We find that homogeneous energy transfer from the inflaton to the radiation sector increases the radiation and kinetic energy densities but does not significantly amplify the initial magnetic field perturbations. Consequently, the magnetic spectrum remains largely unchanged with respect to the instantaneous reheating scenario, while the velocity perturbations undergo a scale redistribution that affects the resulting GW spectrum. Our results demonstrate the importance of nonlinear multifluid MHD dynamics in understanding the evolution of primordial fields during reheating and provide a framework for exploring more realistic scenarios involving inhomogeneous decay processes and detailed thermalization effects.

title: Cosmological Backreaction and the Separate Universe Conjecture: Dynamical volume partitioning of Newtonian cosmologies
background_knowledge: 现代宇宙学以 FLRW 均匀各向同性模型为背景，并把星系和大尺度结构的形成理解为密度扰动的非线性增长。真实宇宙高度不均匀，而 Einstein 方程是非线性的：先演化再作空间平均，与先平均再演化通常并不对易，因此平均膨胀率中可能出现由不均匀性产生的“反作用”（backreaction）项。在 Newtonian 近似下，冷暗物质可用膨胀背景中的无碰撞粒子 N-body 模拟描述；周期盒对应三维环面（3-torus），是研究大尺度结构和平均演化的常用工具。粗粒化或体积分割把全局实现划分为若干区域，从而比较区域膨胀率、平均密度与全局积分约束。Separate Universe 假设认为，足够小尺度上的区域可近似为具有有效局部曲率或密度的独立 Friedmann 宇宙；这一思想被广泛用于长波扰动、晕模型以及模拟中局部演化的解释，但在非线性、非孤立体积和全局约束下需要仔细检验。
contribution: 论文为无碰撞物质的广义 Newtonian 宇宙学建立了一个精确且动态的全局实现体积分割框架，并与宇宙学反作用形式结合，用来分析结构形成的不均匀性与平均性质之间的相互作用。该框架既可作为 Newtonian 模拟中多种应用的工具，也能在区域尺度上以与全局积分约束相容的方式施加解析性质。作者讨论了文献中的 separate Universe 猜想与本框架的一致性。以 Average Expansion Rate Approximation（AvERA）为例，作者表明：把局部指定的 Friedmann 型膨胀率等同于物理的区域膨胀率会受到**全局 Newtonian 3-torus 条件**的限制；若把模拟单元解释为非物质的控制体积，Reynolds 输运会引入**质量通量和通量反作用项**，其动力学一般不再是相互独立的 Friedmann 区域。论文还讨论了稳定聚类（stable clustering）方案的相应一致性条件。
summary: We provide a description of general Newtonian cosmologies for collisionless matter in terms of an exact and dynamical volume partitioning of global realizations of Newtonian models. Employing the formalism for the description of cosmological backreaction, an interaction between the inhomogeneities of the formation of structures in the Universe and their average properties can be analyzed. Our results can be regarded as a tool for many potential applications in the context of Newtonian simulations, but they also provide an exact way to assume analytical properties of the universe models on regional scales in conformity with global integral constraints on their average properties. We discuss approaches in relation to `separate Universe conjectures' in the literature and examine their consistency with the exact partitioning framework. In particular, using the Average Expansion Rate Approximation (AvERA) as an example, we show that identifying locally assigned Friedmannian rates with physical regional expansion rates is constrained by the global Newtonian 3-torus condition. Alternatively, when the simulation cells are interpreted as non-material control volumes, Reynolds transport introduces mass flux and flux-backreaction terms, so that their dynamics is not in general that of independent Friedmann domains. We also discuss the corresponding consistency conditions for stable clustering prescriptions.

title: The PAU Survey: Self-supervised image denoising for flux-preserving photometry
background_knowledge:
大型深层光度巡天依靠长时间曝光与多波段叠图来探测极暗天体，但单幅或单波段的信噪比往往很低。低信噪比成像中的噪声主要来自天空背景光子噪声、探测器读出噪声与暗电流；这些噪声不仅让图像看起来“脏”，更会在源检测、测光（通量测量）、测光红移估计和样本选择等环节引入系统性偏差，例如噪声导致的假源、通量上偏（Eddington bias / Malmquist bias）以及红移离群点。因此，去噪在巡天数据处理中不仅是“美化图像”，更是定量科学分析的前置步骤。
\n传统去噪手段（高斯平滑、小波阈值、非局部均值、BM3D 等）依赖对噪声功率谱或点扩散函数的先验假设，且往往牺牲分辨率与高频结构。基于深度学习的方法通常需要“干净的参考图像”或成对的模拟—真实数据作为监督信号，而天文观测中这样的真值几乎无法获得。自监督去噪因此受到关注：Noise2Noise 要求同一目标的两份独立噪声实现；Noise2Void（N2V）更进一步，只需单幅含噪图像——它通过“盲点”掩蔽策略，用邻域像素预测被掩蔽像素，依赖“噪声在像素间独立、天体信号在空间上相关”这一假设来学习去噪映射。
\n然而，从统计本质上看，这类网络学习的是给定邻域下像素值的条件期望，等价于一种自适应的局部回归与平滑，因此会压缩高频信息、削平源的峰值，在低信噪比区域尤其容易造成通量低估（flux bias）与测光散布改变。对于以通量定标为核心的科学目标（测光红移、谱能量分布拟合、星系数密度），这类偏差必须被量化与控制。
\nPAU Survey（Physics of the Accelerating Universe Survey，PAUS）利用 William Herschel 望远镜上的 PAUCam，在约 40 个窄带加若干宽带滤光片下成像，目标是获得高精度的测光红移以研究暗能量与宇宙大尺度结构。窄带成像的信噪比天然偏低，是检验去噪算法的理想试验场；NB645 为其中一个中心波长约 645 nm 的窄带滤光片。评估去噪对测光的影响，通常使用通量比（去噪后通量与参考通量之比）分布、重复曝光之间的通量差异（repeatability）以及稳健散布统计量 $\sigma_{68}$（分布包含 68% 样本的半宽）等诊断量，而非仅看峰值信噪比或视觉平滑度。
\n在模型改造层面，有界输出层（bounded-output layer）用于限制网络输出的大幅负值，避免在低信噪比像素处产生非物理的通量抵消；LoRA（low-rank adaptation）是一种参数高效微调技术，通过在原权重上叠加低秩增量矩阵、冻结主干网络来适配新目标，从而在不破坏预训练特征的前提下引入任务特定的约束；通量感知损失（flux-aware loss）则直接把通量标度与重复曝光一致性写入优化目标，引导网络在去噪的同时保持测光的线性度。
contribution:
本文以 PAU Survey（PAUS）的真实观测图像和与之相似的模拟图像为试验对象，系统评估并改进了自监督去噪网络 Noise2Void（N2V）在天文成像上的表现，目标是同时实现保通量、降低测光散布以及在宽星等范围内保留源的主要形态特征。
\n作者首先指出，**标准 N2V 会系统性地低估星系通量，且对暗星系尤为严重**：去噪后的图像在峰值处被平滑削平，导致测光通量整体偏低。为缓解这一偏差，作者在网络中加入一个有界输出层（bounded-output layer），用于限制大幅负值输出；随后使用低秩适配（LoRA）进行微调，并引入两项通量感知（flux-aware）损失项，分别用于保持通量标度和改善重复曝光之间的通量一致性。
\n在结果上，对于 NB645 波段中 $22 \le i_{\rm AB} < 23$ 的 PAUS 星系，**标准 N2V 的通量比分布峰值远低于 1，而有界输出模型将通量比分布恢复到接近 PAUS 原始通量标度的位置**。采用通量感知的 LoRA 微调后，重复曝光通量差分布的宽度降至 $\sigma_{68} = 0.529$（NB645），**相对于原始 PAUS 的不确定度尺度，随机通量散布被有效降低约 47%**，同时通量比的中位数保持在接近 1 的水平。
\n作者由此得出结论：**面向巡天的去噪方法必须使用测光诊断量（而非仅依赖图像质量指标）来评估**；在引入通量感知的改造后，自监督去噪可以适配低信噪比的巡天图像，并保留定量分析所需的通量信息。
summary: Context. Deep photometric surveys increasingly rely on low signal-to-noise imaging, where noise affects source detection, flux measurements, photometric redshifts, and sample selection. Self-supervised denoising methods are attractive because they do not require ground-truth images, but applying them to quantitative photometry requires controlling the flux biases they may introduce. Aims. We evaluate and improve Noise2Void (N2V) for denoising real astronomical images, focusing on preserving fluxes, reducing photometric scatter, and retaining the main source features across a wide magnitude range. Methods. We use real observations from the Physics of the Accelerating Universe Survey (PAUS) together with PAUS-like simulated images. We show that standard N2V systematically underestimates galaxy fluxes, especially for faint galaxies. To mitigate this bias, we add a bounded-output layer that limits large negative outputs, and fine-tune the model with low-rank adaptation (LoRA) and two flux-aware loss terms that preserve the flux scale and improve repeated-exposure flux consistency. Results. For PAUS galaxies with 22 <= i_AB < 23 in the NB645 band, the standard N2V flux-ratio distribution peaks far below unity, while the bounded-output model restores it close to the original PAUS flux scale. The flux-aware LoRA fine-tuning reduces the width of the repeated-exposure flux-difference distribution to sigma_68 = 0.529 in NB645, an effective 47% reduction in random flux scatter relative to the original PAUS uncertainty scale, while keeping the median flux ratio close to unity. Conclusions. Denoising methods for astronomical surveys must be evaluated with photometric diagnostics, not image-quality metrics alone. With flux-aware modifications, self-supervised denoising can be adapted to low-SNR survey images while preserving the flux information needed for quantitative analysis.

title: Brewing another binary in the Teapot: Nandou=Phi Sagittarii
background_knowledge: 双星是测量恒星质量最重要的天体物理实验室之一：两颗恒星绕共同质心运动，其轨道由开普勒定律描述，周期 $P$、半长轴 $a$ 与总质量满足 $P^2 = \frac{4\pi^2 a^3}{G(M_A+M_B)}$。对于目视或干涉双星，角距离需结合视差 $p$ 转为物理尺度；视向速度可提供质量比与系统速度，光谱与测光则可约束有效温度、半径和光度。把动力学质量与恒星演化模型比较，是检验恒星内部模型和了解双星演化路径的关键途径。中质量星通常指约 $2$–$8\,M_{\odot}$ 的恒星，它们演化末期可能经历 mass transfer、形成白矮星并产生 symbiosis 等特殊系统。VLTI/GRAVITY 等长基线干涉仪能在毫角秒尺度分辨近距双星；Hipparcos 的中间天体测量数据 (IAD) 则记录了亮星的位置随时间变化，但卫星姿态建模若过于激进，可能把真实的双星轨道运动吸收掉。人马座茶壶星群是天空中标志性的星群，富含处于多星系统的中质量恒星，Nandou=Phi Sagittarii 即为其中一员。
contribution: 论文结合 VLTI/GRAVITY、档案光谱、历史视向速度测量和测光，求解人马座茶壶星群中双星 Nandou=Phi Sagittarii 的轨道与恒星参数。得到 $P = 238.844 \pm 0.011$ 天、$a = 1.32 \pm 0.10\,\mathrm{au}$、$e = 0.418 \pm 0.004$，并给出动力学质量 $M_A = 3.8 \pm 0.9\,M_{\odot}$、$M_B = 1.6 \pm 0.4\,M_{\odot}$；其精度目前主要受视差 $p = 12.5 \pm 1.0\,\mathrm{mas}$ 限制。**Hipparcos 1997 年原始中间天体测量数据 (IAD) 与预期光心半长轴 $a_{\mathrm{phot}} \sim 5\,\mathrm{mas}$ 相符，而 2007 年新归算得到的 $a_{\mathrm{phot}} = 1.7 \pm 0.3\,\mathrm{mas}$ 过小，支持对卫星姿态过度建模会造成过拟合、从而压低轨道运动的怀疑。** 将主星的有效温度 $T_{\mathrm{eff,A}} = 12000 \pm 250\,\mathrm{K}$ 与半径 $R_A = 5.1 \pm 0.4\,R_{\odot}$ 和恒星演化模型匹配，表明 **Nandou 的主星是一颗 $M_A \simeq 4\,M_{\odot}$、接近主序末端的中质量星，且该系统最终很可能演化为共生星。**
summary: The iconic Teapot asterism in Sagittarius is particularly rich in intermediate-mass stars in multiple systems. Here we combine VLTI/GRAVITY, archival spectroscopic observations, past radial velocity measurements and photometry to solve for the orbital and stellar parameters of the binary Nandou=Phi Sagittarii. It has a period $P=238.844\pm0.011$ days, a semi-major axis $a=1.32\pm0.10\text{ au}$ and eccentricity $e=0.418\pm0.004$. The precision in the dynamical masses $M_A=3.8\pm0.9 M_{\odot}$ and $M_B=1.6\pm0.4 M_{\odot}$ is currently limited by the parallax $p=12.5\pm1.0 \text{ mas}$. We find that the original Hipparcos 1997 Intermediate Astrometric Data (IAD) are consistent with the expected photocenter semi-major axis $a_{\mathrm{phot}} \sim 5 \text{ mas}$, while the IAD from the Hipparcos 2007 new reduction yield a too small $a_{\mathrm{phot}} = 1.7\pm0.3 \text{ mas}$, confirming the suspicion that a too aggressive modeling of the satellite attitude can lead to overfitting that suppresses the orbital motion. Matching the primary's temperature $T_{\mathrm{eff,A}} = 12000\pm250 \text{ K}$ and radius $R_{\mathrm{A}} = 5.1\pm 0.4 R_{\odot}$ to stellar evolutionary models implies that it is a $M_A \simeq 4 M_{\odot}$ star near the end of the main-sequence. Nandou will eventually most likely become a symbiotic star.

title: HLA-Net: A Physics-Guided Skeleton-Based Framework for Automatic Gravitational Arc Detection in Astronomical Images
background_knowledge: 强引力透镜效应是指前景大质量星系或星系团作为透镜，使背景星系发出的光发生偏折，从而在观测图像中形成弧、环或多重像。弧的形态、位置和曲率编码了前景透镜的总质量分布，包括暗物质，因此可用于星系团质量重建、暗物质分布约束和宇宙大尺度结构研究。该子领域的典型研究流程包括：在巡天图像中筛选透镜候选体，开展形态与颜色判据、光谱或测光确认，再用透镜模型反演质量分布。自动寻找引力弧的难点在于目标稀少、亮度低，且形态容易与细长星系、潮汐结构或图像伪影混淆；传统人工检查难以扩展到大规模巡天，而监督学习方法通常依赖大量人工标注。物理引导和可解释的几何验证因此成为降低假阳性、提高候选体纯度的研究方向。
contribution: 论文提出 **HLA-Net（Hybrid Lens Arc Network）**，一个可解释的多阶段引力弧自动检测框架，显式利用强引力透镜的几何形态与物理特征，且**无需人工标注训练集**。方法在包含复杂星系团结构的 FITS 天文图像上评估：从有序骨架表示中提取 169 个初始弧候选，经多阶段验证流程将搜索空间缩减为 83 个几何一致候选，并用稳健圆拟合成功建模 113 个候选弧结构。结果表明，HLA-Net 通过可解释、模块化的验证策略**有效抑制假阳性检测，同时保留物理上合理的透镜候选体**。
summary: Gravitational arcs produced by strong gravitational lensing provide a unique approach for investigating dark matter distribution, galaxy cluster mass reconstruction and the structure of the Universe. Automated detection remains challenging because gravitational arcs are rare, often faint and morphologically similar to elongated galaxies.In this paper, we propose \textbf{HLA-Net (Hybrid Lens Arc Network)}, an interpretable multi-stage framework for automatic gravitational arc detection that explicitly exploits both the geometric morphology and physical characteristics of gravitational lensing without requiring manually annotated training datasets.The proposed framework was evaluated on astronomical FITS images containing complex galaxy cluster structures. Starting from 169 initial arc candidates extracted from ordered skeleton representations, the multi-stage verification pipeline reduced the search space to 83 geometrically consistent candidates, while robust circle fitting successfully modelled 113 candidate arc structures. The results demonstrate that HLA-Net effectively suppresses false-positive detections while preserving physically reasonable lens candidates through an interpretable and modular verification strategy.

title: Mock CSST NUV-NIR imaging of TNG50 galaxies with resolved stellar populations
background_knowledge:
星系形成与演化研究通常依赖宇宙学流体模拟与观测图像之间的定量比较。以 TNG50 为代表的宇宙学模拟会追踪暗物质、气体、恒星、金属丰度、黑洞和反馈等物理过程，并给出星系内星粒子与气体单元的空间分布、年龄、质量、金属丰度等信息。要把这类模拟结果与真实望远镜图像比较，需要发展正向建模的 mock 观测流程：从星粒子出发抽样恒星族，处理尘埃吸收与散射，再叠加仪器的点扩散函数、天空背景和噪声。
\n分辨恒星族是理解近邻星系恒星形成历史、初始质量函数、化学演化和尘埃消光的重要途径。星族合成程序可根据年龄、金属丰度和初始质量函数抽样单个恒星；尘埃辐射转移程序则根据气体质量、金属丰度和几何分布计算消光与透射。CSST 是中国空间站望远镜，计划在近紫外到近红外开展多波段、宽视场成像巡天。其高分辨率与多波段能力使分辨恒星研究成为重要科学目标，但源检测、测光恢复和完备性分析都依赖接近真实的模拟图像。因此，构建从流体模拟到 CSST 图像的正向模拟框架，是连接星系形成理论与巡天观测的重要研究范式。
contribution:
论文构建了一个从 TNG50 模拟星系出发、面向 CSST 分辨恒星族成像的 mock 图像生成框架，并以一个旋涡星系和一个矮不规则星系作为示例测试。具体而言，作者使用星族合成程序 TRILEGAL 从星粒子中抽样单个恒星，显式保留亮星，并将剩余未分辨星光以及恒星形成区的星云发射作为星系的弥散背景成分；基于气体单元的气体质量和金属丰度推断尘埃分布，利用辐射转移程序 SKIRT 建立尘埃模型，计算单颗恒星的视线方向消光，并通过辐射转移模拟得到弥散光的图像级透射率图；对仍嵌在出生分子云中的年轻恒星，额外计入出生云衰减。随后，将尘埃衰减后的星表与弥散光图像输入 CSST 模拟流程，施加 PSF 卷积、天空背景和仪器噪声。

**该框架在七个测光波段生成了旋涡星系与矮不规则星系的 CSST 模拟图像，并在统一框架中同时包含分辨恒星、未分辨弥散光和尘埃衰减**。模拟图像涵盖了巡天中预期的主要观测效应，并附带已知的天测与测光定标信息，可作为后续源检测、测光恢复和完备性分析的真实感图像级输入。**该工作的主要贡献是建立并演示了一套可复用的正向模拟流程，而非对真实星系的直接观测发现**；框架设计上可适配其他流体模拟和观测配置。
summary: Aims. We aim to develop a framework for producing CSST-like mock images of resolved stellar populations from simulated galaxies, demonstrated here using two TNG50 galaxies as illustrative test cases. Methods. Starting from simulated galaxies from TNG50, we use the population synthesis code TRILEGAL to sample individual stars from star particles, retaining bright stars explicitly and treating the remaining unresolved light, including faint stellar light and nebular emission from star-forming regions, as a diffuse background component of the galaxy. Based on the dust distribution inferred from the gas mass and metallicity of gas cells, we use the radiative transfer (RT) code SKIRT to construct the dust model. From this model, we compute the line-of-sight extinction for individual stars, while image-level transmission maps for the diffuse light are derived through RT simulations. For young stars still embedded in their natal molecular clouds, we additionally include birth-cloud attenuation. The resulting dust-attenuated stellar catalogues and diffuse-light images are then processed with the CSST simulation pipeline, which applies PSF convolution, sky background, and instrumental noise. Results. Our framework produces mock CSST images for both a spiral galaxy and a dwarf irregular galaxy from TNG50 in the seven photometric bands. The mock images combine resolved stars, unresolved diffuse light, and dust attenuation within a unified framework, and include the main observational effects expected for the survey. The images are provided with known astrometric and photometric calibration information, and are intended as realistic image-level inputs for subsequent source detection, photometric recovery, and completeness analyses of resolved stellar populations. The framework is designed to be adaptable to other hydrodynamic simulations and observing configurations.

title: How fast is the fastest-rotating O-type star in the Galaxy?
background_knowledge: O 型星是质量最大、温度最高、寿命最短的恒星之一，其强烈辐射、星风与最终爆炸对星际介质、星团和星系演化有重要影响。快速自转会在恒星内部和表面产生显著物理效应：离心力使恒星变为扁球，表面有效重力与温度随纬度变化；在重力暗化作用下，赤道通常比两极更冷、更暗，而两极相对更热、更亮。因此，用球对称大气模型拟合快速自转星的谱线时，得到的光度、有效温度、表面重力以及投影自转速度 $v\sin i$ 都可能依赖视角，并产生系统偏差。研究这类天体需要采用扁球、重力暗化的大气模型，并区分角速度与临界角速度之比 $\Omega/\Omega_{\rm c}$、赤道速度与临界速度之比 $v_{\rm e}/v_{\rm c}$，以及赤道离心加速度与重力之比 $\eta_{\rm e}$ 等指标；仅凭投影速度或单一参数判断恒星是否接近临界旋转并不充分。
contribution: 本文重新测定银河系 O 型逃逸星 LAMOST J040643.69+542347.8 的恒星与自转参数。作者采用扁球、重力暗化的光球模型，并结合所选 He II 谱线的表格化 Stark 展宽轮廓，用 \texttt{ZPEKTR} 拟合 4000–4600 Å 的连续谱归一化光谱；模型使用 TLUSTY/SYNSPEC 出射通量、按可见 Roche 表面角贡献加权的临边昏暗、Espinosa-Lara & Rieutord 重力暗化以及 Schöning–Butler Stark 轮廓，并遮蔽星际介质及风或星周主导的谱线特征。模型能够再现 He II $\lambda4200$、He I $\lambda4471$ 与 He II $\lambda4542$。得到的母体非旋转对应体（PNRC）参数为 $T_{\rm eff}^{\rm PNRC}=38\,716\pm1041\,\mathrm{K}$、$\log g^{\rm PNRC}=4.12\pm0.12$ 与 $v_{\rm e}\sin i=587\pm73\,\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}}$。中心网格解给出 $\Omega/\Omega_{\rm c}=0.93$、$v_{\rm e}/v_{\rm c}=0.77$、$i=65^\circ$、$R_{\rm e}/R_{\rm p}=1.25$，以及赤道离心加速度与重力之比 $\eta_{\rm e}=0.50$。Roche 临界旋转要求 $\eta_{\rm e}=1$ 且 $R_{\rm e}/R_{\rm p}=1.5$，因此**尽管角速度很高，该中心解在赤道力平衡意义上仍未达到临界旋转**。其投影速度高于此前的球对称拟合值，但在统计上一致。**LAMOST J040643.69+542347.8 具有明显扁球状、重力暗化的光球**；**评估其接近临界旋转的程度应联合使用 $\Omega/\Omega_{\rm c}$、$v_{\rm e}/v_{\rm c}$ 与 $\eta_{\rm e}$**。作者指出，仍需在同一大气网格下进行受控球对称拟合，以分离忽略形变与重力暗化所造成的偏差。
summary: {Rapid rotation distorts massive stars, making parameters from spherical models inclination-dependent. We studied these effects in the extreme Galactic O-type runaway LAMOST J040643.69+542347.8.} {We re-determined its stellar and rotational parameters with an oblate, gravity-darkened photospheric model and tabulated Stark profiles for selected \ion{He}{ii} lines.} {We fitted continuum-normalised spectra over 4000--4600\,Å with \texttt{ZPEKTR}, using TLUSTY/SYNSPEC emergent fluxes, limb darkening to weight their angular contribution over the visible Roche surface, Espinosa-Lara \& Rieutord gravity darkening, and Schöning--Butler Stark profiles. Interstellar and wind- or circumstellar-dominated features were masked.} {The model reproduces \ion{He}{ii}~$\lambda4200$, \ion{He}{i}~$\lambda4471$, and \ion{He}{ii}~$\lambda4542$. We obtained parent non-rotating counterpart (PNRC) parameters $T_{\rm eff}^{\rm PNRC}=38\,716\pm1041$~K, $\log g^{\rm PNRC}=4.12\pm0.12$, and $v_{\rm e}\sin i=587\pm73$~\kps. The central grid solution gives $Ω/Ω_{\rm c}=0.93$, $v_{\rm e}/v_{\rm c}=0.77$, $i=65^\circ$, $R_{\rm e}/R_{\rm p}=1.25$, and an equatorial centrifugal-to-gravitational acceleration ratio $η_{\rm e}=0.50$. Roche critical rotation requires $η_{\rm e}=1$ and $R_{\rm e}/R_{\rm p}=1.5$: despite the high angular rate, the central solution is not critical in equatorial force balance. The projected velocity exceeds, but is statistically consistent with, the previous spherical-fit value.} {\object{LAMOST J040643.69+542347.8} has a markedly oblate, gravity-darkened photosphere. Its proximity to critical rotation should be assessed using $Ω/Ω_{\rm c}$, $v_{\rm e}/v_{\rm c}$, and $η_{\rm e}$ together. A controlled spherical fit with the same atmosphere grid is needed to isolate the bias from neglecting deformation and gravity darkening.}

title: Observational Test of the Maximum-Entropy Conjecture for Black-Hole Mergers with GW250114
background_knowledge: 双黑洞并合是检验广义相对论强场动力学的重要实验室。在广义相对论中，并合最终形成的 Kerr 黑洞由质量 $M$ 与无量纲自旋 $\chi=J/M^2$ 完全描述（取 $G=c=1$），其视界面积 $A$ 决定 Bekenstein-Hawking 熵 $S_{\rm BH}=k_B A/(4\ell_{\rm P}^2)$，在几何单位制下常写作 $S=A/4$。双黑洞并合过程可分为旋近、并合与 ringdown 三个阶段：旋近阶段可用 post-Newtonian（PN）展开描述能量与角动量损失，并合阶段依赖数值相对论，ringdown 阶段由准正规模（QNM）刻画。最大熵猜想提出：在并合前能量、角动量以及能量和角动量平衡律的约束下，真实的残留 Kerr 黑洞应使 Bekenstein-Hawking 熵最大。检验该猜想需要分别利用并合前旋近信号推断前身天体、利用并合后 ringdown 信号推断最终黑洞，并将熵最大化预言与独立的残留参数测量进行比较。
contribution: 本文利用引力波事件 GW250114 对双黑洞并合的最大熵猜想进行观测检验。作者分别从并合前和并合后信号推断前身天体与残留黑洞性质，沿推断得到的能量—角动量轨迹构造候选残留态的代理 Kerr 熵，并将最大熵态与由 ringdown 独立推断的最终黑洞质量及无量纲自旋进行比较。结果表明，该猜想预言残留黑洞质量 $M_f=70.0^{+0.35}_{-0.21}\,M_\odot$、自旋 $\chi_f=0.70^{+0.00}_{-0.01}$，而 ringdown 估计为 $M_f=72.3^{+3.6}_{-3.7}\,M_\odot$、$\chi_f=0.74^{+0.05}_{-0.07}$。**在基准分析中，熵偏差在 $68\%$ 可信区间内与零一致；改变并合前截断时间和准正规模内容后，也未发现与最大熵猜想有说服力的不一致。**
summary: The remnants of binary black-hole (BBH) mergers are accurately described by numerical relativity, but the physical principle governing the selection of the final states remains unclear. A recently proposed maximum-entropy conjecture suggests that a BBH merger produces the Kerr BH that maximizes the Bekenstein-Hawking entropy, subject to the post-Newtonian formalism or balance laws for energy and angular momentum. In this work, we test this conjecture with the event GW250114, inferring the progenitor and remnant properties from the observed pre-merge and post-merge signals, separately. We construct the surrogate Kerr entropy associated with candidate remnant states along the inferred energy-angular-momentum trajectory. We then compare the maximum-entropy state with the independently inferred mass and dimensionless spin of the final BH. We find that the conjecture predicts a remnant mass of $M_f=70.0^{+0.35}_{-0.21}\,M_\odot$ and spin of $χ_f=0.70^{+0.00}_{-0.01}$, compared with the ringdown estimates $M_f={72.3}^{+3.6}_{-3.7}\,M_\odot$ and $χ_f=0.74^{+0.05}_{-0.07}$. The entropy deviation is consistent with zero within the $68\%$ credible interval for our fiducial analysis, and variations in the pre-merger truncation time and quasi-normal modes (QNM) content reveal no compelling discrepancy with the conjecture.

title: Euclid Quick Data Release (Q1). Refining the strong lens sample with Space Warps crowd-sourced science
background_knowledge:
强引力透镜是指前景大质量星系或星系团等天体的引力场显著弯曲其后方背景源发出的光，从而产生多重像、弧线或 Einstein 环的现象。它是探测不可见质量分布、约束暗物质性质和研究宇宙几何的重要工具。强透镜系统相对稀少，且候选体筛选极易受到形态相似天体、图像伪影和观测噪声的干扰，因此在大规模成像巡天中，通常需要先由算法或人工预选，再经过专家或公众的目视检查与分级。
\nEuclid 是欧洲空间局主导的宽视场空间望远镜，具备高分辨率近红外成像能力，其 Quick Data Release（Q1）为早期强透镜搜索提供了高质量数据。Space Warps 是面向公众的星系动物园式公民科学项目，志愿者通过目视识别强透镜候选体。以往志愿者多进行“透镜/非透镜”的二分类，而发布强透镜样本前通常还需把候选体进一步区分为确定、很可能、可能和非透镜等等级。该研究关注如何利用公众分级提高样本纯净度与完备度，并讨论志愿者与专家分级之间的校准和差异。
contribution: 论文展示了公民科学家在强引力透镜候选样本精修中的有效性。作者把志愿者的二分类扩展为 **determinte?** 等待，抱歉，应忠实为 **definite、probable、possible 与 non-lenses 四级分类**，并将志愿者分级结果与强透镜研究人员的分级进行比较，讨论未来强透镜搜索中的最优分类与分级策略。研究发现，志愿者能够正确识别各个等级的透镜系统，且其回答经过校准后可与研究人员的结果相比较；非透镜系统的等级后验概率收敛最快。在对此类系统进行分级时，**一名研究人员的分类仅相当于 1.9 名志愿者的分类**。对中间等级候选体，志愿者和研究人员内部均存在显著分歧，因此未来搜索中引入经过校准的透镜概率有助于考虑这种主观性。若在 Euclid Q1 强透镜搜索中由志愿者执行分级并进行相应校准，则在研究人员检查前，**Grade A+B（分别对应 definite 与 probable 透镜）可达到 79% 的完备度和 41% 的纯净度**，这对应于 Euclid DR1 中预期的 **12500 个真实透镜**（即排除污染体）。
summary: We demonstrate the efficacy of crowd-sourced refinement of strong gravitational lens candidate samples by citizen scientists. Binary (lens/non-lens) classification by citizen scientists has been conducted previously, and here we extend such categorisation into `definite', `probable', `possible', and `non-lenses'. This grading is a required stage ahead of any strong lens sample publication and is usually carried out by (small) teams of researchers. We compare the responses of the volunteers to those of strong lens researchers and discuss the optimal strategy for lens classification and grading in future strong lens searches. Volunteers are found to be able to correctly identify systems of each grade, and their responses can be calibrated to be comparable to those of researchers. Grade posteriors, defined as the probability that a strong lens system classified by the volunteers is a certain grade, converge most rapidly for non-lens systems. We find that one researcher classification is equivalent to only 1.9 volunteer classifications when grading such systems. There is significant disagreement in the grading of intermediate-grade lens candidates amongst both volunteers and researchers. Moving towards calibrated lens probabilities for future lens searches would help to account for such subjectivity. If the Q1 lens search was rerun with volunteers performing lens grading (and corresponding calibration), a completeness of 79% for Grades A+B (corresponding to definite + probable lenses respectively) could be achieved with 41% purity prior to researcher inspection - this would correspond to an expected 12500 true lenses (i.e. excluding contaminants) in Euclid DR1.

title: Preparing for the Gaia DR4 Epochalypse: Simulated Epoch Astrometry for Substellar Companion Orbit-Modeling Benchmarks
background_knowledge: Gaia 任务通过持续扫描全天，测量恒星在天球上的位置、视差与自行，并将在第四次数据发布（DR4）中为数十亿源提供逐历元天体测量（epoch astrometry），把大量恒星的位置测量从少量历元扩展为逐次观测的时间序列。这使天文学家能够在恒星位置随时间的微小周期性变化中搜寻绕其运行的亚恒星伴星，包括巨行星和褐矮星。其物理图像是：伴星引力使主星绕共同质心运动，主星在天球上的反冲轨迹被 Gaia 记录；对多历元位置拟合开普勒轨道，可反演伴星质量、半长轴、偏心率、倾角等参数。该方向的研究范式是统计与注入—回收测试：用已知参数的模拟星表检验轨道拟合与周期图流程，评估探测率、参数偏差和选择效应。天体测量信号的信噪比不仅取决于伴星质量与轨道，还受主星自身测量噪声、扫描次数与时间采样、距离以及轨道周期相对任务基线长度的影响；当周期远长于基线时，往往只能看到缓慢曲率而难以定出完整轨道。
contribution: 本文发布 epochalypse 星表：对 G23H 星表中 $500\,{\rm pc}$ 内的 $5{,}040{,}328$ 颗主序 Gaia 星，分别注入零个、一个和两个伴星，共构成 $15{,}120{,}984$ 个系统。伴星质量与半长轴分别在 $1\,M_{\rm Mars}$ 至 $80\,M_{\rm Jup}$ 和 $0.03$ 至 $100\,{\rm au}$ 之间按对数均匀抽取，不设伴星发生率模型，也不做可探测性截断，因而轨道周期可远超任务基线，而无伴星样本作为匹配的零假设。作者利用一个估计信噪比来标记潜在可探测的单伴星与双伴星子样本，该信噪比计入每颗恒星的噪声、扫描次数以及周期长于基线时信号的压制。作为演示，作者对每个系统运行 kepmodel 天体测量周期图，发现**信号探测与周期定位在 DR4 基线之外发生解耦：长周期伴星可以产生显著的天体测量曲率，但其周期乃至质量仍难以约束**；在任意伴星发生率模型下，**轨道可探测但不可充分表征的系统数量将远超轨道可完整表征的系统数量**。星表、完整生成流程与建模教程均已公开。
summary: Gaia's fourth data release (DR4) will provide epoch astrometry for billions of sources, enabling the detection of potentially tens of thousands of substellar companions. We present the epochalypse catalog: Gaia DR4-like epoch astrometry for testing orbit-modeling pipelines on a common set of injected systems with known parameters. Onto each of the $5{,}040{,}328$ main-sequence Gaia stars within $500\,{ \rm pc}$ in the G23H catalog, we inject a zero-, one-, and two-companions system, for $15{,}120{,}984$ systems in total. Companion masses and semimajor axes are drawn log-uniformly over $1\,M_{ \rm Mars}$--$80\,M_{ \rm Jup}$ and $0.03$--$100\,{ \rm au}$, with no occurrence model and no detectability cut, so orbital periods extend well beyond the mission baseline and the companion-free population serves as a matched null.
